title: Ex Post Facto
line: Consider this official notice that you are entering a war zone. You do so at your own risk.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Understood.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Any attempt to provide aid or supplies to the Banea will be considered an act of war against the Numiri.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You have my word that we intend to remain neutral in your conflict. Our only interest is in our own crewman.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Proceed. Your activities will be monitored.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Very, very curious. In Numiri terms, that greeting was downright friendly.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Have all security stations remain at full alert. Continue long range scans for Numiri patrols around the clock.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Aye, Captain.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Take us into orbit.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Captain. It's unfortunate we must meet under these circumstances.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: My chief of security, Lieutenant Tuvok.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Please.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Exactly what are these circumstances, Minister? All we know is that a member of our crew has been accused of murder.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Oh, I'm afraid he's been more than just accused. He's been convicted and punished according to our law.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: What form of punishment?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: The perpetrator of a murder is forced to relive the crime through his victim's eyes.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: How is this achieved?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I can have our Chief Medical officer describe the procedure in detail if you wish. We have the capability of isolating memory engrams in the brain. We take them from the final moments of life. After they're used in the trial, they're transplanted into the perpetrator's brain.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: These memories are used in the trial as evidence?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: An artificial life form serves as host to the engrams and testifies to their content. In this case, the victim's last memories clearly show Mister Paris caught in an embarrassing episode with Mrs Ren. An argument ensues. Paris is then seen by the victim's own eyes, killing him. The evidence of his guilt is incontrovertible.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Captain.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Are you all right, Tom?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I've been better.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: May we speak to him alone?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Of course.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: The rehab colony back in New Zealand doesn't seem so bad right now.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Lieutenant, did you murder Professor Ren?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: No!

title: Ex Post Facto
line: But the victim's own eyes identified

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You don't have to tell me what the victim's own eyes saw, Captain. I don't understand it either, but I did not kill him.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Were you having improper relations with his wife?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Their marriage was over. She told Ren they were finished the same day he was killed.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: That does not answer my question.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Nothing happened between us. Almost nothing.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Tom, it's very important you tell us everything. Harry said you spent some time with Mrs Ren while he and the professor were working.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I was bored. You know how it is when two science guys get together.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I came out of the other room, looked over and saw her in the atrium. Her eyes were a million kilometers away, staring at stars I'd just flown by the day before.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Smoking is a bad habit. My species gave it up centuries ago when we finally got it into our heads it was killing us.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You must be a very superior species.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: That's not what I meant.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Maybe I kill myself slowly because I don't have the courage to do it quickly.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Now why would you go and say a thing like that?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Don't.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: What?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Don't get involved, Lieutenant.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I was just trying to

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You'll be sorry.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Look, I was just bored to tears in the other room and I thought you might like to talk.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Why don't you go ahead and ask me?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Ask you what?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: What you've been wanting to ask me all night. What they all want to ask me. Why I'd marry a man old enough to be my father.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'd be lying if I said I hadn't been wondering.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: He was good to me. A lot of other men weren't.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: That sounds like a good enough reason to me.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: He's a good man. I would never do anything to hurt him.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I guess that makes you a good woman.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Good can get very boring.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: No, Tom! Don't!

title: Ex Post Facto
line: No, I

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Stop! No!

title: Ex Post Facto
line: What's going on?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: No! No!

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Apparently, he's entering another cycle.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Is this normal?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: We had some problems integrating the Banean engrams into his alien neurology. This is the first time he's lost consciousness since the implant.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'd like to take him back with us to our medical facility.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'm sorry, but I can't authorize that.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Perhaps we should consider her request, Minister. We don't want to risk general synaptic failure. Their doctors might be better suited to stabilize his condition.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: All right, but you're not to leave orbit with him.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Minister, we don't intend to leave orbit until we prove his innocence.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Away team to Voyager. Three to beam up.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: It's medicine clearly beyond anything we've ever encountered before. What bothers me the most is the neural pathway damage it seems to be causing. It appears to be progressive.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Then this punishment could actually be causing serious brain damage.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: How long it might be before he's seriously affected, I really have no idea.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I would appreciate receiving a copy of your neurological analysis, Doctor.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: It's extremely technical. To the layman, it would be virtually indecipherable.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Nevertheless, I will want to examine it in detail.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: This might be the basis for an appeal of the sentence, don't you think?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Perhaps. However, before the neural implants were developed, the Banean punishment for murder was lethal injection. It is possible they would view that as the only alternative sentence in this case.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Will he regain consciousness?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I believe so. But each time the cycle repeats, I'm afraid his brain will take another damaging blow.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: When he wakes up, I will require an autonomic response analysis while I question him again, Doctor.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Do you really think Tom would lie to us?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: As an investigator, I do not have the freedom to ignore any possibility. Mister Paris maintains his innocence, yet the victim has identified him from the grave, and the victim's wife has testified against him at the trial. Someone is obviously lying. An ARA will tell us if it is Mister Paris.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'll have it ready for you.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: In the meantime, Captain, I request permission to return to the surface.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: What do you have in mind, Tuvok?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I would like to examine the murder scene and speak with Mrs Ren.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Mrs Ren?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Yes?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'm Lieutenant Tuvok of the Starship Voyager. Would you mind if I asked you a few questions?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Are you a friend of Tom's?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I am the Starfleet Chief of Security investigating his alleged participation in your husband's murder.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Stop it, Neeka! She just doesn't like strangers.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Based on your testimony, I assume this is where the murder occurred.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Yes, right there. I had to have a professional cleaning crew come in to remove the bloodstain.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You chose to remain in the house after an act of such violence occurred?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: This has been my home for over ten years, Mister Tuvok. Do you really find that so hard to believe?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I am a Vulcan, Mrs Ren. By nature, we are a dispassionate people. It is rare to encounter someone as dispassionate as we are.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Dispassionate? Is that how I seem to you? I think you'd get an argument from Tom Paris. Can I get you a drink?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Thank you, no.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Mind if I have one?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Please. You testified at the trial that you and your husband had an argument the afternoon before he was killed.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I never said there was an argument, Lieutenant. Have you ever had to end a marriage?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: No.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Are you married?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: My wife and I have been married for sixty seven years.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'm sure she's a fine, dispassionate woman. I hope you never have to find out for yourself, but I can tell you, ending a marriage, it's a quiet thing. The arguments are long over and there's really nothing much left to say at all.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: May I ask why you decided at this time to end your marriage to Professor Ren?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Because I was attracted to another man. I didn't want to deceive my husband.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: That other man was Lieutenant Paris. Lieutenant Paris would have been departing this planet in a few days, and yet you left your husband of ten years for him.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Meeting Tom gave me the push I needed. I already knew in my heart that it was time to start over.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Exactly when did you see Mister Paris on the day of the murder?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I went to see him at the Engineering Institute after I talked with my husband. Once I was free, I knew he wanted to be with me.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: How did you know?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: A woman knows, Lieutenant.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: He left his friend Harry to finish the technical research and walk me home. We were caught in a cloudburst on the way.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'm completely soaked!

title: Ex Post Facto
line: There must be a centimeter of water in my boots.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Here, let me help you.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: We shouldn't.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: It's okay. He knows it's over.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: But you're still a married woman.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I haven't been married for years, Tom. To him, I'm a friend, a companion. He hasn't treated me like a woman since, it must've been the day of the eclipse four years ago.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Eclipse?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: He was very excited by the eclipse. Don't ask me why.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Our timing's just a little off.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You'll be gone in a few days. This is the only time we've got. Let me make you something to warm you up. I love to drink Marob root tea on rainy afternoons.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I made some tea, we talked for a while, then we went out to the atrium to watch the storm and the rest you know.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Did you leave the room at any time during the fight between your husband and Lieutenant Paris?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I saw Tom murder my husband, Mister Tuvok. I tried to stop him. I couldn't.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Voyager to Tuvok.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: This is Lieutenant Tuvok.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Mister Paris has regained consciousness. I thought you'd want to know.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Thank you. I'll be returning shortly. Tuvok out. Thank you for your help, Mrs Ren.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Lieutenant, when you see Tom, would you tell him that I forgive him?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Everything she told you is true, except I don't remember going into the atrium or anything else after that.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: The last thing you remember is?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Sitting with her, drinking tea, talking about the sensual effects of eclipses. After that, I must've fallen asleep. When I woke up, I was in a cell.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: He's telling you the truth.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Was there any evidence of a sedative in his system when he returned here?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: The Banean medical authorities checked him. They didn't find any drugs in his blood. Most narcotics would've been gone from his system by the time he got to me.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Chakotay to Tuvok. You're needed on the Bridge. We're under attack by Numiri patrols.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: On my way, Commander.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Evasive pattern, beta one four zero. Dual attack mode.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Evasive pattern confirmed.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: They're attempting to lock a tractor beam on us.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: That is a standard tactic for the Numiri when they intend to board your vessel. Well, at least now you know I was telling the truth about them, Captain. Although I take no pleasure in being right, mind you.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: But why now? Why an unprovoked attack? What are they after?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: The Numiri have never needed an excuse to attack anyone.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Shields at ninety percent and holding.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Commander, prepare to initiate attack maneuver kappa zero one zero.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Captain, if you don't mind, there's a Maquis trick we sometimes used to get out of situations like this.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Be my guest.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: B'Elanna. Remember Teluridian Four? The two Starfleet runabouts?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'm with you. Blowing out the dorsal phase emitters. Torres to Engineering.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Go ahead.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Vent a couple of LN2 exhaust conduits along the dorsal emitters. Make it look like we're in serious trouble.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Understood.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Cut all engines.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Engines off-line.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Tuvok, lock phasers on their navigational deflectors.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Acknowledged. Numiri ships are closing. Four thousand kilometers.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Not to belittle Maquis tactics, Commander, but this is a very old trick.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: It worked against those Starfleet runabouts.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You're lucky I wasn't commanding one of them.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Two thousand kilometers.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Besides, out here in the Delta quadrant, every old trick is new again.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: One thousand five hundred kilometers.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: They're sending out tractor beams again.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: That's our cue. Fire phasers. Engage impulse engines.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Both Numiri vessels are disabled, Captain.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: That's one trick you won't be able to use again when we get back.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I have more.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Cancel red alert. Take us into high orbit.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Captain. More Numiri will be coming, I promise you.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Mister Tuvok. Any progress with your investigation?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Based on the ARA, I am convinced Lieutenant Paris believes what he is saying. However, I can offer no tangible evidence on his behalf. Considering the urgency of the situation, I believe the only logical alternative at this time is to witness the crime myself.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Yourself?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I propose a mind meld with Lieutenant Paris.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: A, a what? What, what did he say? A mind what?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Let me tell you something, Lieutenant. Believe it or not, I know more about mind melds than you do. I know what every Vulcan doctor has said in every study of mind melds, and I still cannot tell you what will happen if you do this. If these cycles cause damage to a human brain, there's no telling what the risk might be to a Vulcan.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I've examined your neurological reports, Doctor, and I believe the risk is acceptable.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Tuvok

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Captain, the answers I seek can only be found in the eyes of the murdered man. It may be our only chance to prove Lieutenant Paris innocent.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Tom?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Tolen!

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Now I understand.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'd better be on my way.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You don't have to go, Tom. He's got no right.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: No right? This is my home. You come into my home and steal my wife, and I have no right?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: That's not the way it happened.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: We'll see what your captain has to say about this. When I'm finished with you, you'll never wear that uniform again.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I can't let you do that.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: No, Tom, don't! Stop! No!

title: Ex Post Facto
line: The cycle's ended. No neural damage that I can detect.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Captain, I must consult with Ensign Kim immediately.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: With Kim? Why?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I assume he has access to Professor Ren's research. I believe it will explain not only why Lieutenant Paris has been accused of a murder he did not commit, but also why the Numiri chose to attack us.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: His condition has continued to deteriorate. He'll have serious brain damage if the implants are not removed.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: We are not a barbaric people, Captain. This was meant as punishment, not torture. I see no alternative but to remove the implants, do you?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: There is no legal precedent, of course, but we can petition the courts immediately.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I cannot assure you'll find an alternative sentence more to your liking.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: We're still committed to proving his innocence, Minister.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: When do you intend to return him to our custody?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Due to the nature of his condition, we're concerned that our transporting device might cause further medical complications, so we're sending him back by shuttlecraft. They'll leave this ship in one hour.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'll make the necessary preparations.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: This is all your fault, you know.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: My fault?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Yeah. I consider you the conscience I never had. You're supposed to keep me on the straight and narrow.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I tried to warn you.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Funny, so did she.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: If it had been me, I would've stayed as far away from her as possible.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Someday it will be you, Harry. You'll meet her, and you'll know it's wrong from the first moment you see her, and you'll know there's nothing you can do about it.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Here they come.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Numiri patrol approaching, bearing zero six seven, mark two four.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Red alert. On screen.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Range, one hundred thousand kilometers and closing. They're changing course, Captain.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: They're going straight for the shuttle, just as you said they would, Lieutenant.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Shuttle to Voyager. They've locked a tractor beam on us.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Offer

title: Ex Post Facto
line: No resistance, Harry.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Acknowledged.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Hey, Tuvok, I know it's a little late to ask, but you're sure you've got the logic of this thing worked out?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: If I am incorrect, we will know it shortly.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Ah. That makes me feel a whole lot better.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: We're being boarded.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: He's the one.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: This is Captain Kathryn Janeway of the Federation Starship Voyager. You have illegally seized one of our shuttlecraft.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I warned you that you were entering a war zone at your own risk.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Yes, we appreciated that warning and took appropriate precautions. If you read the sensor readouts in front of you, you will see that the shuttle is carrying forty tons of thalmerite explosives. Enough to destroy your ship. I'm prepared to detonate those explosives in thirty seconds if you do not release our vessel. End transmission.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: The shuttle's being released. The Numiri ship is withdrawing.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Tractor the shuttle and take us into low orbit. Cancel red alert. Mister Paris, how soon before your next cycle?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Seven hours.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: That should be enough time to clear this up. Mister Tuvok, this is your show now.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: With your permission, I would like to invite all interested parties to meet at the scene of the murder in two hours.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'll invite the Minister myself.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Lieutenant Paris was not the man Professor Ren saw before he was murdered.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Not the man? But it was clearly established at the trial.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: It is true, Paris's image was seen in the memories examined during the trial. However, that is because someone altered the engrams from Professor Ren's brain.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: But that simply isn't possible for this procedure.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I would suggest, sir, that there is no such thing as a technology that is entirely safe from tampering.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You're forgetting one thing. I was here and I saw him do it.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: On the contrary. I have not forgotten your statement, Mrs Ren. However, I now know it is clearly false.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Just what was in that tea you gave me, Lidell?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Is this just idle speculation, or do you have some evidence?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Mister Paris, would you please stand next to Mrs Ren?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: What for?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: If you wouldn't mind. The man Professor Ren observed with his wife was virtually equal in height to her. Clearly, Lieutenant Paris is several centimeters taller.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: How do you know what my husband saw?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Vulcans have the ability to meld telepathically with another's mind. I observed your husband's memories as Lieutenant Paris went through a cycle. I watched as the killer stabbed Professor Ren right here, through the intercostal space between the eighth and ninth right ribs, the exact location of the Banean heart. The killer clearly knew Banean anatomy. Lieutenant Paris did not.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Are we supposed to take your word for all of this?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: There is additional evidence. For example, we can now say for certain that Professor Ren was murdered by a Numiri agent.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: What?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Lieutenant, did you notice the stream of symbols and numbers that were superimposed on the images?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Symbols? Well, yeah, I guess I did. I didn't know what they meant. I thought they were part of the procedure.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: In researching this procedure, I found no other reference to this phenomenon. I have now confirmed that these symbols and numbers were equations taken from Professor Ren's weapons research. Someone intended them to be delivered to the Numiri.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You're saying somebody used his brain to send secret data to our enemy?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: He was a logical courier. The Numiri agents knew he could leave the planet's surface without raising suspicion. The Numiri made two attempts to gain access to Mister Paris. They attacked just after he returned to Voyager, and then again when he was in the shuttle.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Someone on the surface had to be informing the Numiri of Lieutenant Paris's movements.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Do you know who did this?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You knew when Mister Paris would be in transit, Minister. The doctor is the one who encouraged you to release him to our custody. He is also the one who performed the implant procedure. I know of no one else who had the opportunity and knowledge to carry out this plan.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I'm not going to listen to any of this.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I really would like you to listen, doctor.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Would you please stand again, Mrs Ren?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: So we're the same height. It proves nothing. I never saw this woman prior to the death of her husband. I was never even in this house before today.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: You forget the other witness who was here on the night of the murder, Doctor. Would you mind asking her to come in?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: It appears that you are no stranger to Neeka, doctor.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: He lied to me, Tom. No one was supposed to get hurt. You know I could never do anything to hurt you.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Yeah, you could.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Tuvok.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Mister Paris.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: There are some who'd say you risked my future on the eyewitness identification of a dog.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: It seemed a necessary step to ensure a truthful resolution.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Well, I appreciate you sticking up for me. I owe you one.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I conducted a criminal investigation. If you had been guilty, I assure you I would have pursued the truth just as vigilantly. You have no debt to me, Mister Paris.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: How come I always see you down here eating alone, Lieutenant?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: I prefer to read rather than engage in, what do humans call it? Short talk?

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Close enough. You don't make many friends that way.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Perhaps.

title: Ex Post Facto
line: Well, like it or not, you've made one today, Mister Tuvok.

title: Emanations
line: Captain's log, stardate 48623.5. There are two hundred forty six elements known to Federation science. We believe we have just discovered the two hundred forty seventh inside the ring system of a Class D planet.

title: Emanations
line: The element has an unusually large atomic mass, over five hundred and fifty nucleons. And the readings are constant. The element appears to be stable.

title: Emanations
line: A stable transuranic element inside a natural environment. This is a first.

title: Emanations
line: Can you imagine what we could make with this stuff? Probe casings that could go into the core of a sun, ultra-thin reactor shielding.

title: Emanations

title: State of Flux
line: I'm trying to take you out of harm's way to protect you.

title: State of Flux
line: This is your idea of protection? You might as well point a finger at me in front of the entire crew!

title: State of Flux
line: You don't assign someone you don't trust to the Bridge. Look, I'm sorry, but if something goes wrong over there, I don't want you anywhere near it.

title: State of Flux
line: Thanks for your concern.

title: State of Flux
line: How is he?

title: State of Flux
line: Not very good. We need to completely replace his blood.

title: State of Flux
line: Will he regain consciousness?

title: State of Flux
line: I'm not sure. Even if he does, there's no way to predict what kind of brain damage there might be.

title: State of Flux
line: He's the only one who really knows what happened on that ship, Doctor. The only one who can tell them I had nothing to do with it.

title: State of Flux
line: You? I don't understand.

title: State of Flux
line: Would you call me right away if he wakes up?

title: State of Flux
line: All right.

title: State of Flux
line: Ensign, did you ever come in to leave a blood sample on file?

title: State of Flux
line: No. I never got around to it. Why?

title: State of Flux
line: I've been running a crew compatibility analysis and your file never came up.

title: State of Flux
line: My blood won't help you. I had a childhood disease that infected it. I was warned never to donate blood for transfusion.

title: State of Flux
line: All the more reason we should have your blood on file.

title: State of Flux
line: I will. Right now I have something more important to take care of.

title: State of Flux
line: Someone did make an unauthorized transmission.

title: State of Flux
line: And whoever it was, was an expert at covering their tracks.

title: State of Flux
line: The signal was masked by a test of the dorsal emitters that we conducted a week ago.

title: State of Flux
line: Who was working on that test?

title: State of Flux
line: Only the whole engineering crew.

title: State of Flux
line: We're trying to trace the station where the signal originated. Again, the perpetrator was skilled enough to make the tracking process extremely difficult for us.

title: State of Flux
line: It's like working backwards through a maze of circuits. We keep bumping into dead ends.

title: State of Flux
line: Paris to Captain Janeway. Please report to the Bridge.

title: State of Flux
line: Captain, another Kazon ship is approaching, trying to hail the disabled ship. They're not within visual range yet.

title: State of Flux
line: Perhaps someone else picked up the distress call.

title: State of Flux
line: What's their ETA?

title: State of Flux
line: At their current speed, four hours twenty minutes. Should I tell them we're here?

title: State of Flux
line: If we know about them, it's a good bet they know about us. We don't have anything good to tell them. I think we'll wait.

title: State of Flux
line: Captain, I'm showing an unauthorized autosequence in Transporter Room two. Someone's left Voyager.

title: State of Flux
line: Computer, identify who just beamed off the ship from Transporter Room two.

title: State of Flux
line: Ensign Seska.

title: State of Flux
line: Chakotay to Seska.

title: State of Flux
line: I really don't have time to talk to you right now, Chakotay.

title: State of Flux
line: What the hell do you think you're doing?

title: State of Flux
line: Retrieving the console, my way.

title: State of Flux
line: I want you back on this ship, and I mean now.

title: State of Flux
line: The Captain said she wanted the console today. Carey's plan couldn't do it in time

title: State of Flux
line: But mine can.

title: State of Flux
line: Captain, it is conceivable that she's gone to the Kazon ship to destroy evidence that might implicate her.

title: State of Flux
line: She's gone back to the Kazon ship to prove herself to us. Can't you see that?

title: State of Flux
line: I've got a lock on her, Captain. Do you want me to transport her back?

title: State of Flux
line: If we try to beam her out while she's manipulating subspace, we might kill her.

title: State of Flux
line: Chakotay to Seska. Seska, respond! Get her out of there! Send her to Sickbay.

title: State of Flux
line: Energizing.

title: State of Flux
line: Prep three cc's kelotane. I'll need a dermal regenerator. Run a full blood scan.

title: State of Flux
line: Have a seat, Mister Carey.

title: State of Flux
line: How have things been going for you in Engineering?

title: State of Flux
line: Fine. Why, is there a problem?

title: State of Flux
line: You getting along all right with Lieutenant Torres?

title: State of Flux
line: I think we've settled our differences.

title: State of Flux
line: She was promoted to Chief Engineer over you, Lieutenant. That might be difficult for someone in your position to accept.

title: State of Flux
line: Captain, I accepted your decision, and I've worked as hard as I can to make myself a valuable member of Lieutenant Torres's team. I can't believe she'd have any complaints about my performance.

title: State of Flux
line: She doesn't.

title: State of Flux
line: Then what am I doing here?

title: State of Flux
line: Lieutenant, have you had any contact with the Kazon-Nistrim since we arrived in the Delta Quadrant?

title: State of Flux
line: What? You mean me, personally? No, of course not.

title: State of Flux
line: You were out of contact for almost an hour on the planet where we encountered the Kazon.

title: State of Flux
line: You mean when I was picking those poisoned apples?

title: State of Flux
line: What about before we arrived at the planet? Did you have any reason to signal the Kazon-Nistrim ship?

title: State of Flux
line: No.

title: State of Flux
line: Nevertheless, a signal was sent to the Kazon from your station in Engineering during our dorsal emitter test last week.

title: State of Flux
line: My station?

title: State of Flux
line: Were you not in Engineering at that time?

title: State of Flux
line: Well, yes, I was, but you know how it is down there during a systems analysis.

title: State of Flux
line: Did you see anyone else at your station?

title: State of Flux
line: Honestly, I don't remember. Maybe you should ask Seska.

title: State of Flux
line: Why Seska?

title: State of Flux
line: Everybody knows she was found in the cave with the Kazon. Look, I'm not saying she did anything wrong, but I didn't either.

title: State of Flux
line: I'd like to believe you, Mister Carey, but somebody did contact the Kazon. And until we know who, I'm going to have to restrict you to quarters.

title: State of Flux
line: What do you think?

title: State of Flux
line: He had the motive and the opportunity.

title: State of Flux
line: He's also had a distinguished Starfleet career. Seska has spent most of the last two years as an enemy of the Federation.

title: State of Flux
line: So have I.

title: State of Flux
line: Captain, we're being hailed by the approaching Kazon ship.

title: State of Flux
line: How soon will they be here?

title: State of Flux
line: Four minutes.

title: State of Flux
line: I wish we had something more definitive to tell them. Open a channel. I am Kathryn Janeway, Captain of the Federation Starship Voyager.

title: State of Flux
line: My name is Culluh, First Maje of the Kazon-Nistrim. What have you done to our ship?

title: State of Flux
line: We responded to a call for help. Unfortunately, by the time we were able to respond, all but one of the crew were dead.

title: State of Flux
line: I would like to speak to the survivor.

title: State of Flux
line: He hasn't regained consciousness. We have him in our Sickbay. We'd be happy to beam you aboard so you can see him.

title: State of Flux
line: You will prepare for my arrival.

title: State of Flux
line: Friendly sort.

title: State of Flux
line: Ah, Captain. I'm glad you're here. I was just about to call you.

title: State of Flux
line: Doctor, this is First Maje Culluh of the Kazon-Nistrim. Could you give us the latest condition report on your Kazon patient?

title: State of Flux
line: Well, the good news is, we've been able to stabilize him. We had to completely replace his blood.

title: State of Flux
line: Replace his blood? With what?

title: State of Flux
line: The blood of volunteers from our crew. They saved his life.

title: State of Flux
line: His own blood cells were killing him. They were changed by the accident on his ship.

title: State of Flux
line: Changed in what manner?

title: State of Flux
line: We haven't been able to determine that yet.

title: State of Flux
line: We've been working on a plan to access the source of the explosion, which should answer a lot of the questions.

title: State of Flux
line: That will no longer be necessary. We will take the damaged vessel to our port for inspection.

title: State of Flux
line: I'm afraid I can't allow you to do that just yet.

title: State of Flux
line: And what gives you the right to interfere in our affairs?

title: State of Flux
line: There was a trace of a Federation compound in the remains of the explosion. We have reason to believe that someone on board this ship gave technology to your people. Until we have a better explanation of what occurred, I can't release that ship to you.

title: State of Flux
line: That is not acceptable.

title: State of Flux
line: It will have to be.

title: State of Flux
line: Your unique technologies make you brave, Captain, but you have only one ship. In less than a day there will be four Kazon vessels off your bow.

title: State of Flux
line: Perhaps by then we'll have the answers we need.

title: State of Flux
line: You will leave us with him.

title: State of Flux
line: I assume they'll want to take him back to their ship. I'd rather not let them do it just yet in case he regains consciousness. There are a lot of questions he can answer. Can I tell them it's not safe to move him?

title: State of Flux
line: It will be the truth.

title: State of Flux
line: Good.

title: State of Flux
line: He's dead.

title: State of Flux
line: Get off this ship.

title: State of Flux
line: There was some kind of nerve toxin in that needle. He died instantly. Captain, may we talk to you in my office?

title: State of Flux
line: It's about Seska.

title: State of Flux
line: Complications?

title: State of Flux
line: I was analyzing her blood chemistry to try to locate a compatible donor. But when I got the results, her blood was lacking all the common Bajoran blood factors.

title: State of Flux
line: Meaning?

title: State of Flux
line: The only conclusion we can reach is that she is not, in fact, Bajoran. It appears Seska has been genetically altered. My suspicion is she was born Cardassian.

title: State of Flux
line: You're making me to believe she's a Cardassian agent who infiltrated the Maquis?

title: State of Flux
line: Starfleet Security has documented several incidents in which Cardassian have used cosmetic alterations for the purpose of infiltrating an enemy.

title: State of Flux
line: This is crazy. This is just impossible.

title: State of Flux
line: The Doctor has informed us that there's no other plausible explanation for the medical anomalies, Commander.

title: State of Flux
line: If you don't mind, I'd like to hear her explanation before we dismiss it. Has she been told?

title: State of Flux
line: No.

title: State of Flux
line: I'd like to be the one who questions her.

title: State of Flux
line: I suggest we wait until we retrieve the console. Janeway to Torres.

title: State of Flux
line: Yes, Captain.

title: State of Flux
line: Your status?

title: State of Flux
line: We're finished with the computer simulations.

title: State of Flux
line: Everything looks okay. We're ready to beam over.

title: State of Flux
line: Good. Then let's get started. Janeway out.

title: State of Flux
line: You were working for her. Seska was working for them. Was anyone on board that ship working for me?

title: State of Flux
line: The Kazon ship is hailing us.

title: State of Flux
line: Open a channel. On screen.

title: State of Flux
line: Our sensors show that you are trespassing on our vessel.

title: State of Flux
line: As I've already informed you, we're attempting to retrieve the console that caused this explosion.

title: State of Flux
line: If you attempt to remove anything from our ship, it will be considered an act of war.

title: State of Flux
line: You know, I'm really easy to get along with most of the time. But I don't like bullies, and I don't like threats, and I don't like you, Culluh. You can try and stop us from getting to the truth, but I promise you, if you do I will respond with all the unique technologies at my command. Janeway out.

title: State of Flux
line: Their weapon systems are standing down. They do not appear to be posing a threat to us at this time.

title: State of Flux
line: At least not until reinforcements get here. Janeway to Away team.

title: State of Flux
line: Yes, Captain.

title: State of Flux
line: I don't want to rush you, Lieutenant, but

title: State of Flux
line: We're finished, Captain.

title: State of Flux
line: I beg your pardon?

title: State of Flux
line: Decontamination went exactly as planned. The console has been transported to Engineering, and we're on our way back now.

title: State of Flux
line: Acknowledged. Well done, Away team. We'll meet you in Engineering.

title: State of Flux
line: Of all the things to die for. It's a food replicator, or at least it was trying to be.

title: State of Flux
line: We may take replicators for granted, but imagine what it would mean to a culture that doesn't have this technology.

title: State of Flux
line: They didn't use a thick enough interior shield casing. Once the nucleonic radiation leaked out, a cascade reaction was inevitable.

title: State of Flux
line: Can you tell if any part of the console came from out ship?

title: State of Flux
line: There's no doubt about it, Captain. The pattern buffer relays are clearly composed of bio-neural fibers. No other Federation ship would have them. Somebody on board Voyager gave them what they needed. I guess they just didn't know what to do with it.

title: State of Flux
line: I want a complete report on everything we've found so I can share it with our Kazon friends.

title: State of Flux
line: We've recovered the console. It's a replicator, constructed with materials from Voyager.

title: State of Flux
line: I suppose now everyone thinks I went over there to destroy the evidence.

title: State of Flux
line: Did you?

title: State of Flux
line: I was only trying to show everyone, show you. You really think I had something to do with this, don't you?

title: State of Flux
line: To be honest, I'm not sure anymore. I'm not sure of a lot of things.

title: State of Flux
line: Well, why don't you go talk to your animal guide and figure it all out?

title: State of Flux
line: I plan to.

title: State of Flux
line: Good. Get back to me when you do.

title: State of Flux
line: You know, it's funny. I've been thinking about what's been real and what's not been real.

title: State of Flux
line: What is this about? What's wrong with you? Talk to me, Chakotay. You owe me that much.

title: State of Flux
line: What would you say I owe to a Cardassian who infiltrated my crew?

title: State of Flux
line: What are you talking about?

title: State of Flux
line: Isn't that why you never got around to a blood analysis when we came on board?

title: State of Flux
line: I didn't get around to it because I didn't get around to it.

title: State of Flux
line: Turns out your blood is missing all the common Bajoran blood factors.

title: State of Flux
line: It's a side effect of Orkett's disease. Ask your doctor.

title: State of Flux
line: Orkett's disease.

title: State of Flux
line: A childhood virus that swept through the Bajoran work camps during the occupation. Thousands of children didn't survive. I did, thanks to a bone marrow transplant from a sympathetic Cardassian woman. Her name was Kattell. When we get home, you can ask her yourself. You must think I'm horrible. Do you think I gave you my, my heart to get your Maquis secrets?

title: State of Flux
line: I'm starting to wonder.

title: State of Flux
line: Let me tell you something. Your secrets weren't good enough. They wouldn't have been worth the trouble for a Cardassian agent. I had only one agenda with you, Chakotay, and I never kept it secret. So, do you believe in me again?

title: State of Flux
line: I want to.

title: State of Flux
line: Good. Because I want to go back to work.

title: State of Flux
line: Let's not rush things.

title: State of Flux
line: I'm going stir crazy in here.

title: State of Flux
line: You're going to have to stay confined, at least until we find out exactly where the replicator components were taken from.

title: State of Flux
line: Well, what'll that tell you?

title: State of Flux
line: There might be evidence of who took them.

title: State of Flux
line: Oh, you don't think whoever did this is foolish enough to log in using their own name?

title: State of Flux
line: Chief Inspector Tuvok leaves no stone unturned. I'll tell the Captain what you told me. Somehow we'll try to clear this up soon.

title: State of Flux
line: She said a Cardassian bone marrow transplant saved her life as a child.

title: State of Flux
line: Did you set our plan in motion? I gave Lieutenant Carey the same information.

title: State of Flux
line: Now all we can do is wait and hope someone takes the bait.

title: State of Flux
line: Gin.

title: State of Flux
line: I never knew Vulcans had such a talent for cards.

title: State of Flux
line: It is simply a matter of logical discards, which give a false impression of my own requirements and deny the needed cards to your hand. I believe that's ninety four points to me.

title: State of Flux
line: If you ever need a sponsor in a gin tournament, let me know.

title: State of Flux
line: We're picking up two more Kazon warships about six hours away. We're not going to be able to stay her much

title: State of Flux
line: That's sounds like a nibble to me.

title: State of Flux
line: Someone is accessing the inventory data base.

title: State of Flux
line: And they're going straight to the missing replicator materials.

title: State of Flux
line: Should we start the trace now?

title: State of Flux
line: Negative. It might alert them.

title: State of Flux
line: They're entering data.

title: State of Flux
line: Intriguing. It appears as though they're trying to place evidence at the scene of the crime to indicate the guilty party.

title: State of Flux
line: They're entering an encrypted security code into the materials requisition file.

title: State of Flux
line: Which would suggest they're hiding it. But not very well.

title: State of Flux
line: Anybody know whose security code that belongs to?

title: State of Flux
line: I do. It's Seska's.

title: State of Flux
line: Then it has to be Carey. Carey is trying to point the finger at Seska.

title: State of Flux
line: Chakotay. Is anything wrong?

title: State of Flux
line: It's over. We know who gave the technology to the Kazon.

title: State of Flux
line: Who?

title: State of Flux
line: You did.

title: State of Flux
line: Look, I don't know what evidence you think you've found, but

title: State of Flux
line: We found the evidence you put there for us to find. Your own security code.

title: State of Flux
line: I have no idea what you're talking about.

title: State of Flux
line: We already knew where the stolen materials had been taken from before I met with you. We were monitoring the inventory manifest, hoping either you or Carey would try to cover your tracks.

title: State of Flux
line: Hell of a way for me to cover my tracks, putting in my own security code for you to find.

title: State of Flux
line: That's exactly what you did. You knew no one would believe you could be that careless. You wanted us to believe that someone else was trying to frame you.

title: State of Flux
line: Ever consider that maybe someone was?

title: State of Flux
line: We traced the computer station used to enter the data. Oh, you took us all around the system and back again before we could locate the source, but it was this station, in Sickbay.

title: State of Flux
line: I'd almost say it was a Maquis operation, if I didn't already know you were a Cardassian. Computer, activate Emergency Holographic Medical Program.

title: State of Flux
line: Ah. Have I been called to testify?

title: State of Flux
line: Before you even mentioned Orkett's disease to me, the Doctor had already discounted that as a possible explanation for your blood anomalies.

title: State of Flux
line: And may I say a doctor less informed about Bajoran medicine might have been fooled, but my program includes the complete Bajoran medical text on Orkett's disease. There's no way any childhood virus or Cardassian bone marrow transplant can explain away the genetic markers in your blood. You are Cardassian, Ensign.

title: State of Flux
line: But that didn't necessarily make you the traitor we were looking for. We needed more evidence, and you gave it to us. The one thing I still can't understand is why?

title: State of Flux
line: I did it for you. I did it for this crew. We are alone here, at the mercy of any number of hostile aliens, because of the incomprehensible decision of a Federation Captain. A Federation Captain who destroyed our only chance to get home. Federation rules. Federation nobility. Federation compassion? Do you understand, if this had been a Cardassian ship, we would be home now. We must begin to forge alliances. To survive, we must have powerful friends. The Kazon-Nistrim were willing to be our protectors in return for some minor technology.

title: State of Flux
line: Minor technology that could change the balance of power in this quadrant.

title: State of Flux
line: Change it in our favor! That is all that matters at this point. Building a base of power in this quadrant. You are a fool, Captain, and you're a fool to follow her. I can't imagine how I ever loved you. Computer, command XJL.

title: State of Flux
line: Computer, override transport in progress.

title: State of Flux
line: Unable to comply. Security lockout is in place.

title: State of Flux
line: Computer, identify destination of transport.

title: State of Flux
line: A Kazon vessel fourteen kilometers off the port bow.

title: State of Flux
line: Bridge to Janeway.

title: State of Flux
line: Go ahead.

title: State of Flux
line: The Kazon ship

title: State of Flux
line: Is powering up its engines. It looks like they're getting ready to go to warp.

title: State of Flux
line: Ready a tractor beam.

title: State of Flux
line: I've also got two Kazon warships on an intercept course less than ten minutes away.

title: State of Flux
line: Captain, even with our superior defense capabilities, we cannot prevail against three Kazon warships.

title: State of Flux
line: Awaiting your instructions, Captain.

title: State of Flux
line: Power down the tractor beam. Set a course out of here, Mister Paris, warp four. Engage when ready.

title: State of Flux
line: Yes, ma'am.

title: State of Flux
line: We'll have to wait for another day to settle up with Seska.

title: State of Flux
line: Can I ask you to be honest with me, Lieutenant?

title: State of Flux
line: As a Vulcan, I am at all times honest, Commander.

title: State of Flux
line: That's not exactly true. You lied to me when you passed yourself off as a Maquis to get on my crew.

title: State of Flux
line: I was honest to my own convictions within the defined parameters of my mission.

title: State of Flux
line: You damned Vulcans and your defined parameters. That's easy for you.

title: State of Flux
line: On the contrary. The demands on a Vulcan's character are extraordinarily difficult. Do not mistake composure for ease. How may I be honest with you today?

title: State of Flux
line: I'd just like to know, from someone else who pulled the wool over my eyes, was I particularly naive? Was I not paying enough attention? What the hell was it that let all you spies get by me?

title: State of Flux
line: Like all humans, you depend on feelings and instincts to guide you, and they invariably let you down. But particularly naive? No, Commander, and I've always considered your attention span to be adequate.

title: State of Flux
line: Did you ever see anything about Seska that make you suspicious?

title: State of Flux
line: No. She quite expertly pulled the wool over my eyes as well.

title: State of Flux
line: Well, that makes me feel a little better. Thanks.

title: State of Flux
line: Curious.

title: State of Flux
line: What?

title: State of Flux
line: That my failure, added to your own, should improve your feelings.

title: State of Flux
line: Misery loves company, Tuvok.

title: Heroes and Demons

line: Containment field is active. We're ready for transport.

line: Energize.

line: That's strange. Both containers should have been filled.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm aborting transport. Okay, let's try that again. Energizing.

line: All right. I'll get a complete phase spectrum analysis on this as soon as possible.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'd like to get it sooner than that. I believe Ensign Kim is off duty. Could you use his help?

line: I think I might be able to. Janeway to Kim. That's odd. Computer, locate Ensign Kim.

line: Sensor logs show no record of any unauthorized transporter activity and all shuttlecraft are accounted for. If Ensign Kim left the ship, he did not do so by conventional means.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: His last shift ended four hours ago, and he was scheduled for time on holodeck two when he went off duty. No one has seen him since.

line: Scan the holodeck. What's the matter?

line: There is significant interference in the holodeck. I cannot obtain a clear scan.

line: Is it a system malfunction?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I do not believe so.

line: Commander.

line: The holodeck is definitely active. There appears to be a program in progress.

line: Can you shut it down?

line: Manual overrides are not functioning. I cannot terminate the program.

line: All right, let's go in.

line: Beowulf?

line: An ancient English epic, set in sixth century Denmark, if I remember correctly. It's about a hero named Beowulf who fights a creature that's terrorizing a kingdom and murdering its subjects. Monsters and swordplay. That sort of thing.
