line: The holodeck command systems must not be functioning either.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We must also consider the possibility that the safety programs are malfunctioning as well.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I am Freya, shield maiden, daughter of King Hrothgar. I hold this guard post against any intruders who would bear us harm, so declare yourselves. I will hear your answer before you march any further through this land.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We have no desire to trespass. However, we are on an urgent mission, so if you would allow us to continue, we would appreciate it.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: What land do you call home? Your faces tell me you are not men of the Danes. Are you kinsmen of Beowulf?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes. We are Beowulf's kinsmen. My name is Chakotay and this is Tuvok. Have you seen Beowulf?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes. He was like no other. Hair straight and raven black. Eyes bright with fierce fire. The burning gaze of a hero.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Grandiloquence notwithstanding, that would qualify as a description of Mister Kim. How did you know he was Beowulf?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: This is Harry's holonovel. It'd make sense that he'd be playing the hero. She might be able to help us figure out what happened to him.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: A reasonable assumption.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Your kinsman was a truly noble warrior. It is right you should avenge his death.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes. But first we'd like to know more about how Beowulf died.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Of course. Come. I will take you to the king.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Hail, Lord Hrothgar! I bring new friends, Chakotay and Tuvok, kinsmen of Beowulf who come to avenge his death. Greet them well.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I would bid you welcome to my hall, but the days of glad tidings are gone from this place. We grieve with you for your kinsman. We had hoped that a warrior of Beowulf 's strength and renown would be able to deliver us from our curse.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Could you tell us exactly what happened to him?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: He met with the same fate as did thirty of our own warriors.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It's true. Grendel.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: That's the monster who's been attacking you.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Repelled by light and laughter, the beast waits until we slumber. Then bereft of remorse, Grendel comes in murderous rage to my hall to take my people, and there is nothing anyone can do to stop it. If you are wise, you will forego your vengeance and return home. Death lives here now.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: My lord is fatigued. It is time to retire.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We would like more information about Beowulf. Would it be possible to examine his body?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: The body of Beowulf is gone, dragged down to Grendel's foul lair, no doubt. The beast leaves no traces.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Did anyone actually see the battle?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: No. Beowulf chose to face Grendel alone.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Then I think we'd like to see this Grendel for ourselves.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: To what purpose? To raise false hopes in our king again, as did your kinsman? Leave us alone in our misery.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Unferth, these men are our guests. You will show them the hospitality they deserve.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: They deserve nothing! If their Beowulf was truly the champion he claimed to be, then Grendel would be dead, his head mounted on a spear! Instead, we spend yet another night in terror.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: If you would allow us to assist you, perhaps we could help alleviate your terror.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Your names mean nothing to me. There are no songs of your deeds nor stories of the battles you have fought. Who are you to believe you can slay Grendel?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We have no intention of slaying anyone. We simply wish to examine the creature.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Grendel might not wish to be examined without a fight. And if you would fight Grendel, then you will first prove your worth to me. Defend yourselves!

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You are able warriors. You may stand sentry tonight.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You are brave men. I hope to see you again, fate permitting.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Chakotay to Janeway.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Go ahead.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Captain, we haven't found any definite signs of Harry, but we've encountered several holodeck characters who claim to know what happened to him.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Mister Kim was running a holonovel based on the poem Beowulf. According to the holo characters, he attempted to battle a creature of some kind and was killed in the process.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Killed?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Since the

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Safety programs are malfunctioning, we must consider the possibility.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: But you haven't found a body.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: No. If we shut down the program, we'd know if he's here or not.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Run a diagnostic on the holodeck's imaging control systems. If they're not working, try to repair them. And relay your tricorder scans to the Bridge. I'd like to analyze your readings.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Aye, Captain. Chakotay out.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Primary imaging matrix should be here behind this wooden panel. I will attempt to locate the auxiliary matrix. This ancient Earth culture seems fascinated with monsters.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Every culture has its demons. They embody the darkest emotions of its people. Giving them physical form in heroic literature is a way of exploring those feelings. The Vok'sha of Rakella Prime believe that hate is a beast which lives inside the stomach. Their greatest mythical hero is a man who ate stones for twenty three days to kill the beast and became a saint.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Such fables are necessary only in cultures which unduly emphasize emotional behavior. I would point out there are no demons in Vulcan literature.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: That might account for its popularity.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Bridge to Chakotay.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Chakotay here.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Commander

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We've analyzed your tricorder data. A deep-level scan shows minute quantities of photonic energy.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: How could it be in the holodeck?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We think it happened when we beamed aboard the samples from the protostar. There was a breach in the annular confinement beam, and photonic energy must have leaked into the transporter system.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: And from there into other ship systems as well. We've already found some in the replicators.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: That raises an uncomfortable possibility, Captain.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: If the holodeck's conversion nodes were contaminated, Ensign Kim may have inadvertently undergone the process of matter conversion.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You're saying he might have been converted into energy?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We have to consider it a possibility. After all, the holodeck are basically an outgrowth of transporter technology, changing energy into matter and back again every time a program is run.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Except it's not supposed to convert people.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Hold on, Captain.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Something's coming.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It is an object approximately one meter in diameter.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I think Grendel may be paying us a visit.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Captain, the holo-characters told us Kim was killed by Grendel. An examination of this part of the program might be advisable.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Proceed.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Captain, I'm picking up signs of matter energy conversion.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Emergency transport. Get them out of there now.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I can't get a lock.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Commander Chakotay, report. Mister Tuvok.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Captain, I've lost their life signs. They're gone.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: This is a scan of the holodeck just before we lost contact with Chakotay and Tuvok. The readings are pretty garbled, but I'm still inclined to think there is a malfunction in the holodeck's matter conversion nodes.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Photonic energy leaking into the subsystems could certainly damage the nodes, and it might have created a defect in the program that occurs when Grendel shows up.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: A defect that dematerialized our people.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm not willing to accept the fact that Harry and the others are gone for good. Their molecular patterns might still be there. And if they are, we might be able to rematerialize them. The only thing we can do is go back into the holodeck, study this energy surge, find out what exactly happened.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Anyone who goes back in there might wind up just like the others.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Maybe not anyone.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Me?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: A hologram can't be converted into energy. It already is energy. You're the perfect choice.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: How do you intend to transfer me out of Sickbay?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We'll have to modify your data stream protocols and imaging systems. But the fact that you're going to the holodeck simplifies things. The projection systems are already in place there.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: And we're going to give you complete control over your magnetic containment field. You'll be able to make yourself solid or let matter pass through you at will.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Nothing on the holodeck will be able to touch you unless you want it to.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I see.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Think of this as your first away mission, Doctor. I can understand your hesitation. But there are three lives at stake, and you have the best chance of anyone on this ship to save them. Do you understand that?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Good. Your job is to find the photonic energy surge and scan it closely. We need all the data we can get. You'll have to interact with the characters in the holonovel, so make sure you're familiar with the Beowulf story. Your circuit modifications will be finished in three hours.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes, Captain.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Computer, access full text of ancient Earth epic Beowulf including historical annotation and cultural references.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Data compilation in progress.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Doctor?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Ah, Kes. Come in. I don't know how long I'll be gone, but my absence is no reason to suspend your studies. How are you doing with the protein synthesis text?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I finished it yesterday.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Good. Then you may as well start learning how to operate the base-pair sequencer. You'll find the manual in the technical database. Was there something else?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: There's something bothering you.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Not at all. Now if you'll excuse me, I have a great deal of preparation to do.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You're nervous about this mission, aren't you?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Nervous? I can perform emergency surgery without getting nervous. I can make life-or-death decisions about patients without getting nervous. What makes you think I'm nervous?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Those things are familiar to you. You've been programmed to do them but, this is different, isn't it?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I can describe every detail of every piece of equipment in this Sickbay from biobed to neurostimulator, but I've never even seen a sky or a forest, let alone Vikings and monsters. I can't afford to fail but I don't know what to expect in that holodeck.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You've been telling me that you deserve to be treated like a member of the crew. Well, here's your chance. And I can tell you that none of the crew knows exactly what to expect when they go on an away mission. Doctor, have you chosen a name for yourself yet?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I have narrowed the list to three possibilities.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Then let me suggest you choose one before you go. It might help you feel more like a Starfleet officer.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You may be right. I'll give it some thought. And Kes, thank you.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Good luck.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Paris to Janeway. We're ready for the transfer, Captain.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Good. Go ahead.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: How about you, Doctor? Are you ready?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Of course.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I've already transported a tricorder onto the holodeck. Engaging transfer circuits now.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Is everything all right, Doctor?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes. There were no problems with the transfer. I'm on my way.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Speak as a friend or stand challenged. I am

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes, you're Freya, the king's daughter. A female warrior known as a Shield maiden.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We have never met and yet you know my name? Are you a sorcerer?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: No. It's simply that your reputation precedes you. A warrior of your skill. You're quite famous where I come from.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I did not know that word of my deeds has carried to other lands. Tell me what you have heard.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Well, your battle with

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Scyld, the Gar-Dane?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It's practically legend. An incredible story.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I burned his hall to the ground. There was nothing left but ashes.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Charming.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: And did you hear of my campaign against the Heatho-bards to the south? I fought them for

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'd be delighted to hear all about it but I'm on an urgent mission of my own. I'm looking for Grendel.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Only a warrior would seek that which others flee. What is your name?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm glad you asked. My name is Schweitzer. Doctor Schweitzer.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Schweitzer. A hero's name. Come, I will take you to the king. The hall is not far from here.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Look, fortune is with us. Atuta, a most powerful plant.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: What exactly do you intend to do with it?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We brew the Atuta into a broth which we drink before battle. It brings on the spirit of the bear and gives us strength to swing our swords.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It's more likely to bring on profuse sweating, convulsions and acute delirium. This is an amonita muscaria, a fungus common to sub-arctic climates and, let me assure you, quite poisonous.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes, but those it does not kill it makes strong. A most hardy plant. Are you a master of herb lore?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: In a way, I suppose I am.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You are truly a man of many talents, Lord Schweitzer. Your people must value you greatly.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You would think so.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Hail, Lord Hrothgar! I bring a new friend, Schweitzer, who has come to destroy Grendel. Greet him well.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I would bid you welcome to my hall, but the days of glad tidings are gone from this place.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm sorry to hear that, but with your permission, sir, I'd like to stay here tonight and wait for Grendel.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: To what purpose? To raise false hopes again, as have others before you? Leave us alone in our misery.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm afraid I can't do that. I have a mission.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Your name means nothing to me. There are no songs of your deeds nor stories of the battles you have fought. Who are you to believe you can slay Grendel?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm simply a warrior. I'm only concerned with Grendel. I have no quarrel with you.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Indeed you do. And if you will fight Grendel, then you will first prove your worth to me. Defend yourself!

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Fate be with you.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: If this is your best, then you should thank me. Grendel would destroy you with far greater ease than I.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: This is absurd.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: So be it.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You might want to put some ice on that. It'll take down the swelling.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Our time of deliverance is at hand. We have been given a new champion, one whom weapons cannot hurt! The one who will destroy Grendel and end our suffering! All hail the hero! All hail Schweitzer!

title: Heroes and Demons
line: All hail Schweitzer! Schweitzer!

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Eat. Eat.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: What is it?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Elk. When I built this hall, the forest ran thick with them. But today, game's more scarce. Enjoy it, Lord Schweitzer. It is a great delicacy in our land.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It's quite good.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We rarely hear stories of other lands. Honor us with a tale of your home to gladden our hearts.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm not much of a storyteller.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Please, indulge us.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes. Tell us a tale of your prowess in battle.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Well, there was the time I managed to stop the spread of Paronisti measles before it became epidemic. For a while, things were touch-and-go. Six people came down with it. Fortunately, I was able to isolate the endoplasmic virus and replicate it in order to form an antibody. Even then, it wasn't altogether clear I could create an effective vaccine, but I worked at it for seventy four hours straight and managed to create an inoculation that successfully protected the crew.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You'll excuse me, my lord, if I take leave of this folly.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: A truly unique tale. Come, Lord Schweitzer. Allow me to show you my home. If you are in need of anything, please do not hesitate to ask.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: All I need is to find Grendel.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You're a true champion, always ready for the fight. Ah, perhaps you would like some mead to fortify yourself for the battle.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: No, thank you. I'm fine.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Away! You're disturbing Lord Schweitzer! It was with that weapon I made my first kill. I was eleven years old.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You killed someone when you were eleven?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Well, it's a poor weapon, I agree, but a token of my youth. You must have similar trophies from your own childhood.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I don't remember much about my childhood.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Well, I'm certain you distinguished yourself in battle many times and did honor to your father.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: My lord! It grows late. It is time to retire.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Always with you it is time to sleep. Perhaps you have forgotten that the work of a warrior is battle not rest. You would do well to learn from Lord Schweitzer. This was a beautiful hall once, before Grendel. You will make it so again. You have our thanks.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I appreciate your faith in me, sire.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Come, my lord.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You may have deceived them with your tricks, but the king is old and desperate for hope, and the rest are just fools!

title: Heroes and Demons
line: You have nothing to worry about, Unferth. Once I'm done with Grendel, I'll be leaving.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We shall see. The morning will prove if your deeds are as strong as your words.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: The nights here are cold. I wanted to make certain you were comfortable.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I appreciate your concern. I thought everyone had gone to sleep.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Sleep does not come easily in this place. Not anymore. I was taught the world would end in winter. First there would be a desperate cold, followed by a demon who would devour the sun. It has been long since we felt summer, and a demon does walk these halls.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Freya, your world isn't coming to an end.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Perhaps not. But it has changed. Every night, the monster comes. And every day, our numbers are lessened and no one will speak of it. No one speaks of the fear that he will be next. Each meal become quieter than the last, and after time, we barely speak at all. Do you know what it is to be alone among many and unable to speak your fears?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I think I do.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: How do you survive?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm still learning how. I'm sure that's not very helpful.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Sometimes I believe I can see the moment of my own death. It comes in battle, I think, my sword raised high. It is said that fate often spares a doomed warrior if his courage can prevail, but there have been days when I have felt my own courage falter, and then you came.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm glad I could help.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Perhaps I can help you. Before combat, it is most important to stay warm.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Well, you've done an excellent job with the fire. I'm sure I'll

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Fire is not the only heat, Lord Schweitzer. You know where I sleep.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Holodeck to Bridge.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We're monitoring you.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Captain, I'm picking up readings of photonic energy.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Captain, it's right in front of me. It's some kind of photonic energy formation.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Emergency! Get me out of here!

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Now!

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Sickbay, emergency transfer.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm on it.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Sickbay. Report.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Er, I have him, Captain, more or less. I think you'd better come take a look at this.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: How does it feel?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Just like the old one, actually.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Apparently, contact with photonic energy disrupted your magnetic cohesion, but we're still not sure if that's what happened to the others.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Captain, take a look at this. The readings from the Doctor's tricorder when the energy surge made contact with him.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: They're showing a synaptic pattern. I wouldn't expect to see something like this in photonic energy. Is this the first time those patterns have shown up like this?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes, but it's the first time we've had clear readings from a moment of contact. I wonder if I could produce these same patterns in the samples we have in Engineering.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: If you can, you might be able to get more information about how photonic energy damaged the holodeck systems.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm on it.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'll give you a hand.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Okay, I've initiated a polarization field. I'm introducing it into the container.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We're getting a reaction.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It's producing a synaptic pattern, all right. Highly complex.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: What's that?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Whatever it is, it's cutting through the bulkheads.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Let's get a containment field around it.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It's heading for deck fourteen, section C five.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Okay, now I've got a containment field blocking it.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Oh. It's changing direction. It's like it's avoiding the containment field.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Let's give it another try. Now it's blocked on three sides.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It's changing course, heading for the open side.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Those synaptic patterns could be some sort of neural net.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We may be dealing with a life form.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Bridge to Engineering.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Torres here.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We're detecting an energy mass

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Moving through the ship.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Right. It broke through the sample container. Captain, it's showing the properties of a life form.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: A life form?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It seems to have a neural net, and it's demonstrating signs of intelligent behavior.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It's cutting its way through the ship, heading for the outer hull. It'll breach in about fifteen seconds.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Are there any critical systems in its path?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Negative.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Then let it go.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Be ready to seal the hull breach with a force field. I'll have a damage control team standing by for repairs. And let's track it on sensors when it gets out.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Captain

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It's penetrating the outer hull.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Force field is in place.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'm showing the energy form one hundred meters off our port side.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Let's get it on screen.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: What was that?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: It appears to be some kind of photonic lattice.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: And it seems pretty clear that the energy form was trying to get back to it as though it's a shelter of some kind.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Or maybe a transportation device. Their equivalent of a ship. At any rate, we had sensor contact for a few seconds, and we picked up three distinct bio-electrical patterns inside it.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Bio-electrical? What are you suggesting, Captain?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We have three missing crewmen. Our best guess has been that they were somehow converted into energy while they were on the holodeck. We find no sign of them on this ship. Then we pick up three discrete patterns in that lattice. Three patterns that don't match anything else in that lattice, and which have biological components. I don't think it's a stretch to hypothesize that those are our crew members, converted into a kind of photonic energy.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: But what are they doing over there? How did they get there?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: We have good evidence now that there are photonic beings that live in that protostar. Life forms that have intelligence. We didn't know that when we beamed those energy samples on board. We had no idea that what we were doing, in essence, was capturing those life forms. We locked them in a containment field and began to experiment on them. If my people were taken like that, I know what my response would be. I would do whatever was necessary to get them back.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Then you think they have simply retaliated against us?

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Yes. These beings can manifest themselves on the holodeck in the matrix of a holo-character. That's how they were able to take our crew members hostage.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Captain, if you're right about this, then we should return the remaining life form.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: A gesture, to show we mean well. It's certainly worth a try.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: If I took the life form onto the holodeck and released it to Grendel, maybe they'll understand and release our people.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Ordinarily, officers go through intensive training before they're put into a first contact situation but you're the only one who can do this safely.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I'd like to finish what I started, Captain. I can do this.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I agree. Make arrangements to transfer the life form to a container so the Doctor can carry it. But remember, if you're holding the container, you'll have to stay in solid form.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: I understand.

title: Heroes and Demons
line: Freya? Freya!

title: Heroes and Demons
