line: Set a course to follow them.

title: Warlord
line: I can't find the shuttle's warp trail. There's no sign of them on long range sensors.

title: Warlord
line: Transporter room to Bridge. Ensign Martin and the Ilari representative are dead. The Captain is injured and has been beamed to sickbay.

title: Warlord
line: Acknowledged.

title: Warlord
line: It looks like the shuttle's plasma injectors were remodulated to suppress their warp signature.

title: Warlord
line: You wouldn't think it was possible to make those adjustments so quickly.

title: Warlord
line: It takes some incredibly precise calibrations. Someone on that shuttle really knows what they're doing.

title: Warlord
line: They didn't follow us.

title: Warlord
line: Of course not. They're still trying to figure out what happened.

title: Warlord
line: What's wrong? Does your head hurt?

title: Warlord
line: A little. It's nothing.

title: Warlord
line: Adin should take a look.

title: Warlord
line: I said it's nothing! You're worse than that Talaxian.

title: Warlord
line: We're in position over the encampment now. Looks like Resh's assembled the troops right on schedule. Four hundred men just waiting for your orders.

title: Warlord
line: Maybe we should give them some.

title: Warlord
line: What is this? Nori! I heard your ship had been destroyed.

title: Warlord
line: You didn't think I'd let a little accident stop me, do you?

title: Warlord
line: That's Tieran?

title: Warlord
line: The host body you were expecting is dead. Fortunately a young nurse was with me at the right time, and she's provided me with a very suitable replacement.

title: Warlord
line: Oh, I'm very relieved you survived.

title: Warlord
line: Oh, I'm sure you are, at least for your own ambitions. I want you to advance my troops to the northern ridge.

title: Warlord
line: But we can't go ahead with the attack now!

title: Warlord
line: Are you questioning my orders?

title: Warlord
line: This is insane. We've spent years planning this, every move, every detail, and now suddenly our leader's been reduced to a little girl?

title: Warlord
line: I've been exploring the mind of this little girl and I've discovered some rather interesting abilities.

title: Warlord
line: She had barely begun to tap into them. It's a good thing I came along, so all that wasted potential could be turned to a greater purpose. Now, should I continue the demonstration, or do I have your loyalty?

title: Warlord
line: You shall have it. Sir.

title: Warlord
line: Captain's log, stardate 50351.4. We're holding a meeting with Demmas, the Autarch's eldest son and heir, in an effort to understand the recent hostile activity.

title: Warlord
line: I'm sure they really wanted to kill my father. He's the one they invited up to your ship. Nori and Adin are known to be political extremists.

title: Warlord
line: How could Kes be involved?

title: Warlord
line: I may be able to explain that. You mentioned that she was with the third patient when he died?

title: Warlord
line: That's right. Why?

title: Warlord
line: I believe your crewmember has been inhabited by the consciousness of a very dangerous man, named Tieran.

title: Warlord
line: Who is that? What does he want with Kes?

title: Warlord
line: Oh, I know exactly what he wants. To overthrow my family's government and to reinstate himself as the Autarch.

title: Warlord
line: He has held title before?

title: Warlord
line: Tieran ruled Ilari over two centuries ago. He was a war hero, a brilliant military leader. He brought security and stability during a difficult time in our history. But in peace time, he began to treat his own subjects as enemies. He became convinced everyone was a potential traitor.

title: Warlord
line: At some point your people must have rebelled.

title: Warlord
line: They did, led by one of my ancestors. They laid siege to the Imperial Hall for over a year and the city around it was burned to the ground, but Tieran was finally defeated.

title: Warlord
line: And yet you believe that he, or at least his consciousness, has survived.

title: Warlord
line: During his reign he became obsessed with his own mortality. He spent most of his time, and Ilari's resources, searching for ways to overcome death. Somehow he's discovered a way to transfer his own mind into someone else's body, as he's done with Kes.

title: Warlord
line: So he's been controlling her.

title: Warlord
line: Yes. Completely.

title: Warlord
line: But she, he knew things about Kes's life. He acted enough like Kes to fool us all. The real Kes must still be in there somewhere.

title: Warlord
line: Tieran may have access to her memories and her feelings, but the Kes you know is lost. I'm very sorry.

title: Warlord
line: I'm not prepared to accept that yet. Examine the body of the man who died. We need more information about how the transfer works if we want to get Kes back.

title: Warlord
line: That's certainly worth exploring, Captain, but our priority must be to stop Tieran. By force if necessary. Voyager is a powerful ship.

title: Warlord
line: You may be considering force, but my only intention is to rescue Kes and remove Tieran's consciousness. That should suit both our interests.

title: Warlord
line: You don't understand what's at stake here, Captain. You must help me to defend my people.

title: Warlord
line: Bridge to the Captain.

title: Warlord
line: Go ahead.

title: Warlord
line: We've located the missing shuttle.

title: Warlord
line: On my way. Let's hope we can put an end to this right now.

title: Warlord
line: They entered orbit, then dropped their shields and cut their engines.

title: Warlord
line: There's a residual trace of transporter activity. Looks like four people beamed from the shuttle to the surface.

title: Warlord
line: They're in the main chamber of the Imperial Hall.

title: Warlord
line: Lock onto those patterns and beam them back to Voyager.

title: Warlord
line: I can't. Some kind of interference has gone up around the whole structure.

title: Warlord
line: He's after my family, my father and brother are down there.

title: Warlord
line: Ah, the venerated Autarch. I've been looking forward to meeting you for a long time.

title: Warlord
line: Father!

title: Warlord
line: Where's his brother?

title: Warlord
line: He should have been here.

title: Warlord
line: Get him out of here. Lock him up!

title: Warlord
line: I think I've located the brother. According to security logs Demmas was transported to Voyager over an hour ago.

title: Warlord
line: He's going to be a problem but we'll have to deal with him at another time. Give me the talisman.

title: Warlord
line: This was stolen from me two hundred years ago, and I've dedicated every moment since to putting it back where it belongs.

title: Warlord
line: Loyalty and service to the new Autarch.

title: Warlord
line: Loyalty and service.

title: Warlord
line: I want you to pay a visit to my supporters in Yaro province. Give them all new titles, whatever I promised. And of course, I couldn't overlook your faithful service. I think the title First Castellan suits you very well. I feel like I've finally come home again. The trouble is I left it. My portrait should be hanging here. As for the rest of this nonsense, it's nothing more than a useless display of wealth. As if the First Autarch needs to impress anyone. I want it all cleared out of here. Everything should look as it did during my reign!

title: Warlord
line: I trust you'll take care of all that. And we'll need some new servants, too. What is it? You don't look happy.

title: Warlord
line: I'm happy that we've accomplished our goal, but there have been some unexpected changes and I don't know how they'll affect our future together. I don't even know if I'm still your wife.

title: Warlord
line: Forgive me, I haven't considered how unsettling this must be for you. Don't worry. You know how much I depend on you. Your loyalty and encouragement have helped make this victory possible. I'll share everything with you, just as I always promised.

title: Warlord
line: Autarch!

title: Warlord
line: Now I'm afraid I have business to attend to. Leave him here. Everyone else is dismissed. Ameron, you and I haven't had a chance to get acquainted. I'm Tieran.

title: Warlord
line: Tieran?

title: Warlord
line: I like the way you say that. You and I didn't get off to a very good start, did we?

title: Warlord
line: You murdered my father right in front of me.

title: Warlord
line: I shouldn't have let you watch that, I'm sorry. But his death was necessary to make room for his successor.

title: Warlord
line: Demmas is the rightful heir, not you.

title: Warlord
line: How many times have people said the very same thing to you? It must have been hard to hear, every day, the constant reminder that your brother is destined to be ruler just because he was lucky enough to be born first. I don't think that's fair, do you?

title: Warlord
line: It's the law.

title: Warlord
line: Doesn't have to be. It can change. Demmas is off hiding on some alien ship and you're here, with me. I'm sure it's an opportunity you've always dreamed of, to prove that you're really the natural leader and not just a weak copy of your father. Now you can have that chance, if you're willing to take it.

title: Warlord
line: You mean if I join you.

title: Warlord
line: We have so much to offer each other. Your heritage would help solidify my claim and in return I could give you power. Real power to control the lives of millions of people. To reward your friends, punish your enemies. Everything you want can be yours for the asking. Everything.

title: Warlord
line: After what you've done?

title: Warlord
line: That's all in the past. You should be thinking about the future. Would you rather be a martyr to your brother's cause, or rule by my side?

title: Warlord
line: Captain's log, supplemental. Demmas has decided to remain on board Voyager for the time being, but continues to monitor the worsening situation on Ilari.

title: Warlord
line: This coup attempt is turning my people against each other. They're splitting into factions, mine and Tieran's.

title: Warlord
line: Whom does the law recognize as Autarch?

title: Warlord
line: Officially, I inherited my father's title upon his death. But this isn't a matter of law, it's about loyalty. Some people will follow whoever has more power and right now that's Tieran. He's gaining support everyday. He's already recruited some of my less reliable allies, which may include my brother, Ameron.

title: Warlord
line: Your brother? I assumed he'd been killed.

title: Warlord
line: So did I, until I learned otherwise from sources on Ilari. Tieran spared his life no doubt in order to win his loyalty. Ameron's always been easily swayed.

title: Warlord
line: And you believe he would betray you?

title: Warlord
line: That's very possible. And if he does there will be no way to avoid a civil war. I must strike now, before Tieran is fully prepared!

title: Warlord
line: There are always alternatives to war. Before you send in your fleet I suggest we hear from the Doctor and consider the possibility of removing Tieran from Kes safely.

title: Warlord
line: I've identified the transfer mechanism. This cortical implant was automatically activated at the moment of death. It enhanced Tieran's neural pattern and sent it out along the peripheral nerves. The actual transfer took place through these bio-electric microfibers. When they came into direct contact with Kes they transmitted Tieran's pattern up through her nervous system and into her brain.

title: Warlord
line: I assume Tieran would implant a device like this in his new body as quickly as possible.

title: Warlord
line: Perhaps we can use that to our advantage.

title: Warlord
line: My thoughts exactly. This synaptic stimulator will tap into the implant in Kes's body and remove the alien neural pattern. Then her own consciousness can take over.

title: Warlord
line: Yes, but how close would you have to get to use this device?

title: Warlord
line: To be fully effective it would have to come in direct contact with her skin.

title: Warlord
line: If I could get anywhere near her, I'd use a thoron rifle to be absolutely sure.

title: Warlord
line: Not if you want my help. Kes is still a member of this crew, under my protection.

title: Warlord
line: I'm very sorry she got caught in the middle of this, Captain, but too many other innocent lives have already been lost. Including my father's.

title: Warlord
line: Then let's work together to prevent any more deaths. Don't risk the lives of your soldiers until you've exhausted every other option.

title: Warlord
line: What exactly do you suggest?

title: Warlord
line: If Tieran is anticipating an attack by your fleet, he may not be guarding as carefully against an individual infiltrating the Imperial Hall. I believe I would be able to get close enough to Kes to use the Doctor's device.

title: Warlord
line: Your knowledge of the Hall and its defenses would be invaluable to us.

title: Warlord
line: All right, we'll try your strategy.

title: Warlord
line: The new cortical implant looks fine. Let me just make sure it's connecting properly to the nerve pathways.

title: Warlord
line: Do something about these headaches while you're at it. They make it difficult to concentrate.

title: Warlord
line: That's an entirely different problem. This body isn't accepting your neural pattern very easily. She wasn't a willing host like the others.

title: Warlord
line: She's been resisting me all right. I can feel her in the back of my mind somewhere like a trapped animal, rattling her cage. She's a lot of spirit. It's invigorating.

title: Warlord
line: Your neural pattern may become unstable if you stay in this host. Now that we've got the transfer mechanism in place, I suggest you use it to move into a more compatible body.

title: Warlord
line: No! I like this one. Particularly the unique mental abilities that come with it.

title: Warlord
line: Consider the risks!

title: Warlord
line: Do you really think a child like this poses any threat to me? I've been fighting worse battles since the day I was born. When the doctor said I wouldn't live past my first year I proved them wrong. Even when my parents thought I was too sickly to be worth caring for, I survived on the streets. Even when my own ungrateful subjects forced me into exile I refused to accept defeat. I certainly won't surrender to this little girl! You will not suggest it again.

title: Warlord
line: Demmas has acquired two more ships.

title: Warlord
line: There are reports that his fleet are massing behind the fifth moon. We should make a pre-emptive strike.

title: Warlord
line: Not on the basis of an unsubstantiated rumor. Let him come to us. We'll be ready.

title: Warlord
line: I'm told that the Viceroy of Genarr is ready to give you his support in exchange for more territory.

title: Warlord
line: When did corruption become so commonplace? My people are crying out for moral leadership. I should make an example out of this Viceroy.

title: Warlord
line: What's wrong?

title: Warlord
line: There's someone.

title: Warlord
line: Tieran?

title: Warlord
line: There's a familiar presence in this room. Not any of you. Someone from this body's previous life. Someone she knew well. Seal the room! We have an uninvited guest.

title: Warlord
line: Everyone stay where you are.

title: Warlord
line: Who is he?

title: Warlord
line: Someone very good at concealing himself and his thoughts. A disciplined, logical mind.

title: Warlord
line: You've made it this far without being detected, but you didn't realize how much more perceptive I've become. Typical Vulcan arrogance. It's touching really, your concern for the life of your little student, risking yourself in a hopeless effort to save her.

title: Warlord
line: Get that off!

title: Warlord
line: Are you all right?

title: Warlord
line: Yes, I'm fine, and still perfectly in control of this body, but my compliments on your clever medical technology.

title: Warlord
line: An attack on the Autarch is punishable by death.

title: Warlord
line: She's so protective of me. But I think Voyager's tactical officer might be more useful to me alive.

title: Warlord
line: You know that I won't provide you with any information.

title: Warlord
line: You'd be surprised how often I've heard that.

title: Warlord
line: Who helped you get past my security? Who betrayed me?

title: Warlord
line: I had no assistance.

title: Warlord
line: What will Janeway do when you don't come back? Send someone else? Join Demmas in an assault?

title: Warlord
line: I have no knowledge of the Captain's plans.

title: Warlord
line: She must have discussed alternate strategies with you before you came on this mission.

title: Warlord
line: She did not.

title: Warlord
line: I suppose I could threaten you, or torture you, but I doubt that would make any difference.

title: Warlord
line: You are correct.

title: Warlord
line: Fortunately I have other options now. With these new abilities, it's a simple matter to reach into someone's mind. With some people it's effortless. Others require a little more work.

title: Warlord
line: Do you really think you can keep me away from your innermost thoughts? Your fears and insecurities? Your feelings? I sense an embarrassment at being captured, worry about how strong I really am, and of course there's anger. That's the emotion that really threatens your control. So you try even harder to hide from me. I feel those mental barriers going up. Do you notice that it doesn't seem to be working? As if someone were disrupting your ability to concentrate. It's a helpless feeling, isn't it.

title: Warlord
line: You will not break my control.

title: Warlord
line: Not break you, free you from all that repression. All you have to do is let go. I can help you release your own strength, and give you what you've always secretly desired.

title: Warlord
line: I have never desired Kes.

title: Warlord
line: All those hours you spent alone together, all those intimate moments touching each other's minds, you've never even wondered what it might be like?

title: Warlord
line: Kes!

title: Warlord
line: I'm here. I'm fighting him.

title: Warlord
line: I had no doubt you would be.

title: Warlord
line: There are times when he's weaker I can almost break through.

title: Warlord
line: Tap into his strengths, and make them your own.

title: Warlord
line: I'm losing hold.

title: Warlord
line: I am with you. Don't let go.

title: Warlord
line: No!

title: Warlord
line: Captain's log, stardate 50361.7. Lieutenant Tuvok hasn't reported for our scheduled rendezvous and we've been unable to contact him. We're now considering other, more forceful, options.

title: Warlord
line: Our team will beam down to the surface approximately two kilometers from the palace. Demmas and his advanced guard will meet us there.

title: Warlord
line: Captain, I request permission to go with you on the rescue team. I had basic combat training on Talax. All right, very basic. But I've also been participating in tactical exercises with this crew every month. I have a lifetime of experience thinking on my feet, and you know I'll do everything in my power to make this mission a success.

title: Warlord
line: Consider yourself drafted.

title: Warlord
line: The detection grid will make a surprise attack difficult.

title: Warlord
line: Well then, we'll have to find a way to knock out the grid.

title: Warlord
line: I've been scanning it for weaknesses. The system goes through a maintenance cycle every ten hours. There are a few seconds when it might be vulnerable to a narrow band EM pulse.

title: Warlord
line: Bridge to the Captain. You have an incoming transmission from the planet.

title: Warlord
line: Put it through.

title: Warlord
line: Captain, you failed.

title: Warlord
line: What do you mean?

title: Warlord
line: I'm still in control. Your little device was useless and Tuvok is my prisoner. I suggest you call off your new rescue mission before you lose any more members of your crew.

title: Warlord
line: You've made a bad guess, Tieran. There will be no more rescues.

title: Warlord
line: My guess is that you've discovered the convenient weakness in the detection grid. If you attempt to take advantage of it, I'll have twice as many soldiers waiting for you.

title: Warlord
line: If this was meant to be a trap, why tell us about it?

title: Warlord
line: I'm really not a monster. I have no quarrel with Voyager. Your crew did save my life once when my ship was about to explode. I haven't forgotten that. This has been a friendly warning, Captain, but it's the last one. Now, I strongly suggest that you accept your losses and be on your way. You have thirty seconds to leave orbit.

title: Warlord
line: Send two of my warships to intercept Voyager.

title: Warlord
line: You're not well.

title: Warlord
line: If you can't do anything about this pain, then leave me alone.

title: Warlord
line: You need to get some sleep.

title: Warlord
line: No, she's there when I sleep.

title: Warlord
line: She?

title: Warlord
line: Kes! Who else.

title: Warlord
line: You can't stay awake for the rest of your life.

title: Warlord
line: The Voyager's leaving orbit.

title: Warlord
line: Let them go.

title: Warlord
line: Yes, sir, but, with all due respect, why? Demmas is on that ship. Our warships are in position to destroy it.

title: Warlord
line: I told them they could go, and I keep my word. I don't have to explain myself to you. Get out! Everyone! Clear the room now!

title: Warlord
line: You're losing, Tieran. Why won't you admit it?

title: Warlord
line: I will admit that you surprised me. Who would have imagined that such fierce determination existed within that deceptively frail body.

title: Warlord
line: Don't continue to underestimate me. Release me, or I'll force you out.

title: Warlord
line: My dear, why should we be enemies? Why waste the energy in conflict when we could achieve so much more by cooperating.

title: Warlord
line: You're contemptible, Tieran. I won't be any part of your plans.

title: Warlord
line: You're already a part of them. You and I have killed together, remember? And you will continue to serve my will. You really have no choice. Wouldn't it be wiser to join me? To take advantage of all I have to offer. You may find that you enjoy having power. I assure you, it is the finest aphrodisiac there is.

title: Warlord
line: That may work with others, but it won't with me.

title: Warlord
line: So, you insist on making this a battle. How foolish.

title: Warlord
line: It's a battle I intend to win.

title: Warlord
line: Brave words. You've been an annoyance to me, nothing more.

title: Warlord
line: I've been more to you than that, and you know it. I'm fighting you with every bit of strength I have, and it's wearing you down. You're becoming more unstable every day. The headaches alone are almost more than you can stand.

title: Warlord
line: I've suffered pain all my life. It's going to take more than headaches to stop me.

title: Warlord
line: I know all about your life. I know about your suffering. It doesn't justify what you've become. You're a monster, Tieran, and I have no compassion for you.

title: Warlord
line: And I don't ask for any. What I need from you I already have. Your body and your mind.

title: Warlord
line: You may have my body but you'll never have my mind. I won't surrender it.

title: Warlord
line: You may resist and try to fight me, but eventually I will defeat you. I haven't existed for two centuries to be brought down by a child!

title: Warlord
line: You're already deteriorating and it's only going to get worse. I'll find every little crack in your defenses. You'll feel yourself crumbling from within, your sanity slipping away. I won't stop until you're broken and helpless. There's nowhere you can go to get away from me. I'll be relentless and merciless, just like you.

title: Warlord
line: What are you doing?

title: Warlord
line: You were in such a deep sleep I had to use a stimulant to bring you out of it. Your neural stress levels are extremely erratic. This has gone too far. You must transfer out of this body before it destroys you.

title: Warlord
line: I told you not to say that ever again! As you can see, I'm in full command of my faculties. This momentary lapse will pass and I'll be stronger than ever! Stronger than ever! Stronger than ever. Stronger than.

title: Warlord
line: My friends, we have much to celebrate tonight. Our recent victory, the consolidation of power among those who are loyal to us, and the fact that Ilari is poised on the bring of what will be it's greatest era of prosperity. But there's another occasion that's cause for celebration. One that is perhaps the most joyous of all. I'd like to present my husband to be.

title: Warlord
line: Don't be upset, it's only a political alliance. Ameron will help bring the support of Demmas's troops. Ah, tell me you still love me.

title: Warlord
line: You know I love you.

title: Warlord
line: Ameron! And Nori. You have both been essential to my success, and I want you to be close friends. I want us all to be very, very close. Ah, Nori, don't make me doubt your loyalty. I'm not listening to you!

title: Warlord
line: Sir, enemy ships are approaching. At least twenty. It's Demmas's fleet, and Voyager.

title: Warlord
line: I assume our ships are moving to intercept them?

title: Warlord
line: Yes, but we are outnumbered.

title: Warlord
line: I've always fought against the odds. My fleet will defeat them.

title: Warlord
line: All the same, I recommend taking some precautions. We should get you to the reinforced shelter.

title: Warlord
line: This is a celebration to announce my marriage. I won't allow Demmas to make me run like some frightened animal. Join us. Food and drink for my First Castellan. I told you to join us. Drink! Eat! I want all of you to enjoy yourselves. My charitable projects, how are they progressing? When do we break ground for the new library?

title: Warlord
line: Soon.

title: Warlord
line: Good. I want my people to know I have their welfare at heart. Tomorrow we'll send out an edict. Every citizen must have a garden.

title: Warlord
line: A garden?

title: Warlord
line: I love plants, flowers, anything that grows. Some of the times I felt most content were those spent watching the seedlings grow in the airponics

title: Warlord
line: They've made it through our defenses. They're sending down ground forces.

title: Warlord
line: That's impossible! You're lying!

title: Warlord
line: I'm sending additional troops to the defensive positions. Activating full security measures. That ought to hold them off, but we have to go. Now.

title: Warlord
line: Anyone who tries to leave this room will be shot as a traitor.

title: Warlord
line: Look for yourself!

title: Warlord
line: This has to be a trick, a ruse of some kind. That's what they're doing, they're creating a distraction to draw my attention away from their real plan.

title: Warlord
line: Tieran, please, they're coming.

title: Warlord
line: They must have sent an infiltrator. We have an intruder! I know you're here somewhere, Tuvok, you don't realize how perceptive I've become. I know you're here!

title: Warlord
line: Tuvok!

title: Warlord
line: Mister Paris.

title: Warlord
line: No time for a tearful reunion. We've got to get you out of here.

title: Warlord
line: Some day you're going to have to show me how to do that.

title: Warlord
line: Don't give in. Stay with me. Tieran!

title: Warlord
line: Still here.

title: Warlord
line: Fight it. You must fight it, Tieran. Please, keep fighting.

title: Warlord
line: Do you have the device ready? Now!

title: Warlord
line: They're getting away.

title: Warlord
line: I'll cover you.

title: Warlord
line: We've got to get out, find a doctor and get you stabilized or transferred to a new host. You will survive.

title: Warlord
line: Kes! Stop! Please, stay there. Just let me get to you and this will all be over.

title: Warlord
line: Tieran!

title: Warlord
line: Tieran?

title: Warlord
line: He's gone.

title: Warlord
line: No, he isn't. He's still here. He moved onto someone else before you used this. He wanted you to think he'd been destroyed, but he's hiding in a new host. I know you too well, Tieran.

title: Warlord
line: No! You can't do this!

title: Warlord
line: You died a long time ago. Now it's time to let go.

title: Warlord
line: Demmas, it's over.

title: Warlord
line: Your thoughts are a turbulent ocean. Visualize yourself floating above them.

title: Warlord
line: I can't. I've been using all the meditations you've taught me, but they're not helping.

title: Warlord
line: You must be patient, and allow yourself sufficient time. Don't attempt to deny the emotional impact of your experience.

title: Warlord
line: How can I worry about my own well-being when so many people have suffered and died?

title: Warlord
line: You were not responsible for Tieran's actions.

title: Warlord
line: I can't help wondering whether I could have fought harder.

title: Warlord
line: It was your absolute refusal to surrender which defeated him. You cannot ask more of yourself than that.

title: Warlord
line: Everything seems so different now. My thoughts and perceptions, even my relationships with my closest friends. You, the Doctor, Neelix. How can I go back to my normal life as if nothing ever happened?

title: Warlord
line: You cannot. This experience will force you to adapt. You are no longer the same person, and the course of your life will change as a result. Where that new course leads is up to you.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh!

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Incredible.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Absolutely thrilling.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: All I can say is, wow! What about you, Mister Vulcan? Isn't that just, wow!

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Your inarticulate expression of awe notwithstanding, Mister Neelix, it was a fascinating spectacle.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: That's the edge of the shock wave. The pressure's over ninety kilopascals, thirty percent more than we predicted.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Tom, back us off at full impulse. I want to stay ahead of the brunt of that wave.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Yes, ma'am.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Congratulations, everyone. Only two other crews in the history of Starfleet have witnessed a supernova explosion.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: But neither one was this close. Less than ten billion kilometers. Definitely a record.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Who brought the champagne?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Champagne? Captain, if I thought you wanted champagne.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Relax, Neelix. It's a figure of speech.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Thanks for inviting us to watch with you, Captain. It's really got me interested in learning more about stellar phenomenon.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Just remember, Kes, anyone can stargaze on the Bridge, even a hologram with a mobile emitter, but the real action will always be in sickbay.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: How'd those shield modifications hold up, B'Elanna?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Less than a seven percent power drain.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Good job. Chakotay, what do you say we get started analyzing those carbon conversion readings?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Captain, you've been on the Bridge for fourteen straight hours. Don't you think you deserve a little rest? Harry and I will get to work on the astrometric analysis, and we'll give you a full report in the morning.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You win. I'll see you at oh seven hundred.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Janeway to security. Intruder alert.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: There's no need to call room service, Kathy. I've already ordered.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh, Q.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You did say you wanted champagne?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Janeway to security. Intruder alert.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh, it's no use. I've taken the proverbial phone off the hook. After all, we don't want any interruptions.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: What are you doing here?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: To us.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: There is no us, Q.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: The night is young, and the sheets are satin.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I want you out. But first, get rid of this bed.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I have no intention of getting between those Starfleet issue sheets. They give me a terrible rash.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Since you won't be getting in the bed, I wouldn't worry about it.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh, Kathy, don't be such a prude. Admit it. It has been a while.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: And it's going to be a while longer. Now get out.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: So tense. Why don't you slip into something more comfortable?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: If you think this puerile attempt at seduction is going to work, you're even more self-deluded than I thought.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Now I see. You think I'm interested in some tawdry one night stand. That's because I haven't told you why I'm here yet. Out of all the females of all the species in all the galaxies, I have chosen you to be the mother of my child.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh!

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I know that you're probably asking yourself, why would a brilliant, handsome, dashingly omnipotent being like Q want to mate with a scrawny little bipedal specimen like me?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Let me guess. No one else in the universe will have you.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Nonsense. I could have chosen a Klingon Targ, the Romulan empress, a Cyrillian microbe.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Really? I beat out a single-celled organism? How flattering.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: It's an overwhelming honor, isn't it? I can't get you out of my mind. You're confident, passionate, beautiful.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: And totally uninterested.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Kathy, you can't leave. My cosmic clock is ticking. Besides, you have no idea what you're missing. Foreplay with a Q can last for decades.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Sorry, but I'm busy for the next sixty or seventy years.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh, I see, this is one of those silly human rituals. You're playing hard to get.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: As far as you're concerned, Q, I'm impossible to get.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Goody! A challenge. This is going to be fun.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Janeway to bridge.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Chakotay here, Captain.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I thought you were going to get some sleep.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I've just had a visit from Q. He's gone now.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: But I want to be notified immediately if he reappears anywhere on the ship or if anything odd starts to happen.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Acknowledged. What did he want?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Let's just say he had a personal request.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Captain?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'm not sure what he's really up to, but I have a feeling he'll be back. Janeway out.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Come in.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I've got those carbon conversion readings from the supernova.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Thank you. Is there something else?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Have you heard anything more from Q?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: No. I wish I could believe he's gone for good.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I was wondering just what just what you meant when you said he made a personal request.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: He wants to mate with me.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I see.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Obviously, it's out of the question. And I suspect it's a smoke screen. Knowing Q, he's probably got some hidden agenda.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Maybe.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Chakotay.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I know I don't have any right to feel this way, but this bothers the hell out of me.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I do believe you're jealous. Why didn't you tell me there was another man?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Because there isn't. I'm just not interested in you.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Any more questions?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I was wondering, Kathy. What could anyone possibly see in this big oaf, anyway? Is it the tattoo? Because mine's bigger.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Not big enough. Captain's log, stardate 50384.2. Q's unannounced visits continue. Since I suspect he's up to something more than pursuing me, I've instructed the crew to take every opportunity to uncover his true motives.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Who says crew performance reports have to be a chore?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Sure beats working on the bridge.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Now if we could just convince the Captain to start holding morning briefings in here.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: That'll be the day.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Nice program, Tommy. But it's all just so much holo-pleasure, isn't it?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: All right, Q, we'll bite. What do you want?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Guys, I just don't understand your Captain. I've tried everything. Filling the Bridge with roses, writing Drabian love sonnets, serenading her in her bath.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh, I'll bet she loved that one.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: But no matter what lengths I go to win her heart, she rejects me. Me! How, I ask you, is that possible?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Did it ever occur to you that she just doesn't like you?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: No.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Look, Q, we've been told about your appearances on the Enterprise. We know your little visits usually turn out to be more than meet the eye. So save your broken heart routine, and tell us what you're really after.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I just thought that the two of you might be able to give me some advice on how to break through Kathy's icy exterior. You know, man to man.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: My advice would be to give up before you embarrass yourself anymore than you already have. Come on, Harry. We're not going to get a straight answer out of this guy.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You, bar rodent, another one of these fruity concoctions.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Not unless you tell me why you're bothering Captain Janeway.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Captain Janeway? Now that's a subject I want to discuss. Tell me, what are some of her favorite things. Chocolate truffles? Stuffed animals? Erotic art?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You can't bribe Captain Janeway.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh, no? Isn't that what you do?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: What are you talking about?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I understand that you acquire things for her, create little interesting diversions, prepare little tasty treats. After all, why else would she be so fond of your fur-lined face?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Do you want to know what Captain Janeway likes about me? I'll tell you. I am respectful, loyal and most of all, sincere. And those are qualities which someone like you could never hope to possess.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: This isn't going to work, Q.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: How can you ignore that face?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: He's adorable. But this has to stop.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Please, accept him as a small token of my affection.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: No.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Suit yourself. May we talk? Just talk.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'm afraid that I haven't been sincere. When you first asked why I wanted to have a child with you, I made jokes, bragged about my prowess, engaged in sexual innuendo. I was using all that to cover up my true feelings.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: And I suppose you want to share your true feelings with me now.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'm lonely.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Lonely?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh, I know it's hard to believe, but I've been single for billions of years. It was fun at first, gallivanting around the galaxy, using my omnipotence to impress females of every species. The fact of the matter is, it left me empty. I want someone to love me for myself. I guess what I'm saying is, I want a relationship. I just thought if you and I had a child, it would give me that kind of stability and security that I've been missing.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Sorry, Q. I'm not buying it.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh. All right. Let's see if you buy this. You're stuck out here, thousands of light years from home, and you aren't getting any younger, are you? All your hopes for home, hearth and family grow dimmer every day. Admit it, Kathryn, you're lonely too. And you wonder if you will ever have a child.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You're right. I would like to have a child someday. But not with you.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Why not?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'm just not the right kind of woman for you, Q.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Truer words were never spoken.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Q! How did you find me?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Never mind that. What are you doing with that dog? I'm not talking about the puppy.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Can't you see I'm busy here? Stop stalking me.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You should be back in the Continuum.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Excuse me, but who are you exactly?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Kathryn Janeway, may I present Q.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Not just any Q. His Q.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: We were involved for a while.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: About four billion years. And now you desert me to pollute the Continuum with the DNA of this narrow little being.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I never said it was exclusive.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Stay away from him.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Look, Miss Q, I'll save you a lot of trouble. I have zero interest in him.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh! Now you see what you've done? And I was finally making progress.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Bridge to Janeway. You'd better come in here, Captain.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: On my way.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'd really appreciate it if you would take this domestic squabble off my ship.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Report.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You're not going to believe this, Captain, but another star in this cluster just went supernova. It's point oh two light years from our current position.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Make that two supernovas, Commander. I just picked up another one at two one seven mark four seven. Estimated time of implosion, sixty seven seconds.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Get us out of here, Tom.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I can't. A subspace shock wave from the star is collapsing the warp field.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Red alert. Tuvok, increase power to the shields. Tom, lay in a course away from that shock wave, maximum impulse.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: A star going supernova is an event that occurs once every century in this galaxy. Now we're about to witness our third in less than three days, all in the same sector. Why do I suspect you have something to do with this?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: She maybe a member of an intellectually challenged species, but she's right. Your irresponsible behavior is continuing to have cosmic consequences.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Will you stop overreacting? Always nagging. Now you see why I left her.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Are you causing these supernovas?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Well, not exactly.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: What's that supposed to mean?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: It's no use, Captain. the shock wave is too fast for us.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Try evasive maneuvers.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'm afraid a course correction will be futile, Captain. There are now three distinct shock waves heading toward us on various trajectories. It will be impossible to avoid them all.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Divert auxiliary power to the shields. You have the ability to get us out of here, so do it.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Sixteen seconds to impact. I'm not sure if the shields will hold.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Do something, Q.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Well, if you insist.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: That two-timing toad!

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Contact with the first shock wave within three seconds, Commander.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: All hands, brace for impact.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Q? Where have you taken me?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Well, I must admit, your gown is very becoming.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I don't have time for your little fantasies. Return me to Voyager.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: This is no fantasy. You're in the Q Continuum.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: The Continuum?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: That's right. I'm simply allowing you to perceive it in the context your human mind can comprehend.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: The last time you brought me here, it looked like some sort of way station on a desert road.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: It was awfully drab, wasn't it? But this, this is a much more colorful representation for a human of American descent, don't you think? An elegant manor house, a beautiful Southern belle, a dashing Union officer determined to win her affections despite her hatred for Yankee interlopers.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Enough. The only thing that interests me right now is the welfare of my ship and crew.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Well, I'm sure your first officer, Chuckles, is it? I'm sure he's got everything under control for the moment.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'd like to make sure of that myself, if you don't mind.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: This has gone way beyond your ship. It's even gone beyond you and me. This is about the future of the Continuum itself.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Stop speaking in riddles, and tell me what's going on.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'll do better than that. I'll show you.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: The Continuum is burning. The Q are in the middle of a civil war.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Start explaining.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Do you remember our friend, Quinn?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: The Q who committed suicide aboard Voyager?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Do you recall what I said might happen if he were allowed to take his own life?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You said it would represent an interruption to the Continuum. That it could have dire consequences.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'd say a civil war is pretty dire, wouldn't you?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: His death caused this conflict?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: It caused chaos and upheaval. Because even though he was gone, his calls for freedom and individualism continued to echo in the ears of those who believed in his teachings, myself among them. I sounded the trumpet and carried the banner. Naturally, others followed. The forces of the status quo tried to crush us once and for all, but we fought back. And now there's a cosmic struggle for supremacy, and the battle is spreading, causing hazardous repercussions throughout the galaxy.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh! The supernovas.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You might call them galactic cross fire. It's terrible, isn't it? But it's also a wonderful opportunity.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I fail to see anything wonderful about a war.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: War can be an engine of change. War can transform a society for the better. Your own Civil War brought about an end to slavery and oppression.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: But our Civil War came at a time before mankind had learned to resolve disputes without bloodshed. Surely the Q have evolved to a point where you can find a non-violent way to resolve a conflict.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: That's where you come in.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: What do I have to do with any of this, Q?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I want you to help me transform the Continuum in the same way your Civil War transformed a nation.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: By mating with you?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I know. It's brilliant, isn't it?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I don't see how a baby is going to end a war being fought by a race of omnipotent beings.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: It's simple. Mating will create a new breed of Q, which will combine my omnipotence and infinite intellect with the best that humanity has to offer.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You believe human DNA is going to restore peace?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Precisely. What the Continuum needs right now is an infusion of fresh blood, a new sensibility, a new leader, a new messiah. Think of it, Kathy. Our child will be like a precious stone tossed into the cosmic lake, sending endless ripples of human conscience and compassion to wash up on every distant shore of the universe. What greater contribution could a being of your limited power ever hope to make? What is more important to humanity than peace? I'm offering you the opportunity to be the mother of peace.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Well, what's it going to be? Oh!

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Q! You're bleeding.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Report.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Shield strength is at twenty percent. Hull damage on decks nine through fourteen. Minor injuries reported on all decks.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Warp drive is offline.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Commander, according to these readings, the shock waves have knocked us sixteen billion kilometers from our previous location.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I want to know what's going on here. Where's Captain Janeway?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Let me go before I hurl this ship and everyone on it into the Therinian Ice Age.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I don't think you can.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Don't be ridiculous.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I don't know how or why, but something's affected your powers. Otherwise, you wouldn't still be here and you wouldn't have a bruise on your forehead. Now start talking before I hurl you into the brig.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: And it's the war in the Continuum that's causing the supernovas?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: May we presume that this conflict is also responsible for the weakening of your powers and your inability to return to the Continuum?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: The Vulcan talent for stating the obvious never ceases to amaze me.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: How were Q and Captain Janeway able to re-enter the Continuum and you weren't?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I tried to return, but I was wounded in the process. Oh, don't try to understand it, it's far beyond your limited capacity to comprehend. What's important is, I'm stuck here with you mortals while Q is probably in the process of irreparably harming the Continuum with that woman. Tossed aside for someone five billion years younger. If it weren't so laughable, I'd cry.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Look, we want our Captain back, and you obviously want to get home. Why don't we help each other?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: How could you possibly help me?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: There's got to be some way to get back to the Continuum besides snapping your fingers.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Hmm. Well, there's one possibility. But somehow, I don't think this rickety barge or your half-witted crew members are up to the challenge.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: May I remind you, madam, that this rickety barge and its half-witted crew are your only hope at the moment.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Ow! That hurts.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Be still. I never thought a Q could be injured.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: As I said, this is only a perception of what is happening. I can assure you, those are not mere cannonballs and lead charges being fired at us.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: So they're some sort of Q weapons?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You'd be surprised what innovative munitions can be created by one immortal being who's set his mind on killing another.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Hold your fire. Hold your fire! You're surrounded, Q. Surrender now. We'll be merciful.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Call a truce. Talk to them. Maybe you can resolve this peacefully.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: What's your answer, Q?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I'll never surrender! You know that!

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Resume fire. Resume fire!

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Get the rifle in the corner and take the other window.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: This is your fight, Q, not mine.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: If that's how you feel about it. But if their weapons can make me bleed, what do you think they'll do to you?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Q! Come on. Come on. First Officer's log, Stardate 50392.7. While we don't fully understand the astrophysics underlying her plan, the female Q has suggested several modifications which may allow Voyager to enter the Continuum.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Well?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Well what?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Are you finished yet?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: What you've asked us to do requires a complete reconfiguration of the shield array. It takes a while. For us mere morals, that is.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Surely there's some way you can speed up the process?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: If you're in such a hurry, why don't you just snap your fingers and do it yourself? Oh, that's right. You've lost your powers and you need our help.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I don't think you understand. It's imperative that I get back to the Continuum before Q mates with your Captain.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I understand perfectly. You aren't the first female who's ever had a man run out on her.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I hope you're not comparing some failed romance in your pitiful existence to my eternal association with Q.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You know, I have really had it with this superiority complex of yours.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: It's not a complex, dear. It's a fact.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Well, here's another fact. If you don't stop pestering me, I'm never going to finish. In which case, your association with Q might not be quite as eternal as you think.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: you know, I've always liked Klingon females. You've got such spunk.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Where are we?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: One of your faction's encampments.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: How?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I pulled you out of the mansion and managed to hide you from the enemy patrols. Then I spotted some of your people retreating from the battle. From the look of them, I'd say you're not on the winning side.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: You saved my life.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: And now it's time to end all this.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I knew you'd come around.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: I've been thinking about what you said, that creating a new Q could bring an era of peace.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh, my wild, sweet Kathy. I promise you won't regret it.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Oh, you're not going to have a child with me. You're going to mate with that charming lady friend of yours that appeared on my ship.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Mate with another Q? Ridiculous.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: It sounded to me like you and she had a very long term relationship.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Yes, but it was never physical. I mean, the Q are way beyond sex. It's never been done.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Really? Then how exactly did the Q come into existence in the first place?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: The Q didn't come into existence. The Q have always existed. Besides, I can only mate with a species capable of copulation, like you.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: But I don't love you, Q.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Yes, but what does that have to do with it?

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Everything. It's the foundation of a family. I could never have a child with someone I didn't love, much less give it up to the Continuum.

title: The Q and the Gray
line: Dearest Kathy, I would never dream of having you give it up. I mean, who would raise it? Who would look after it? I'm really not cut out to be a wet nurse.

title: The Q and the Gray
