title: Rise
line: Neelix!

title: Rise
line: Where's Tuvok?

title: Rise
line: Mister Tuvok returned to the surface. Get this carriage moving.

title: Rise
line: What are you doing!

title: Rise
line: Now!

title: Rise
line: He can't. He's hurt.

title: Rise
line: Back away. Get up. Get up! oh. We're going to have to figure out how to fly this vessel.

title: Rise
line: Captain, the asteroid is within visual range.

title: Rise
line: Let's see it.

title: Rise
line: Ensign?

title: Rise
line: There's a large crew compliment. At least two thousand.

title: Rise
line: They remodulated their shields to fool our sensors. We're being hailed.

title: Rise
line: On screen.

title: Rise
line: The Etanian Order claims this territory. You will withdraw.

title: Rise
line: This planet belongs to the Nezu. They have five colonies here.

title: Rise
line: You are not Nezu.

title: Rise
line: I'm a friend of theirs. Kathryn Janeway. And I'm not going anywhere until you've lowered your weapons.

title: Rise
line: You would be willing to die for them? A loyal friend, and a foolish one.

title: Rise
line: They'll be here in under ten minutes, Captain.

title: Rise
line: Battle stations.

title: Rise
line: Why haven't we started?

title: Rise
line: If we don't get moving soon the tether couplings will give out and they'll snap. We'll lose mag-lev cohesion.

title: Rise
line: Then get us moving.

title: Rise
line: I can't. I don't know how.

title: Rise
line: There's the accelerator control. Try it.

title: Rise
line: It's too dangerous. We've got to secure the tether first.

title: Rise
line: Right, you. Go outside and check the couplings. Make sure they haven't been damaged.

title: Rise
line: Not me. Besides I wouldn't know where to look.

title: Rise
line: The only person who knows how to pilot this ship is Neelix.

title: Rise
line: It can't be that complicated. Keep trying.

title: Rise
line: I'm doing my best.

title: Rise
line: Come on, come on.

title: Rise
line: I'm glad you're all right.

title: Rise
line: Fortunately I was able to grab hold of an induction coil and climb to safety. Thank you, Mister Neelix.

title: Rise
line: What?

title: Rise
line: I said thank you, for opening the door.

title: Rise
line: Don't mention it.

title: Rise
line: I believe we know now who killed Doctor Vatm.

title: Rise
line: But why did he kill him?

title: Rise
line: The data storage device contains tactical information about an alien starship. Weapons, warp drive, shield modulations. Apparently Sklar did not want us to find it. You have an occipital concussion. I'm afraid my understanding of Talaxian physiology is limited. I cannot treat you.

title: Rise
line: I don't know how to do this. We're going to lose cohesion any minute know.

title: Rise
line: Neelix, we need you.

title: Rise
line: I don't think I can do it.

title: Rise
line: You must.

title: Rise
line: I can barely keep my eyes open.

title: Rise
line: Do it for Alixia. She would be proud of you.

title: Rise
line: I'm glad to see your interpersonal skills are improving. You're learning how to motivate people.

title: Rise
line: Speed, forty five kilometers per hour.

title: Rise
line: The ship is within range. They're charging weapons.

title: Rise
line: Full power to the shields. Ready phasers.

title: Rise
line: Shields down to eighty five percent.

title: Rise
line: Return fire.

title: Rise
line: No effect. We can't penetrate their shields.

title: Rise
line: Hang on! We're breaking through the ionosphere. Engaging induction dampers. We did it. We made it!

title: Rise
line: Tuvok to Voyager.

title: Rise
line: Janeway here. Are you all right, Lieutenant?

title: Rise
line: Yes, Captain.

title: Rise
line: We're a little busy right now. Prepare to beam aboard.

title: Rise
line: Shields down to twenty three percent. Structural integrity is failing.

title: Rise
line: Captain, this data device contains tactical information about the enemy vessel, including their shield modulation.

title: Rise
line: Adjust our phasers to match. Target their primary reactor.

title: Rise
line: Ready.

title: Rise
line: Fire at will.

title: Rise
line: Direct hit. Their reactor is offline.

title: Rise
line: They're remodulating their shields.

title: Rise
line: Target their weapons array. Fire!

title: Rise
line: Their weapons have been destroyed.

title: Rise
line: They're retreating, Captain.

title: Rise
line: What happened to you down there? Where's Sklar?

title: Rise
line: Mister Sklar returned to the surface.

title: Rise
line: I've just come from a staff briefing. The people who attacked your colonies, they call themselves the Etanian Order. Apparently they have a unique way of invading other worlds. First they create what appears to be a natural disaster, in your case an asteroid bombardment. Once the population has evacuated, they arrive and stake their claim.

title: Rise
line: But they didn't expect Voyager to intervene, so they arrived before our colonies had been evacuated

title: Rise
line: Exactly.

title: Rise
line: What about Doctor Vatm?

title: Rise
line: From what we could tell, Doctor Vatm found out about the Etanian Order and was secretly collecting information about their starship technology. He also knew that one of your colonists was a traitor, helping the Etanians, feeding your government false information about the asteroids. But he didn't know that it was Sklar. He didn't know who to trust.

title: Rise
line: So that's why he tried to hide the data storage device on the roof. The damage to our world could have been much worse. Thank you.

title: Rise
line: I have just received word from the Ambassador. Your sister Halla has been found.

title: Rise
line: Tell her I said hello.

title: Rise
line: Mister Neelix, I thought you should know that I have submitted my mission report to the Captain. I've given you a special commendation for your endurance and bravery.

title: Rise
line: I'm honored.

title: Rise
line: Your instincts were correct. However, one day your intuition will fail, and you will finally understand that logic is primary above all else. Instinct is simply another term for serendipity.

title: Rise
line: And one day, Mister Vulcan, I'll get you to trust your gut.

title: Rise
line: That is doubtful.

title: Rise
line: We'll see.

title: Rise
line: Your attempts have yet to succeed.

title: Rise
line: You always have to get in that last word, don't you.

title: Rise
line: I'm simply responding to your erroneous statement.

title: Rise
line: Something tells me you just hate to lose an argument.

title: Rise
line: Losing is irrelevant.

title: Rise
line: See what I mean?

title: Rise
line: No, I do not.

title: Favorite Son
line: Let's mark the coordinates of that trinary star. It'll be a good reference point for this sector.

title: Favorite Son
line: Didn't we already pass a trinary system like this?

title: Favorite Son
line: Not that I remember. Why?

title: Favorite Son
line: It just seems familiar.

title: Favorite Son
line: Perhaps you're experiencing a paradoxical state-dependant associated phenomenon.

title: Favorite Son
line: Deja-vu.

title: Favorite Son
line: Yeah, I guess so.

title: Favorite Son
line: Captain, there is a ship approaching, bearing two one five mark eight.

title: Favorite Son
line: On screen.

title: Favorite Son
line: Their shields are down and their weapon systems are unpowered.

title: Favorite Son
line: They're hailing us.

title: Favorite Son
line: My respects to you. I'm Alben, Captain of the Narada.

title: Favorite Son
line: Captain Kathryn Janeway of the Federation starship Voyager.

title: Favorite Son
line: I thought I was familiar with every type of ship in this sector, but I've never seen anything like yours before.

title: Favorite Son
line: We're not from around here.

title: Favorite Son
line: In that case, let me welcome you to Nasari territory.

title: Favorite Son
line: That ship's going to fire!

title: Favorite Son
line: What?

title: Favorite Son
line: Captain, we've got to defend ourselves.

title: Favorite Son
line: I am detecting no threat. Tactical control has been moved to the Ops station. Our weapons systems are charging.

title: Favorite Son
line: Raising shields and firing phasers.

title: Favorite Son
line: Direct hit. They are returning fire.

title: Favorite Son
line: Red alert!

title: Favorite Son
line: Hail them. We've got to put a stop to this.

title: Favorite Son
line: Captain, I had to act quickly.

title: Favorite Son
line: You will explain yourself, Mister Kim, but right now you're relieved. Commander, you're at Ops.

title: Favorite Son
line: They are not responding to hails.

title: Favorite Son
line: There's pressure building up in plasma conduit G six. Ashmore, open up the emergency vent. I'll try to reroute the plasma flow.

title: Favorite Son
line: Shields are down to seventy percent.

title: Favorite Son
line: Get us out of here.

title: Favorite Son
line: Warp engines are down.

title: Favorite Son
line: They are in pursuit.

title: Favorite Son
line: Bridge to Engineering, what's the status of the warp drive?

title: Favorite Son
line: The plasma injectors are offline, Captain. We're working on them now.

title: Favorite Son
line: A plasma conduit just blew in Engineering. Propulsion systems are down. They're reporting casualties.

title: Favorite Son
line: Target their weapons array and fire.

title: Favorite Son
line: They've suffered damage to their weapon systems and shield emitters. They are moving away.

title: Favorite Son
line: I want to know exactly what you thought you were doing.

title: Favorite Son
line: Their weapons were charging. They were about to fire at us. We could have been destroyed.

title: Favorite Son
line: Sensor logs indicate that their weapon systems were not powered.

title: Favorite Son
line: Then they must have fooled our sensors somehow. I detected a tetryon surge coming from their ship.

title: Favorite Son
line: There are many sources of increased tetryon emissions. It may have been an irregularity in their warp field.

title: Favorite Son
line: No! It was their weapons. That whole welcome to Nasari territory was a trick.

title: Favorite Son
line: How could you know that?

title: Favorite Son
line: I can't explain that. I just knew. I was only trying to protect the ship.

title: Favorite Son
line: I trust your intentions, Ensign, but your actions are going to need a little more justification. I want you to analyze the sensor logs, and see if there's any basis for Mister Kim's hunch.

title: Favorite Son
line: Aye, Captain.

title: Favorite Son
line: In the meantime I'm suspending you from duty. Go to Sickbay. Let the Doctor have a look at that cut.

title: Favorite Son
line: Still no respiration. Her blood pressure's ninety over forty and dropping.

title: Favorite Son
line: She has second degree burns on her lungs. I'll need to do a pulmonary regeneration.

title: Favorite Son
line: Her neural tissues are starting to degenerate.

title: Favorite Son
line: Oxygen deprivation. We've got to get her breathing. Try ten milligrams pulmazine.

title: Favorite Son
line: No effect.

title: Favorite Son
line: Twenty milligrams.

title: Favorite Son
line: Is she going to be all right?

title: Favorite Son
line: Yes. Another patient snatched from the jaws of death.

title: Favorite Son
line: Let me take care of that.

title: Favorite Son
line: B'Elanna almost got killed. It's my fault.

title: Favorite Son
line: What do you mean?

title: Favorite Son
line: I started that fight. I thought I was doing the right thing. For a moment I was absolutely sure.

title: Favorite Son
line: And now you're not?

title: Favorite Son
line: It's fading. What I did, and how I felt. It doesn't make any sense. And it could have been worse. What if they'd been more powerful than we were? I could have gotten everyone killed.

title: Favorite Son
line: But none of that happened. B'Elanna got hurt, but she'll recover. Harry, you can't undo what's been done.

title: Favorite Son
line: You're right. Thanks.

title: Favorite Son
line: Raising shields and firing phasers. I can't explain it. I just knew. I never wanted you to get hurt.

title: Favorite Son
line: That's supposed to make me feel better?

title: Favorite Son
line: I'm sorry.

title: Favorite Son
line: Harry, I'm here. Don't worry, you'll feel better soon. I can make some soup for you, would you like that? I won't go away anywhere as long as you need me. We raised you to be a responsible boy.

title: Favorite Son
line: I try to be.

title: Favorite Son
line: I'm suspending you from duty.

title: Favorite Son
line: Mom!

title: Favorite Son
line: Well, the good news is I won't have to quarantine you. There's no sign of an infectious agent anywhere in your body.

title: Favorite Son
line: And the bad news?

title: Favorite Son
line: If I don't find the cause of this rash, it will be difficult to treat.

title: Favorite Son
line: Last night I had a dream about being sick with the Mendakan pox when I was nine. Do you think this could be a recurrence?

title: Favorite Son
line: I've never considered dreams as a diagnostic tool before. Your unconscious mind sensed these developing symptoms and tried to provide an explanation? Such recurrences of this particular illness are rare, but I will consider the possibility. Hmm.

title: Favorite Son
line: What?

title: Favorite Son
line: In addition to your visible symptoms, your blood chemistry has been slightly altered.

title: Favorite Son
line: Is that serious?

title: Favorite Son
line: No, but it's not consistent with the symptoms of the Mendakan pox.

title: Favorite Son
line: Doctor, you don't think there could be any psychological effects from this disease, do you?

title: Favorite Son
line: Such as?

title: Favorite Son
line: I've been having this strange deja-vu feeling. Then yesterday on the Bridge I had this sudden instinct, and I acted on it by firing without orders.

title: Favorite Son
line: I'd certainly call that atypical behavior. Your scans haven't shown any neurological abnormalities, but I will run a closer analysis.

title: Favorite Son
line: Doctor, she's regaining consciousness.

title: Favorite Son
line: Good morning, Lieutenant.

title: Favorite Son
line: Morning? What am I doing here?

title: Favorite Son
line: There was an accident in Engineering. A plasma conduit exploded.

title: Favorite Son
line: I've treated you for second and third degree burns and several broken ribs. I expect you'll make a full recovery

title: Favorite Son
line: Ow!

title: Favorite Son
line: after you've spent at least one more day in Sickbay.

title: Favorite Son
line: This time Doctor, I'm not going to argue with you. Harry, what happened to your face?

title: Favorite Son
line: We're still trying to figure that out.

title: Favorite Son
line: It's kind of cute. Makes you look like a speckled targ.

title: Favorite Son
line: B'Elanna, I'm really sorry you got hurt.

title: Favorite Son
line: Hey, it's all part of the adventure of space travel, right?

title: Favorite Son
line: I know, but, er

title: Favorite Son
line: What. What is it?

title: Favorite Son
line: Never mind. I'm glad you're going to be all right.

title: Favorite Son
line: Thanks.

title: Favorite Son
line: I'm afraid I'm going to have to cut visiting hour short. Ensign, you can go. I'll contact you with the results of my analysis.

title: Favorite Son
line: Take care of yourself.

title: Favorite Son
line: See you later, Spot.

title: Favorite Son
line: Captain, I accept full responsibility for my mistake. I was completely out of line, even if I believed that other ship was charging weapons, which they probably weren't.

title: Favorite Son
line: Harry, they were charging weapons.

title: Favorite Son
line: I was right.

title: Favorite Son
line: Tuvok has confirmed that the tetryon surge matched the energy signature of that particulate beam they shot at us. They would have taken us completely by surprise.

title: Favorite Son
line: As soon as I saw their ship, I felt this sudden suspicion and loathing. I knew we were in trouble.

title: Favorite Son
line: Which brings us back to the larger question.

title: Favorite Son
line: How did I know? I really wish I could tell you, Captain, but for the past few days this area of space has seemed more and more familiar to me. If I didn't know it was impossible, I'd swear I've been here before.

title: Favorite Son
line: We'll have to consider every possible explanation.

title: Favorite Son
line: Oh, believe me, I have been. Space-time anomalies, alien telepathy, alternate realities. The list gets weirder as it goes on.

title: Favorite Son
line: Then there's your sudden illness, which may not be a coincidence.

title: Favorite Son
line: Tuvok to Janeway. There are three ships approaching of the same configuration as the Nasari vessel.

title: Favorite Son
line: On my way.

title: Favorite Son
line: They'll intercept in thirty six minutes.

title: Favorite Son
line: Can we outrun them?

title: Favorite Son
line: I doubt it. Engineering's still working on repairs. We could manage warp three at best.

title: Favorite Son
line: Let me see a star chart of this region. Head for this system. I think we can make it.

title: Favorite Son
line: Is this another hunch, Ensign?

title: Favorite Son
line: We'll be safe there, I'm sure of it.

title: Favorite Son
line: Tactical status.

title: Favorite Son
line: The aft shield emitter is offline, phasers are operational, but torpedo launchers are not. I strongly advise against a confrontation.

title: Favorite Son
line: Follow Harry's course. Speed, as fast as we can go.

title: Favorite Son
line: The Nasari vessels will overtake us in two minutes.

title: Favorite Son
line: We're coming up on that star system. We'll pass it if we stay at warp.

title: Favorite Son
line: Slow to impulse. We're making our stand here.

title: Favorite Son
line: They'll enter weapons range in a few seconds.

title: Favorite Son
line: Taresia.

title: Favorite Son
line: What does that mean? Do you know this place?

title: Favorite Son
line: Yes. It was in my dream.

title: Favorite Son
line: There is another ship approaching from the third planet.

title: Favorite Son
line: Is it Nasari?

title: Favorite Son
line: No, but they're on an intercept course and their weapons are fully powered.

title: Favorite Son
line: Prepare for evasive maneuvers.

title: Favorite Son
line: Aye, Captain.

title: Favorite Son
line: We'll be all right.

title: Favorite Son
line: The unidentified vessel has disabled all the Nasari ships. They are retreating.

title: Favorite Son
line: What's your next trick, Harry. Pull a shuttlecraft out of a hat?

title: Favorite Son
line: Open a channel to that ship.

title: Favorite Son
line: They're already hailing us.

title: Favorite Son
line: Alien vessel, this is the Taresian starship. There you are! Our sensors detected you aboard your ship. I'm glad to see you're safe.

title: Favorite Son
line: Do you know me?

title: Favorite Son
line: In a way. I know you are one of my people.

title: Favorite Son
line: What?

title: Favorite Son
line: You're Taresian. Welcome home.

title: Favorite Son
line: Captain's log 50732.4. The Taresians have escorted us back to their homeworld so we can continue to investigate their claim that Ensign Kim is a member of their race.

title: Favorite Son
line: Welcome. We're so glad to have you here. This is a day of celebration. Another Taresian has returned.

title: Favorite Son
line: Welcome.

title: Favorite Son
line: You're home now, Harry.

title: Favorite Son
line: Er, wait a minute. I still don't understand how this is possible.

title: Favorite Son
line: We'd like to ask some questions before we start celebrating.

title: Favorite Son
line: Of course.

title: Favorite Son
line: Our Doctor has found some genetic fragments in my DNA which could be part of an alien genetic structure.

title: Favorite Son
line: Yes, those are part of your Taresian genes. They're becoming active. We'd be happy to provide your Doctor with some DNA samples for comparison.

title: Favorite Son
line: What I want to know is how I could have gotten them.

title: Favorite Son
line: You were conceived here, on this world. While you were still an embryo, you were placed in stasis and taken to Earth to be implanted in the womb of an Earth woman.

title: Favorite Son
line: My mother. What did you do to her?

title: Favorite Son
line: She would have been completely unaware of the procedure. After the implantation process, the child begins to incorporate some DNA from the surrogate parent. You developed physically as a human, so she would have thought you were her natural child.

title: Favorite Son
line: But you're saying I'm not.

title: Favorite Son
line: We understand how you feel. Everyone here was born on other worlds. We all found our way back home like you, and discovered we're not quite who we thought we were.

title: Favorite Son
line: Harry, maybe you'd like to sit down.

title: Favorite Son
line: Why don't you go get him something to drink?

title: Favorite Son
line: All of your children are born to alien parents?

title: Favorite Son
line: Yes, and when they return, each child brings an infusion of new genetic material as well as of first hand experience about another culture.

title: Favorite Son
line: But Harry wasn't trying to return here. We came to the Delta Quadrant by accident.

title: Favorite Son
line: His DNA was encoded with certain instincts, including the desire to explore space. Your accident may have brought him here faster, but he always would have been driven to find his way back. You are the first to return from such a great distance.

title: Favorite Son
line: Harry.

title: Favorite Son
line: That's how Taresians say thank you, isn't it? But how could I know so much about a place I've never been?

title: Favorite Son
line: It's been encoded into your Taresian genes. As you've gotten closer to home and seen familiar sights, your dormant genetic memory has been reawakened.

title: Favorite Son
line: You'll remember more about us as you spend time here.

title: Favorite Son
line: I know it all seems strange now, but you are one of us, Harry. Can't you feel it?

title: Favorite Son
line: Yes, I can.

title: Favorite Son
line: Then stay with us a while and celebrate. Come, have something to eat.

title: Favorite Son
line: Is this the standard welcome home reception?

title: Favorite Son
line: For males it is. They're very rare. Our population is ninety percent female.

title: Favorite Son
line: Really?

title: Favorite Son
line: I want to thank you again for your help in combating the Nasari. Do you have any idea why they tried to attack us?

title: Favorite Son
line: They probably detected a Taresian aboard your ship as we did. For the Nasari, that's reason enough to destroy you.

title: Favorite Son
line: Are your people at war?

title: Favorite Son
line: We have no interest in fighting with them, but they seem determined to destroy us. Our defense capabilities prevent them from attacking directly, but they do everything in their power to stop our people from returning home.

title: Favorite Son
line: I see. That might explain Mister Kim's instinctively hostile reaction to them.

title: Favorite Son
line: It's a defense mechanism we've programmed into all our children.

title: Favorite Son
line: Are the Nasari likely to attack us again when we leave your space.

title: Favorite Son
line: I think eventually they'll tire of waiting for you to come out. In the meantime, I'd advise you to simply stay here for a while.

title: Favorite Son
line: These are words.

title: Favorite Son
line: Can you read them?

title: Favorite Son
line: Almost.

title: Favorite Son
line: Our written language is very complicated. I can teach it to you if you're interested.

title: Favorite Son
line: Ah, that looks good. What is it?

title: Favorite Son
line: Spiced hatana. I prepared it myself. Harry, try some.

title: Favorite Son
line: I'd like to find out if I have any relatives here. Maybe talk to my biological parents.

title: Favorite Son
line: I'm afraid none of us get the chance to meet our fathers. They're the ones who take the embryos to other worlds. Your father must have left here a very long time ago to make it all the way to the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Favorite Son
line: Ensign, we're transporting back to the ship.

title: Favorite Son
line: I'd like to stay for a while. I still have a lot of questions.

title: Favorite Son
line: Of course, Harry. Contact us when you're ready.

title: Favorite Son
line: We'll see you later.

title: Favorite Son
line: It's a positive match. These genetic fragments within Ensign Kim's DNA are clearly Taresian.

title: Favorite Son
line: Why haven't they shown up in his medical scans before?

title: Favorite Son
line: I went back and checked his scans carefully. These fragments have apparently been disguising themselves as the recessive elements which normally within all DNA, but over the past few days they've become increasingly dominant over his human genes.

title: Favorite Son
line: And they've provided him with new knowledge?

title: Favorite Son
line: Yes, by forming neural connections in his brain. All humanoid babies are born with certain instinctive knowledge. How to recognize the shape of a face, how to hold their breath underwater. It all comes from their genes.

title: Favorite Son
line: The Taresians must have found a way to manipulate genetic material to implant very specific knowledge into their children.

title: Favorite Son
line: It's scientifically plausible, but quite a feat of genetic engineering.

title: Favorite Son
line: So what the Taresians have been telling us appears to be true. Harry is one of their people.

title: Favorite Son
line: And he's becoming more like them every day, both physically and neurologically.

title: Favorite Son
line: I wonder how that's going to influence him when Voyager's ready to leave? Of course, when that might happen is another question entirely. Are the Nasari still out there?

title: Favorite Son
line: All three ships are holding position just outside the Taresian system.

title: Favorite Son
line: Even if we can wait them out, we'd only be postponing another conflict. I'd much rather find a way to convince them we're not their enemies.

title: Favorite Son
line: Apparently the Nasari only consider Ensign Kim their enemy. Perhaps they would be more receptive to diplomacy if he were not aboard.

title: Favorite Son
line: Contact Harry. Let him know we'll be leaving orbit. With any luck, we'll be back in a few hours with this matter resolved.

title: Favorite Son
line: I joined the merchant fleet so I could get into space, because I wanted to explore every quarter of the galaxy.

title: Favorite Son
line: Like me with Starfleet. All my life, that's all I ever wanted to do. Now I guess I know why. Strange to think that some alien DNA fragments have been controlling my life.

title: Favorite Son
line: Not controlling. Influencing, yes. You probably inherited some Taresian traits like a talent for math or music.

title: Favorite Son
line: Yes, I always wondered why I loved music so much when my parents, my human parents, were practically tone deaf.

title: Favorite Son
line: Wait, wait a minute. What is that?

title: Favorite Son
line: Something to make you feel good.

title: Favorite Son
line: It's just a mild mood enhancer. No side effects. You'll like it.

title: Favorite Son
line: I think I'll pass, thanks.

title: Favorite Son
line: This is Malia. She's going to be my first wife.

title: Favorite Son
line: First?

title: Favorite Son
line: Ah ha.

title: Favorite Son
line: And you're already planning on a second?

title: Favorite Son
line: And a third. We'll all be joined with Taymon tonight. What do humans call it when a man and women are joined?

title: Favorite Son
line: It's called marriage, but it's usually one woman with one man.

title: Favorite Son
line: How unusual. I hope you come to our ceremony.

title: Favorite Son
line: I wouldn't miss it.

title: Favorite Son
line: Don't be afraid to indulge yourself, Harry. Everybody here wants you to be happy. You're important to us.

title: Favorite Son
line: That's what my human parents used to say to me. How special I was. They'd been trying to have a baby for years until I came along. They called me their miracle child.

title: Favorite Son
line: They were right.

title: Favorite Son
line: They spoiled me rotten, making sacrifices so they could give me everything I wanted.

line: The Great Forest. The afterlife. I was taught that when I died my ancestors would be there, waiting for me by the Guiding Tree. My sisters, my mother and father, my cousings. title: Mortal Coil

line: No. I was dead for eighteen hours. I should have experienced something, should remember something. It's just a story, a myth. There is no Guiding Tree. No gathering of the ancestors.

title: Mortal Coil

title: Mortal Coil
line: A few days ago we almost lost a member of our family. I don't know about how the rest of you feel, but it scared the hell out of me. Neelix, you still don't know how to make a pizza, but I'm glad you're here.

line: I'm sorry I had to cancel our little chat, but I was needed in the mess hall. I've been so busy the last few days, I've let things slip around here.

title: Waking Moments

line: Has anybody seen this species before? While you were awake, I mean. Seven?

line: One possible explanation is that he's attempting to make telepathic contact.

title: Waking Moments
line: He's doing more than making contact. We've got six crewmembers who can't wake up. For all we know it's some sort of attack.

title: Waking Moments
line: From where? Astrometric scans haven't revealed any ships in this vicinity, or planets capable of sustaining humanoid life.

title: Waking Moments
line: So where do we look?

title: Waking Moments
line: In our dreams. That's the only place any of us have seen him, right? So if we want to communicate with him, find out what he wants, we'll have to do it on his terms.

title: Waking Moments
line: How do you propose we do that?

line: Lucid dreaming.

title: Waking Moments
line: What's that?

title: Waking Moments
line: It's a technique which allows you to take control of your dream.

title: Waking Moments
line: That happened to me once. I dreamt I was falling and suddenly I realized that I was dreaming, and I could fly, land, do whatever I wanted. I was in complete control of the dream.

title: Waking Moments
line: What happened to you by accident is something some people can do by design. I've been able to have a lucid dream by using the same technology I use for a vision quest. I may be able to use it to communicate with this alien.

title: Waking Moments
line: Maybe so, but how do we know you'd be able to wake up again?

title: Waking Moments
line: It's kind of like self-hypnosis. Before I go to sleep, I choose a visual cue, something to let me know I'm dreaming. Earth's moon, say. Once I see it, I can wake myself by tapping the back of my hand three times.

title: Waking Moments
line: Perhaps you are capable of doing this under normal circumstances, but these were hardly conventional dreams we experienced.

title: Waking Moments
line: I don't see any other way of finding out what our friend here is after, or how we can wake up Harry and the others. Besides, we can't stay awake forever.

title: Waking Moments
line: You'll do this in Sickbay, under the Doctor's supervision. The rest of you keep scanning the region. Analyze this ship from stem to stern. Wherever he is, find him.

title: Waking Moments
line: Normally I consider a good night's sleep an important part of any health regimen, but in this case, I can't recommend it.

title: Waking Moments
line: I respect your medical opinion, Doctor, but at this point we're out of options.

title: Waking Moments
line: This will regulate your hypothalamus, but in all probability I won't be able to wake you. You'll be on your own.

title: Waking Moments
line: I understand.

title: Waking Moments
line: Ready? Pleasant dreams.

title: Waking Moments
line: Ah-koo-chee-moya. Far from the sacred places of my grandfathers, far from the bones of my people, I seek to sleep, to meet the one who has visited us in our dreams.

title: Waking Moments
line: I know this is a dream. My dream. I'm in control.

title: Waking Moments
line: You're mistaken.

title: Waking Moments
line: Am I?

title: Waking Moments
line: This is more than a dream. It's my reality. And you're no different than the others.

title: Waking Moments
line: The others?

title: Waking Moments
line: The waking species. For centuries, you've come and found us in a state that you call sleep and tried to destroy us. But not anymore. Now we are in control. One by one, you will fall asleep and enter our reality, where it is you who will be destroyed.

title: Waking Moments
line: We didn't attack you. We didn't even know you existed until we started seeing you in our dreams. Tell me how I can wake my crew and I promise we'll leave.

title: Waking Moments
line: As long as you're asleep, you're no threat to us.

title: Waking Moments
line: I can wake myself anytime I want. And if I do, I'm going to start looking for you in the waking world. Find where you're sleeping. You wouldn't want that.

title: Waking Moments
line: Leave our space. Once you're beyond it, your people will awaken.

title: Waking Moments
line: Just tell me how far we need to go.

title: Waking Moments
line: There's a six planet system less than a parsec away. It marks the nearest border of our space.

title: Waking Moments
line: We can be past it in one day.

title: Waking Moments

title: Waking Moments
line: Congratulations, Commander. You're awake.

title: Waking Moments

title: Waking Moments
line: I'm fine.

line: The alien, did you see him? And?

title: Waking Moments
line: Well, it was certainly one of the most interesting away missions I've ever been on. I'll tell you about it on the way to the bridge.

title: Waking Moments
line: Tuvok, scan for a six planet system. It should be less than a parsec from here.

title: Waking Moments

title: Waking Moments
line: Past the alien's territory. Once we're clear of it, Harry and the others should wake up.

title: Waking Moments
line: And the rest of us can finally get some sleep.

title: Waking Moments
line: One step at a time, Tom.

title: Waking Moments
line: From what the alien told me it sounds like they have corporeal form but they communicate through their dreams. For them, it's as real as the waking world.

title: Waking Moments
line: Extraordinary.

title: Waking Moments
line: It reminds me of the Australian aborigines. They believed the dream world was no more or less real than the waking world. In fact, their creation mythology says their ancestors actually dreamed the universe into existence.

title: Waking Moments
line: That's mythology. This seems to be fact.

title: Waking Moments
line: I wonder, do they ever wake up? How did they evolve this way?

title: Waking Moments
line: We may never know. Sometimes first contact is last contact.

title: Prey
line: That may not be necessary. Hold your fire. I said, lower your weapon.

title: Prey
line: Mister Neelix, I must ask you to exchange your spatula for a phaser rifle.

title: Prey
line: Sure.

title: Prey
line: We have two intruders on board and six Hirogen vessels on the way. I need additional security personnel.

title: Prey
line: Right away, sir. What's my assignment?

title: Prey
line: Join the security detail on deck ten, section twelve. You'll receive further instructions then. I'll expect tactical updates every twenty minutes.

title: Prey
line: Lieutenant? Are you all right?

title: Prey
line: You have your orders.

title: Prey
line: Report.

title: Prey
line: The Hirogen's back in Sickbay, within a forcefield.

title: Prey
line: And Species 8472?

title: Prey
line: We've established a security perimeter. Basically, we've turned this entire section into a brig.

title: Prey
line: As an added precaution, have B'Elanna start working on a way to lock onto the creature, in case we have to beam it off the ship. You mentioned it was injured. In what way?

title: Prey
line: I wish I could tell you for certain. It's body is generating some sort of bioelectric field making it impossible to scan, so I could only make a visual diagnosis. It's conscious but immobile. Its epidermis displays any number of injuries, punctures, energy burns. And its demeanor is that of a wounded animal.

title: Prey
line: The Hirogen said they've been chasing it for several months. Is there anything you can do?

title: Prey
line: I don't know enough about it's physiognomy to treat it's surface wounds, let alone any internal damage. Frankly, I'm at a loss.

title: Prey
line: Captain, just before we cornered it, Species 8472 accessed Deflector Control from this panel.

title: Prey
line: I've analyzed the transmission protocols. It was attempting to open a singularity into it's realm, but it failed.

title: Prey
line: It was trying to get home.

title: Prey
line: That's what it looks like.

title: Prey
line: Tuvok?

title: Prey
line: The creature initiated telepathic contact with me.

title: Prey
line: What's it saying?

title: Prey
line: It's ship was damaged during the conflict with the Borg. When the other members of its species retreated into fluidic space, it was left behind. It has been trapped in the Delta Quadrant ever since. Alone, pursued by Hirogen hunting parties. It has no desire for further conflict. It only wants to return to its domain. It is dying, Captain.

title: Prey
line: You have nothing to be afraid of. We're going to help you get back to your realm. Does it understand?

title: Prey
line: It does.

title: Prey
line: It will take time to open a singularity and we have no way of treating your injuries, but if there's anything you can tell us about your

title: Prey
line: It has lost consciousness. Our telepathic link has been severed.

title: Prey
line: Where is my prey?

title: Prey
line: Lying at the end of a corridor on deck eleven. Nearly dead, thanks to you.

title: Prey
line: Take me to it.

title: Prey
line: No.

title: Prey
line: Take me to it!

title: Prey
line: In less than three hours, your ships will arrive. By that time, Species 8472 will no longer be on Voyager.

title: Prey
line: What do you mean?

title: Prey
line: I'm sending it back where it came from.

title: Prey
line: Surrender the creature to me and you will not be harmed.

title: Prey
line: This isn't a hunt, it's a slaughter, and I'm calling it off right now.

title: Prey
line: We will not be denied our prey. Give us the creature, or your crew will take its place.

title: Prey
line: Tuvok.

title: Prey
line: Have Seven of Nine report to my ready room.

title: Prey
line: You intend to ask her to open a rift into 8472's realm.

title: Prey
line: She's the only one on board who knows how.

title: Prey
line: Given her feelings towards the species, she may not want to cooperate.

title: Prey
line: We'll see.

title: Prey
line: You wish to see me, Captain?

title: Prey
line: I've made a decision about Species 8472. I'm going to return it to fluidic space. In order to do that, I need you to open a quantum singularity.

title: Prey
line: I don't believe that is a prudent course of action.

title: Prey
line: I realize it may be difficult for you to help save this creature's life, but part of becoming human is learning to have compassion for those who are suffering, even when they're your bitter enemies.

title: Prey
line: Why?

title: Prey
line: I remember when I was a Lieutenant. It was during a Cardassian border conflict. My away team was cut off while we were defending a Federation outpost. We'd been exchanging phaser fire with a group of Cardassians for about three days. A stalemate. One night, during a break in the fighting, we could hear this low moaning sound coming from somewhere in the brush. We knew that none of our people were out there, so it had to be a wounded Cardassian. You have to understand, we'd been killing each other for weeks on this planet. It was brutal. But our commanding officer decided that we couldn't just sit there and listen to that poor man suffer. So he ordered me and an Ensign to crawl out there and bring that Cardassian back to our camp. I thought he was crazy. He was risking our lives for someone who would have shot us without hesitation. But we did it, and the Cardassian lived. Three days later we secured the outpost. It was a major victory. We were all decorated by Starfleet Command. But in retrospect, the thing I'm most proud of was the night we saved that man's life.

title: Prey
line: Explain.

title: Prey
line: A single act of compassion can put you in touch with your own humanity.

title: Prey
line: You are trying to justify your present decision.

title: Prey
line: No, I'm trying to help you see this as an opportunity to grow. I know you don't want to do it, Seven, but I'm telling you as your Captain, and as your friend, you won't regret it.

title: Prey
line: No. Your decision is tactically unsound. We will be surrounded by Hirogen ships in approximately two hours. If we do not surrender the creature, they will destroy us. A lesson in compassion will do me little good if I am dead.

title: Prey
line: It is wrong to sacrifice another being to save our own lives.

title: Prey
line: I have observed that you have been willing to sacrifice your own life to save the lives of your crew.

title: Prey
line: Yes, but that's different. That was my choice. This creature does not have a choice.

title: Prey
line: It invaded our ship, put our lives at risk to save its own. In my view, it has already forfeited its freedom.

title: Prey
line: I'm giving you an order. Report to Deflector Control and begin working on creating a singularity.

title: Prey
line: I will not comply. I have agreed to remain on Voyager. I have agreed to function as a member of your crew. But I will not be a willing participant in my own destruction or the destruction of this ship.

title: Prey
line: Objection noted. We'll do this without you.

title: Prey
line: You will fail.

title: Prey
line: And you have just crossed the line. End of debate. Report to the Cargo Bay and remain there until this is over. Is that understood?

title: Prey
line: Shields down to eighty four percent.

title: Prey
line: Return fire.

title: Prey
line: Three more ships are closing from port and starboard. All escape trajectories have been cut off.

title: Prey
line: Our weapons are having little effect on their hull plating. I'm scanning for weaknesses in the molecular structure.

title: Prey
line: Shields at seventy nine percent.

title: Prey
line: They are hailing us.

title: Prey
line: Better late than never. Open a channel.

title: Prey
line: You've taken our prey and one of our hunters. Surrender them.

title: Prey
line: Call off your attack and we'll return your crewman. As for your prey, it's under our protection now.

title: Prey
line: It belongs to us.

title: Prey
line: It belongs to no one. Now order your ships to withdraw and this can end peacefully.

title: Prey
line: All vessels are firing.

title: Prey
line: Any luck finding a crack in their armor?

title: Prey
line: Not yet.

title: Prey
line: Doctor to bridge. Species 8472 appears to be regenerating. I'm no exobiologist, but I'd say this fellow is becoming highly agitated.

title: Prey
line: It could be sensing the Hirogen attack.

title: Prey
line: Doctor, can you sedate it?

title: Prey
line: I believe so, but I'll need another dose of Borg nanoprobes.

title: Prey
line: Stand by. Bridge to Seven of Nine.

title: Prey
line: Yes.

title: Prey
line: Report to deck eleven immediately with a supply of nanoprobes.

title: Prey
line: Understood.

title: Prey
line: B'Elanna, how's it going down there?

title: Prey
line: Transporters are ready. I can establish a lock on the creature at any time, but I still haven't duplicated the deflector protocols to open a singularity.

title: Prey
line: How long?

title: Prey
line: I need another hour, maybe two.

title: Prey
line: Captain, we can outmaneuver the Hirogen ships for a few more minutes, but beyond that

title: Prey
line: Direct hit to the EPS manifold. Main power just went down.

title: Prey
line: Forcefields on all decks are offline.

title: Prey
line: Switch to auxiliary power.

title: Prey
line: Done. Forcefields have been restored but I don't know how long they'll hold.

title: Prey
line: Bridge to Doctor. Report.

title: Prey
line: It's all right, Captain. The creature is contained.

title: Prey
line: Bridge to Sickbay. Security, respond.

title: Prey
line: Security, dispatch teams to deck five. The Hirogen may be loose.

title: Prey
line: Direct hit to our port nacelle. Now they've taken out our starboard nacelle.

title: Prey
line: They've crippled us. Tuvok, divert warp power to the phaser banks. Maybe that'll help us penetrate their hull plating.

title: Prey
line: The nanoprobes?

title: Prey
line: Armed and ready.

title: Prey
line: Not a moment too soon.

title: Prey
line: Give me the prey.

title: Prey
line: Lower your weapon or I will destroy you.

title: Prey
line: I don't think you will. You want me to destroy this creature. I saw it on your face earlier in the medical bay. It's a look I've seen a thousand times. Stand aside.

title: Prey
line: What are you doing?

title: Prey
line: Captain, someone's accessing the transporter system from deck five.

title: Prey
line: Lock them out.

title: Prey
line: I can't. They're overriding my commands with Borg encryption codes.

title: Prey
line: Report, Mister Kim.

title: Prey
line: 8472 and the Hirogen, they've been beamed to one of the attacking ships.

title: Prey
line: All six vessels are moving away at high warp.

title: Prey
line: Tom, can we pursue?

title: Prey
line: I'm sorry, Captain. Warp engines are still offline.

title: Prey
line: Resume our previous course, full impulse.

title: Prey
line: Seven of Nine.

title: Prey
line: Seven of Nine.

title: Prey
line: Captain's log, stardate 51652.3. It's been twelve hours, and our sensors show no sign of any Hirogen vessels. But their people are scattered throughout this region, and something tells me that the hunt for Voyager is far from over.

title: Prey
line: Captain.

title: Prey
line: Step down, please. Seven, you disobeyed my direct orders, and as a result you condemned a sentient being to its death.

title: Prey
line: By doing so, I also diverted the Hirogen attack. An attack which would have destroyed us.

title: Prey
line: Maybe not. In any case, the decision wasn't yours to make.

title: Prey
line: The creature broke through the forcefield. I had no choice.

title: Prey
line: I didn't come here to debate your decision. I came here to inform you of the consequences. When you first came to Voyager, I decided to grant you the same liberties and freedoms of any crew member, because I wanted you to be a part of this family. And I've been willing to accommodate your unique way of doing things, even when you rubbed somebody the wrong way or violated protocol. But this time, I can't accommodate you. From this point forward, you will no longer have access to any primary systems on this ship. Not without my direct authorisation. If you attempt to circumvent me, I'll throw you in the Brig. I still need your expertise in the Astrometrics lab if you're willing. If not, you can spend your time here in the Cargo Bay. Is that understood?

title: Prey
line: Yes.

title: Prey
line: It is puzzling.

title: Prey
line: What's that?

title: Prey
line: You made me into an individual. You encouraged me to stop thinking like a member of the Collective, to cultivate my independence and my humanity. But when I try to assert that independence I am punished.

title: Prey
line: Individuality has its limits, especially on a starship where there's a command structure.

title: Prey
line: I believe that you are punishing me because I do not think the way you do. Because I am not becoming more like you. You claim to respect my individuality, but in fact you are frightened by it.

title: Prey
line: As you were.

title: Retrospect
line: Direct hit.

title: Retrospect
line: The target buoy is solid monotanium, ten meters thick, shielded by a chromoelectric forcefield.

title: Retrospect
line: Impressive.

title: Retrospect
line: I'm glad you agree. It's not wise to travel this region without adequate defenses. I've seen scuttled ships with more firepower than Voyager.

title: Retrospect
line: I'm sure you have.

title: Retrospect
line: Imagine what you'll be capable of once the isokinetic cannon is integrated into your defensive systems. One projectile can penetrate the shields of any heavily armored vessel. Hostile species will know to avoid Voyager by reputation alone.

title: Retrospect
line: You've made your point, Mister Kovin. I want the cannon, and I'm prepared to give you astrometrics charts spanning twelve sectors. You'll find them unusually precise.

title: Retrospect
line: Even the most sophisticated charts become obsolete. One random anomaly and they're no longer accurate. However, I could be persuaded if you were to include the mapping technology that created them.

title: Retrospect
line: Sorry. Our Astrometrics sensors were designed specifically for this ship. They'd be of no use to you. What I can offer you is a generous supply of isolinear processing chips. We'll even show you how to integrate them into your existing sensor technology.

title: Retrospect
line: How generous a supply?

title: Retrospect
line: One hundred chips.

title: Retrospect
line: One hundred and fifty.

title: Retrospect
line: One fifteen.

title: Retrospect
line: One twenty five.

title: Retrospect
line: Done. Escort our guest to Engineering. You'll be supervising the installation of the cannon?

title: Retrospect
line: Of course. For a modest fee.

title: Retrospect
line: Five additional chips, no more.

title: Retrospect
line: It's good to see the art of negotiation isn't lost on you, Captain.

title: Retrospect
line: That guy is worse than a Ferengi

title: Retrospect
line: Assign Seven of Nine to work on this. She's got a knack for adapting alien technology.

title: Retrospect
line: Should I give her complete access to the engineering control systems?

title: Retrospect
line: I'm ready to give her some latitude. She's been behaving herself lately.

title: Retrospect
line: What are you working on?

title: Retrospect
line: I'm trying to decode the message Starfleet Command sent us several weeks ago.

title: Retrospect
line: Any progress?

title: Retrospect
line: None. I'm working on a new decryption algorithm.

title: Retrospect
line: I'd like you to set it aside for a while. I have another assignment for you.

title: Retrospect
line: What is it?

title: Retrospect
line: The Captain wants you to help Kovin integrate the new weapon system.

title: Retrospect
line: I'd rather not. I find him inefficient.

title: Retrospect
line: Maybe so, but you seem to work well with him. You've been asking for more responsibilities, I thought you'd be pleased.

title: Retrospect
line: The captain gives me greater liberty only when she needs my expertise.

title: Retrospect
line: You violated her trust, and if you want it back, you're going to have to earn it. One step at a time.

title: Retrospect
line: I will report to Engineering.

title: Retrospect
line: You'll need to install isolinear buffer circuits here and here.

title: Retrospect
line: The main power relay should be protected by a containment field.

title: Retrospect
line: Unnecessary. All the buffer circuits would have to fail simultaneously for there to be any danger.

title: Retrospect
line: We prefer to play it safe. I'll check the inventory logs to see if we have a field generator available.

title: Retrospect
line: What are you doing?

title: Retrospect
line: I'm reconfiguring the tactical control systems.

title: Retrospect
line: The isokinetic circuit requires a specialized protocol. Let me take care of it.

title: Retrospect
line: That won't be necessary.

title: Retrospect
line: No, no! The subroutines need to be arranged in cascading sequence. Let me show you.

title: Retrospect
line: Seven, stop.

title: Retrospect
line: There's a hairline fracture of the premaxilla bone.

title: Retrospect
line: Do you see this, Captain? She shattered it.

title: Retrospect
line: It's easily repaired.

title: Retrospect
line: Do you have any idea why Seven attacked you?

title: Retrospect
line: It was unprovoked. She came at me like an animal!

title: Retrospect
line: Oh, I wouldn't put it like that. I was at another console about ten meters away. I heard Kovin raise his voice and when I looked around I saw that he was holding her arm.

title: Retrospect
line: I barely touched her. A gentle gesture to move her out of my way so I could get to the console, then she turned on me, attacked me.

title: Retrospect
line: What did you say to her?

title: Retrospect
line: I told her how to reconfigure the tactical control systems properly.

title: Retrospect
line: Is that all?

title: Retrospect
line: That's all!

title: Retrospect
line: And that's when she knocked him down. Ashmore and I had to hold her back.

title: Retrospect
line: She would have killed me. That woman is dangerous.

title: Retrospect
line: It's a miracle you survived. Now hold still or this won't heal properly.

title: Retrospect
line: Why are you questioning me on this? You should be disciplining your crew member.

title: Retrospect
line: Believe me, I'll deal with it. Please accept my sincere apology. Now, if you'll excuse me.

title: Retrospect
line: Good as new.

title: Retrospect
line: Come in.

title: Retrospect
line: Here we are again. Oh, I'm tired of having this conversation. You know what I'm going to say. I know how you're going to respond, so it seems pointless to say anything.

title: Retrospect
line: Shall I consider my privileges restricted and confine myself to the Cargo Bay?

title: Retrospect
line: I think we've established that traditional disciplinary actions don't work with you. The question is, what will?

title: Retrospect
line: Are you asking for my opinion?

title: Retrospect
line: I suppose I am. Because frankly I'm running out of options. Throwing you in the brig isn't going to solve anything, neither is slapping you on the wrist. And it's not as though I don't understand your feelings about Kovin. There have been a few times when I'd have liked to pop him on the nose myself. But you have to start learning the difference between having an impulse and acting on it. Does that make any sense to you?

title: Retrospect
line: I believe so. I will give it more thought.

title: Retrospect
line: Well, that's a start.

title: Retrospect
line: I hear there was some excitement this morning. When I started helping you improve your social skills, I'm fairly certain I didn't include a boxing lesson. You weren't hurt, were you?

title: Retrospect
line: No.

title: Retrospect
line: Still a bit tense?

title: Retrospect
line: Perhaps.

title: Retrospect
line: I understand the burden you carry. Constantly being obligated to deal with those who fall short of excellence. I often find my own patience being tested by someone like Mister Kovin. Of course I generally respond with a devastating quip rather than a left hook. We must both accept the fact that very few lifeforms will ever meet our high standards. So, when you get irritated, just try to be tolerant, and remember, they can't help being what they are. Hmm. I'm reading some increased engrammatic activity, and your adrenalin levels are slightly elevated.

title: Retrospect
line: What does that indicate?

title: Retrospect
line: It's consistent with a state of heightened tension. Lie down and I'll run some scans. In a typical human, I would consider this a mood swing. But with your unique physiology, I'd like to rule out the possibility of a chemical imbalance.

title: Retrospect
line: Have you been experiencing any other symptoms? Headaches, disorientation?

title: Retrospect
line: No.

title: Retrospect
line: Physiological scans seem normal. I'm going to check your Borg implants now.

title: Retrospect
line: Seven? What's wrong?

title: Retrospect
line: Let me out.

title: Retrospect
line: I will. Stay calm.

title: Retrospect
line: No more procedures.

title: Retrospect
line: All right.

title: Retrospect
line: Stay away. You mustn't do this.

title: Retrospect
line: Do what? Seven, what are you so afraid of?

title: Retrospect
line: I don't know.

title: Retrospect
line: She experienced an episode of acute anxiety with all the trimmings. Intense apprehension, shortness of breath, dizziness. I finally managed to sedate her.

title: Retrospect
line: Could this have been caused by her cortical implants?

title: Retrospect
line: I don't think so. I think the problem has to do with memory suppression. I've detected a high concentration of biogenic amines in Seven's hippocampus, a substance I haven't noticed before. It's blocking portions of her memory center.

title: Retrospect
line: Do you know where it came from?

title: Retrospect
line: No, but it seems to be dissipating.

title: Retrospect
line: Seven's unusual behavior may be the result of the blocked memories beginning to surface. Memories which she can't identify yet.

title: Retrospect
line: Can you treat her?

title: Retrospect
line: Treatment would involve integrating the repressed memories into Seven's consciousness. I may be able to use a standard therapeutic regression technique.

title: Retrospect
line: I wasn't aware that you were programmed for psychotherapeutic capabilities.

title: Retrospect
line: I wasn't. But in the absence of a ship's counselor, I've been developing a psychiatric subroutine to add to my program. I'll be even more valuable to you than I am now.

title: Retrospect
line: Keep me informed, Doctor.

title: Retrospect
line: A Jungian therapist would attempt to retrieve unconscious memories by exploring synchronicities in recent events. On the other hand, Amanin of Betazed would argue that a combination of sensory isolation and focused breathing techniques would be more effective. I've integrated the finer points of both to create my own approach to memory reconstruction.

title: Retrospect
line: What does this approach involve?

title: Retrospect
line: First, putting you at ease by performing the treatment here, in your own environment. Once the cortical probes have reinforced the neural pathways, I'll use a directed imagery technique to guide you through the regression.

title: Retrospect
line: You may proceed.

title: Retrospect
line: Please, close your eyes. Clear your mind. Try not to think or to analyze.

title: Retrospect
line: My mind is now clear.

title: Retrospect
line: Seven, this isn't an exercise in efficiency. Close your eyes, breathe deeply. Now concentrate on the sound of my voice. Let go of the present, leave the cargo bay behind. Allow yourself to drift. Describe the first image that enters your mind.

title: Retrospect
line: A medical tricorder. Duritanium casing. Seven point six centimeters by nine point eight centimeters by three point two centimeters. Alphanumeric display.

title: Retrospect
line: That's enough. So, you're in Sickbay. How does the tricorder make you feel?

title: Retrospect
line: It disturbs me.

title: Retrospect
line: Why does it disturb you?

title: Retrospect
line: I'm afraid it will hurt me.

title: Retrospect
line: Is there anything else there that causes you to anticipate pain?

title: Retrospect
line: The diagnostic bed. It's closing around me.

title: Retrospect
line: You feel restrained, confined?

title: Retrospect
line: About what?

title: Retrospect
line: It's Kovin.

title: Retrospect
line: What is he doing?

title: Retrospect
line: He's restraining me. I want to get away from him but I can't. Kovin's using some kind of instrument on me.

title: Retrospect
line: Seven?

title: Retrospect
line: I didn't recall this before.

title: Retrospect
line: Recall what?

title: Retrospect
line: Kovin. He performed a surgical procedure on me. He extracted Borg technology from my body. He violated me.

title: Retrospect
line: We're making progress. Now tell me, this surgical procedure, when did it happen?

title: Retrospect
line: I don't know. The details are vague. There are only images.

title: Retrospect
line: And you're sure it was Kovin? Did you see Kovin?

title: Retrospect
line: Yes.

title: Retrospect
line: You said he was restraining you, using an instrument of some sort.

title: Retrospect
line: He was.

title: Retrospect
line: Were you on Voyager when this happened?

title: Retrospect
line: No. It must have been when we were testing the weapons on the surface.

title: Retrospect
line: Then concentrate on that away mission. Focus on the first image that enters your mind. Describe it for me,

title: Retrospect
line: A large granitic stone, approximately one half meter high.

title: Retrospect
line: Now, allow that memory to develop beyond the image. Integrate it into your consciousness. Let the memory take shape.

title: Retrospect
line: I'm at the weapons range. Kovin had taken us there to evaluate various hand held firearms he wished to offer in trade.

title: Retrospect
line: He attempted to impress us with a demonstration of the weapons' destructive capabilities. My role was to provide a more objective analysis.

title: Retrospect
line: Terawatt powered particle beam rifle, four microsecond recharge cycle, ten kilometer range.

title: Retrospect
line: Definitely not standard Starfleet issue. What do you think?

title: Retrospect
line: Seventy two percent fragmentation, twenty eight percent vaporization. Crude, but efficient.

title: Retrospect
line: It's not as accurate as our compression rifles, but it's a lot easier to handle. I wouldn't mind carrying one of these the next time we run into the Hirogen.

title: Retrospect
line: Targeting mechanism could be augmented with a thermal guidance sensor. That would improve accuracy by twenty four percent.

title: Retrospect
line: I can do that now. Care to join me? You can make sure the adjustments perform to your specifications.

title: Retrospect
line: If you don't mind, I'd like to test some of the other firearms.

title: Retrospect
line: Go right ahead. This way.

title: Retrospect
line: Kovin took me to a small laboratory.

title: Retrospect
line: Describe it.

title: Retrospect
line: It was poorly illuminated. I saw various instruments, technology unfamiliar to me. I assumed this was where he developed new weapon designs.

title: Retrospect
line: This weapon is thoron based.

title: Retrospect
line: Most of these hand-held disrupters are.

title: Retrospect
line: Thoron can be unstable in weapons.

title: Retrospect
line: Not if you polarize the emitter matrix. That compensates for any instabilities. Watch.

title: Retrospect
line: What are you doing?

title: Retrospect
line: He turned the weapon on me.

title: Retrospect
line: He fired?

title: Retrospect
line: Yes, I remember it now.

title: Retrospect
line: What happened next?

title: Retrospect
line: I'm not sure.

title: Retrospect
line: Concentrate. See the laboratory in your mind.

title: Retrospect
line: There was a light in my eyes.

title: Retrospect
line: Was Kovin still in the room with you?

title: Retrospect
line: Yes.

title: Retrospect
line: Restrain her, quickly.

title: Retrospect
line: And another Entharan was assisting him.

title: Retrospect

line: Can you shut it down?

line: Yes, but I'm going to have to initiate an overload. We'll worry about making repairs later. Right now we've got to put an end to those simulations. Janeway to Ensign Kim.

title: The Killing Game
line: Captain's log, stardate 51715.2. The damage to Voyager has been extreme. Both sides have taken heavy casualties, and it's clear that no one is going to win this conflict. The fighting has reached a standstill and the remaining Hirogen have agreed to negotiate a truce.

title: The Killing Game
line: What is this?

title: The Killing Game
line: An optronic datacore. You can use it to create holodeck technology on your own vessels. I made a promise with your leader before he died, that I would give this knowledge to the Hirogen. Take it.

title: The Killing Game
line: His ideas were unconventional. I do not share them.

title: The Killing Game
line: Was he any more unconventional than you are? Calling a ceasefire with your prey? Only a few days ago, the thought of speaking with us on equal terms would've been inconceivable, but here we are. Accept this trophy. You can use it to create a new future for your people. At the very least, you can hang it on your bulkhead.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Ow! Ow! What do you think you're doing, Doc?

title: Vis A Vis
line: An impromptu auditory exam.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Did I pass?

title: Vis A Vis
line: With flying colors, which leads me to believe you did hear me when I requested you meet me this morning.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're right. I forgot.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I see. I realize your Sickbay training is purely voluntary, but you haven't spent any time there in several weeks. And when I try to find you, you're always in the holodeck.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Correct me if I'm wrong, Doc, but we haven't been treating anything more serious than an ingrown toenail.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That's beside the point. If an emergency were to happen you must be prepared. You're too far behind in your medical texts to be wasting your time in the holodeck.

title: Vis A Vis
line: If it's any consolation, I have spent most of the morning immersed in a complicated surgical procedure.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Really.

title: Vis A Vis
line: A classic case of atrophied shocks. They needed to be extracted to prevent chrome abrasion. It was touch and go for a while, but the prognosis is excellent.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You'll be ready for neurosurgery in no time.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Take a look at this, Doc. This is a fully stock 1969 Chevy Camaro, one of the earliest muscle cars ever made.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Imagine, Northern California, late twentieth century. You're cruising up Highway One, the woofers are pounding, the wind is whipping through your hair.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Medieval safety constraints, internal combustion system producing lethal levels of carbon monoxide. Hmm. I stand corrected. This may be just what you need to get you back to Sickbay.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I guess I should have known this wouldn't interest you. It's too much fun.

title: Vis A Vis
line: This isn't about fun, Mister Paris. Serving in Sickbay is a privilege. I'd expect you to realize that.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Oh, I do. I'll be there. Soon.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Lieutenant Paris, report to the bridge immediately.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm on my way.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Somebody call for a driver?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Take your station, Tom. Anything on scans, Harry?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm picking up another spatial disturbance two thousand kilometers away.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Source?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I have no idea. It looks like space is folding in on itself.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Shields to full.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It's an alien vessel, one occupant aboard.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain, it looks like that ship is being powered by a coaxial warp drive.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Coaxial what?

title: Vis A Vis
line: It's a hypothetical propulsion system. Starfleet engineers have been dreaming about it for years. In theory, it can literally fold the fabric of space allowing a ship to travel instantaneously across huge distances.

title: Vis A Vis
line: The alien warp drive is overloading.

title: Vis A Vis
line: In theory, a coaxial drive explosion could collapse space within a radius of a billion kilometers. In theory.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Let's keep theory from becoming reality. Red alert!

title: Vis A Vis
line: Scan the vessel. Can we beam the pilot out?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Too much interference.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That ship's about had it, Captain. The coaxial core is breaching.

title: Vis A Vis
line: We should vacant this area of space at once.

title: Vis A Vis
line: We can't just leave him like this.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Try one more hail.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Nothing. Maybe he's ignoring us.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Or maybe he's unconscious. We've got to do something.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Suggestions?

title: Vis A Vis
line: A symmetric warp field. That should contain any instabilities in his space-folding core.

title: Vis A Vis
line: How can you be sure?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Advanced subspace geometry. It's the one course at the academy where I actually paid attention. We'll tractor him in to kill his momentum, generate a warp field around his ship.

title: Vis A Vis
line: His flightpath is erratic. We'd be risking collision.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain, I can make this work.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Do it.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Passing through the residual folds in space. Steady. Got him!

title: Vis A Vis
line: I've extended our warp field around his vessel. His core is powering down.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Nice flying, Tom.

title: Vis A Vis
line: My pleasure.

title: Vis A Vis
line: We're finally receiving a hail.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Open a channel.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain Janeway, of the Federation Starship Voyager. Do you need medical attention?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm fine, Captain. Unfortunately my ship is not.

title: Vis A Vis
line: If you need to make repairs, we might be able to help.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That's very generous.

title: Vis A Vis
line: We'll beam you aboard in a few minutes. Stand by.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Thank you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Tuvok.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Energize.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Welcome.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain, I know you put yourselves in danger to rescue me. I want to thank you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm glad we could help.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I was so eager to test my new engine, I pushed it beyond it's limits.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Coaxial warp doesn't seem to be the smoothest way to travel.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It's a violent procedure, but it allows a ship to travel through space at incredible speeds.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Considering the dangers, this method of travel hardly seems logical.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That's probably true, but if I were worrying about danger I wouldn't have become a test pilot.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Where are you from?

title: Vis A Vis
line: The fourth planet of the Benthan system. That's about twenty light years from here.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'll speak to my engineers about helping you with repairs. Without your coaxial drive, it's a long way home.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Come in.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'd like to ask you a favor. I need a change of pace. I'd like to help Steth repair his ship.

title: Vis A Vis
line: This isn't a good time to ask.

title: Vis A Vis
line: What do you mean?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I've been reading a report from the Doctor. You didn't show up today.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I was a little busy this morning. Saving someone's life, as I recall.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Is there something wrong, Tom? Anything bothering you?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Nothing is wrong. Since when is not wanting to spend time with the Doctor a capital offense? You'd have to throw the whole crew in the brig for that one.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Maybe. I was wondering if there's something on your mind. You're showing up for your duty shifts, you do what's required, but your heart doesn't seem to be in it. You seem preoccupied.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Like I said, I think I need a change of pace.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're a different man from the one that came on board four years ago. You've taken charge of your life, turned yourself around. I'd hate to see you ruin it.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I won't. With your permission, I'll report to Sickbay.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Permission denied. Report to Steth's ship instead. Assist in the repairs. We need our best man on the job.

title: Vis A Vis
line: And on my way back, I made the mistake of flying the prototype through restricted Entaban territory.

title: Vis A Vis
line: And?

title: Vis A Vis
line: And the Entabans weren't too pleased to see me. I limped back to the engineers on Benthos with phaser holes through their brand new extanium fuselage. I think they would have been happy to see phaser holes through me.

title: Vis A Vis
line: When I was sixteen, I followed an ancient human custom. I took my father's shuttle out for a joy ride, and proceeded to fry all the relays.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm guessing he wasn't happy about getting it back.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Actually he didn't. As far as I know, it's still at the bottom of Lake Tahoe.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Here it is, the coaxial induction drive. It draws in subatomic particles and reconfigures their internal geometries.

title: Vis A Vis
line: And this is what makes folding space possible?

title: Vis A Vis
line: At least in spurts. Unfortunately, particle instabilities keep overloading my engines. But I'm going to make it work. I have to keep in motion. I don't like the thought of settling down. Too many new ships to drive. Too many intriguing women.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Yeah, I guess so.

title: Vis A Vis
line: When I get this ship back I'm going to be doing the first test on a new Mithran class flyer. I'm told it's more advanced than any warship in the quadrant. Why don't you come with me? We'd have a great time. You could meet up with Voyager afterwards.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'd love to do that. It sounds very exciting. But I have responsibilities here. People who count on me. B'Elanna would be furious. B'Elanna. I have to go.

title: Vis A Vis
line: So, you started without me.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I finished without you. You're a little late.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Sorry. I was helping Steth repair his ship.

title: Vis A Vis
line: How's it going?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Pretty slow. We're both stuck on how to prevent the particle overloads in his propulsion system.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Have you tried an isokinetic containment field?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Yeah, that's the first thing we tried.

title: Vis A Vis
line: How long do you think repairs are going to take?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I don't know.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I was just hoping that maybe you could help me recalibrate the plasma manifolds tonight.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Ah. I, er, I probably should go help Steth.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Tom, is there something wrong?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Why are you interrogating me?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I didn't think I was.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It sounds more like you want me to account for every minute that I'm not with you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That's ridiculous.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Can't I have some time to myself? Can't I do what I want without having to report every detail of it to you?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Tom, you can do whatever you want. I just wanted to know if there was something wrong. I mean, lately you've been canceling dates. You hide out for hours in the holodeck.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I am not hiding anything. That is ridiculous.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Is it? You haven't even told me what holodeck program this is that has you so fascinated.

title: Vis A Vis
line: The Dancing Girls of Ninipia Prime. It's very entertaining,

title: Vis A Vis
line: Very funny.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're overreacting.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I am not overreacting. There's obviously something going on and you're refusing to admit it.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Good evening, Lieutenants. I see you don't have your dinner yet, Tom. Can I get you something?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm really not hungry.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Excuse me. Are you going to talk about this? Because if you're not, I don't want to sit here anymore.

title: Vis A Vis
line: If you can carry on an adult conversation without all the histrionics

title: Vis A Vis
line: Good night, Tom.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Computer, run a DNA stability analysis. How long before my genome reverts to it's previous form?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Time to reversion three hours thirteen minutes. Complete genome recovery is imminent.

title: Vis A Vis
line: So I was lying in bed last night when it hit me. What you need is a carburettor.

title: Vis A Vis
line: A carburettor?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Yes. It's a device that's hundreds of years old. I can't believe I didn't think of it yesterday.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Wait. Hundreds of years old? Surely that couldn't be of any use to us now.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It all goes back to basics. You would be surprised at how often I find solutions to twenty fourth century problems in twentieth century technology. Computer, access Paris program alpha one, Grease Monkey.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Grease Monkey?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Mechanic lingo.

title: Vis A Vis
line: A car's engine can't run on pure fuel, so the carburettor supplies it with a mixture of vaporized fuel and air.

title: Vis A Vis
line: And you think we need a device like that to dilute the particle stream as it enters the coaxial drive.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Exactly! And a spare polaric modulator from Voyager's impulse drive should do the trick.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Subatomic dilution! It never would have occurred to me. I think you've solved it.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Well, we can run a few simulations on the holodeck before we actually try it.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I owe you a lot.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You can thank my lucky toolbox. It's gotten me out of hot water more than once.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're lucky to be stationed on a ship like this. Replicators to feed and clothe you, holotechnology to cater to every whim. Hallways filled with women.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Yeah. It's great.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You don't sound convinced. Aren't you happy here?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Of course I'm happy. I'm very happy. I mean, I pilot one of the most advanced ships in Starfleet, I have a beautiful girlfriend, I'm respected. I have everything that I've ever wanted.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're lucky, You're part of a family, part of a structure. You have rules to guide you. You don't have to worry about making a lot of choices. I usually go to bed at night not knowing what the next day has in store, what trouble I might get into. You don't have to worry about those things. You're very settled.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I remember those days. I used to be a lot like you. Going anywhere, doing whatever I wanted, making my own rules.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Well, then there's hope for me yet, Maybe someday I'll settle down too. But for now I prefer to stay on the move.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Sometimes I wish that's what I was doing.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Things'll turn around for you. I've always found that change is inevitable. It comes when you least expect it.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Yeah, I suppose.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Now, are we ready to try this carburettor idea on my ship?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Just give me five more minutes to finish up here and I'll be right with you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Five minutes. And Tom? Don't dismiss the suggestion I made, about coming with me to fly the new ship. It might be fun to escape the shackles for a while.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Hmm.
