title: Vis A Vis
line: Computer, access all files pertaining to Lieutenant Tom Paris. Download into memory core alpha.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Please enter authorisation code.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Access granted. Commencing download.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Hello. I'm Steth, a guest of your captain.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I have been appraised of your presence on Voyager. You are not authorized to access the ship's computers.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You must be Seven of Nine.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That is correct.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Tom mentioned you. He thinks you're extremely intelligent.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Lieutenant Paris' opinion of me is irrelevant to your being in this room.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Well, er, Tom felt we needed some files for polaric modulators, but he was called away before we could access them. I thought I'd find them myself and help out.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You were mistaken. He must be present to download these files.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Oh, I'm about to meet him at the holodeck. We can find the files there.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Voyager's hierarchy is complex. See that you familiarize yourself with it.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Good advice. I'll do that.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain's log, stardate 51762.4. The repairs to Steth's coaxial drive have been completed well ahead of schedule.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Everything here looks good. Just give me one more second to check the flow field parameters.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Go ahead.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It's my box wrench. I've been looking all over for this.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I know I should have asked you, Tom, but I needed it for an experiment.

title: Vis A Vis
line: To check your new carburettor?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Not quite. You're the first humans I've met and that wrench had enough cellular residue on it for me to check your DNA. I have good news. We're compatible.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Consider this a favor. I know how unhappy you've been with this dreary, settled life so I'm taking it off your hands. I'm betting there's still some fun to be had here. Voyager is a great ship, Tom. I'll take good care of it.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Sorry I'm late.

title: Vis A Vis
line: We were beginning to wonder if you were ever coming back.

title: Vis A Vis
line: His ship is powering engines.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Something wrong, Tom?

title: Vis A Vis
line: It's nothing.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm just really going to miss that guy.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Mind if I join you?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Not at all. Commander.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Chakotay will do, Tom. You don't carry this rules thing too far. I've been discussing your engineering report with the captain. She was wondering if we could implement some of Steth's technology here on Voyager.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Really?

title: Vis A Vis
line: We thought maybe you could start on a shuttle. Do you think you can do it?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm sure I can.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Great. You can start right after you finish with the Doctor.

title: Vis A Vis
line: The Doctor.

title: Vis A Vis
line: He needs your help in Sickbay. I told him you'd be there.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Of course.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Lieutenant.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Hi.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I know you've been avoiding the Doctor, but don't tell me you've forgotten where Sickbay is?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Oh! Not yet. I was just trying to figure out if there's a more efficient route between Sickbay and my quarters.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I didn't realize you were that eager to get there. So tell me, are they ready yet?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Ah, not yet. But they will be, soon.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Great. Hey, let me know if you have any problems. Polyduranide can be tough to replicate.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Oh, sure can be.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I can't wait to get my hands around one of those clubs. Ensign Kaplan won't know what hit her.

title: Vis A Vis
line: What?

title: Vis A Vis
line: We're going to play golf with her. We scheduled a rematch, remember?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Oh, of course. I can't wait.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Have you been working on your putting? You missed both those two-footers last time.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I won't let it happen again.

title: Vis A Vis
line: All right. Give the Doc my best.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I will.

title: Vis A Vis
line: If I ever find him.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're early, Mister Paris. I see some good came from my report to Commander Chakotay. Let's put these extra few minutes to good use. Begin with a thorough biobed diagnostic. I want you to recalibrate each physiosensor, making sure to enter each metabolic referent precisely.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Okay.

title: Vis A Vis
line: When you're through with that, run a protein structure analysis and then continue your review of the thirty seven steps of a cardiopulmonary reconstruction procedure. I'll leave you to your biobeds.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Did you forget to disengage the scan emitters?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Sorry.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Mister Paris.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I don't know what's wrong.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I realize it's complicated, but you must try again.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Actually, I'm not feeling so well.

title: Vis A Vis
line: How fortunate you're already in Sickbay. I'll run a few scans.

title: Vis A Vis
line: No, no, Doc, that's all right. To be perfectly honest with you. This is so frustrating for me. I usually pick things up a lot faster than this.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're here to learn, Mister Paris. It will get easier with time.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That's easy for you to say.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Excuse me?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Well, no offense, Doctor, but you were programmed to be a medical genius. Things always come easy to you. Me, I'm just a pilot. A grease monkey. And as hard as I might try to become a better assistant, it's clear to me now that I'll never be half the healer that you are.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Do you mean to tell me you've been trying to live up to my standards?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm afraid I have.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It all makes sense now. The misplaced aggression, the shirking of responsibilities. All classic signs of an inferiority complex. I had no idea my superior abilities were affecting your psyche so strongly. Take the rest of the day off. Reflect on your strengths. Realize your worth.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'll do that, Doctor. Thank you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: B'Elanna.

title: Vis A Vis
line: What do you think you're doing?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Putting.

title: Vis A Vis
line: In my quarters?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I can't putt in your quarters?

title: Vis A Vis
line: No.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Since when?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Tom. What is this?

title: Vis A Vis
line: That is a sand wedge. It's used for getting out of traps.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Why is it here?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I replicated it for you. I thought we could play a little game of golf on the holodeck before dinner.

title: Vis A Vis
line: So this is your idea of an adult conversation? I don't know what you are trying to accomplish with this little stunt, but let me assure you, it is not working. I am sorry if you are bored because Steth is gone, but that doesn't mean that you can just walk in here and pretend like you haven't been shutting me out.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're being a little hard on Steth. If it wasn't for him, I wouldn't be here right now.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Really?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I mentioned to him we were having some problems and he urged me to come and talk to you. To try to work things out. To admit I was wrong. I made a mistake, B'Elanna, and I'm sorry. I won't shut you out anymore. In fact, I went to the Doctor and begged to be excused from my duties. I realize it's only a few extra hours, but they're hours I want to spend with you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Steth turned out to be a positive influence on you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Computer, wh

title: Vis A Vis
line: Computer, where are we?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Navigation matrix one seven one one. The Kotaba expanse. Coaxial leap complete. PARIS?

title: Vis A Vis
line: How far are we from Voyager? Computer, lock in Voyager's last known coordinates and activate differential induction drive.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Unable to execute command.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Why not?

title: Vis A Vis
line: The differential induction drive has been secured. The security access code is required to implement the coaxial leap.

title: Vis A Vis
line: This is Commander Avek of the Benthan Guard. We're taking you into custody. Prepare to surrender the vessel to us at once.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Benthan? I need a second to explain, Commander. I'm not who you think

title: Vis A Vis
line: We do not negotiate with thieves.

title: Vis A Vis
line: No, you don't understand. I, I need the ship to get back to Voyager.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Surrender the vessel peacefully or we will use force.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Why is everybody trying to shoot me today?

title: Vis A Vis
line: You know what I'm here for.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I don't know what you're talking about. Who are you?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm Steth.

title: Vis A Vis
line: What?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Look at me. You did wear this body for nearly a year before you switched it with mine. That's my body you're in now. I want it back.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Bear with me for a second. We have more in common than you might think.

title: Vis A Vis
line: This better be good, Tom. I left Vorik right in the middle of an EPS recalibration.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You can thank me later.

title: Vis A Vis
line: So, what's my big surprise?

title: Vis A Vis
line: What would you say to twenty four glorious hours on the famed fourth planet of the Kendren system?

title: Vis A Vis
line: You mean the planet where Neelix is gathering food samples?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I ran a few scans and found the most incredible beach on one of the smaller continents. I replicated a picnic lunch for us. Voyager isn't leaving orbit until tomorrow. We'd have an entire day.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Only a day? Oh, I think that we would need at least a week.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I wish we could. We've only got a day.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're serious, aren't you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Completely.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Do you know how much trouble we would be in?

title: Vis A Vis
line: What could Janeway do, execute us?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Tom, I am swamped. I can't get away for an hour, let alone twenty four.

title: Vis A Vis
line: B'Elanna.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I have responsibilities here. We both do.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Responsibilities? I don't care!

title: Vis A Vis
line: Tom, you're hurting me.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're a real disappointment to me, do you know that? I don't know what I ever saw in you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Seven, what brings you here at this hour?

title: Vis A Vis
line: We were supposed to meet in the shuttlebay at twenty one hundred hours. Did you forget?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I did. I got so caught up with my reading I guess it slipped my mind. Sorry.

title: Vis A Vis
line: The capillaries in your eyes are swollen, Lieutenant, and I see signs of vascular congestion in your cheeks. Are you intoxicated?

title: Vis A Vis
line: No, not at all. I was just exploring the replicator, trying some alien beverages. Only a few were alcoholic.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You are not officially off-duty for another seventy eight minutes.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm on break. Would you like to join me? I could replicate another Trakian ale for you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That will not be necessary.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Relax, Seven. You're not on the Borg Cube any more. We could finish our work on the shuttle tomorrow.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That would be an inefficient use of our time. I will complete the work myself.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Fine.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Before I leave, I would like to know why you were reading the captain's personal logs?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I wasn't.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I saw the PADD. It was unmistakably the captain's logs.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're wrong. You're confused. You couldn't possibly have seen anything.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You know I possess an eidetic memory. I require only seconds to commit what I see to memory. Would you like me to quote the passage you were reading?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm warning you, stay out of my way! Don't interfere in things that don't concern you. If you bother me again, I will make things very unpleasant for you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Remove your hand from my arm.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Don't be foolish. You'll regret it.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Enter.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You wanted to see me, Captain?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Yes. I received a rather disturbing report from Seven of Nine regarding your conduct last night. She claims you were drinking on duty.

title: Vis A Vis
line: She's mistaken, Captain.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Don't lie to me, Tom. I checked the computers. You replicated five alcoholic beverages in the mess hall. She also said you threatened her.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm sorry, Captain. B'Elanna and I had an argument. I was upset.

title: Vis A Vis
line: And is that why you were reading my personal logs?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I wasn't!

title: Vis A Vis
line: Seven recited a passage which I'd written, word for word.

title: Vis A Vis
line: She probably accessed those files herself. Captain, you can't take the word of a Borg over mine.

title: Vis A Vis
line: This has to stop, Tom. Your conduct lately has been bizarre, and I've heard far too many complaints from far too many people to dismiss it. Chakotay, the Doctor, Seven of Nine. They're all worried about you. And so am I.

title: Vis A Vis
line: You're right, Captain. I need some rest. I'll go right to my quarters.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Tom! As your Captain and as your friend, I want you to report to Sickbay for some tests. We have to find out if there's something physical that's causing this behavior.

title: Vis A Vis
line: This is crazy. I don't need any help.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That's an order.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Security, I need you in the ready room, now!

title: Vis A Vis
line: Are you hurt, Captain?

title: Vis A Vis
line: No. Take him to Sickbay. Keep security with him.

title: Vis A Vis
line: The coaxial drive will be online in a few minutes.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Good. I've just about overridden all the lock-out commands. No offense, but I'd like to get out of your body as soon as possible.

title: Vis A Vis
line: The alien seems capable of some sort of selective DNA exchange. He absorbs new DNA while depositing his current genetic material into his victims. Let's hope he can reverse that process.

title: Vis A Vis
line: That's the last lock-out command. We're set for coaxial warp. Let's find Voyager.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain's log, supplemental. The doctor has treated Mister Paris' phaser wounds, but has been unable to wake him. The motive for his attack remains a mystery.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Neurological scans yielded very little, but I did find something very interesting in his blood analysis. There are traces of a second DNA pattern in his nucleotide structure. Possibly the result of a genetic virus.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Could this be the cause of his recent behavior?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I don't know, but I'm running more scans to see how this might have affected his neurological functions.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain, a vessel just emerged from coaxial space off our starboard bow.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Keep me informed, Doctor.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Hail them.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain Janeway.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Welcome back, Mister Steth.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I know this sounds crazy, Captain, but I'm not Steth. I'm Tom Paris.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I beg your pardon.

title: Vis A Vis
line: We're dealing with an alien who's some sort of identity thief. He traded places with me. Please, beam us aboard.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Maintain your position while we consider your request. End transmission. Hold them in a tractor beam until you hear from me.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Aye, Captain.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I have a feeling Steth and his new friend are behind whatever's happened to Tom.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain?

title: Vis A Vis
line: No time to explain. I'll be in Sickbay.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Commander, I'm reading an unauthorized shuttle launch. It's the captain. She's in the shuttle Tom's been working on.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Try hailing her.

title: Vis A Vis
line: She's not responding.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Hail Steth's ship. Look, I don't know who you are, but I want to know what's happening here.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Who's on that shuttle?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain Janeway.

title: Vis A Vis
line: No. I'm betting the alien switched my body, er, Tom's body for hers. You've got to let us out of this tractor beam. We can catch her with this ship. Chakotay, it's me.

title: Vis A Vis
line: How do I know that?

title: Vis A Vis
line: The other day, in your office, you told me I'd turned my life around. Well, give me the chance to prove it. Let me go after the shuttle. It is the only way we can get everybody back into the right body.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Harry, disengage the tractor beam.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Twenty thousand kilometers and closing.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Has he detected us yet?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'd say he has.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Gentlemen, I'd advise you to reconsider this pursuit. Killing me will only keep you trapped in those bodies.

title: Vis A Vis
line: He's right. We can't risk killing him.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Yeah, but nothing's keeping him from killing us. Damn! The ship's not nearly as manoeuverable as a shuttle.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Shields are down.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm surprised you're so eager to

title: Vis A Vis
line: Reclaim your life on Voyager, Tom. I was just as disappointed with it as you were.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Then I guess we were both wrong.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It's time to move on again. Oh, Tom? Be sure to send my best regards to B'Elanna, hmm?

title: Vis A Vis
line: He's charging the coaxial drive.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Set the sensors to track him.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I can't. He's blocking us. We won't be able to follow him once he goes into coaxial warp. We're losing him.

title: Vis A Vis
line: The carburettor! We added a polaric modulator to the coaxial drive. If I can target the modulator, hit it with a chromoelectric pulse, that'll disrupt his engines. Here goes.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I hope you still have my box wrench. Faulty carburettors can be a pain to fix.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Captain's log, stardate 51775.2. While the alien intruder remains trapped in the body of his last victim, the doctor has found a way to return Tom, Steth and me to our own bodies.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Doctor, I can't thank you enough. You've given me my life back.

title: Vis A Vis
line: All in a day's work.

title: Vis A Vis
line: There were times when I thought I would be stuck in that body forever.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Believe me, I'm just as happy to be back to the old Tom Paris.

title: Vis A Vis
line: What do you plan to do now?

title: Vis A Vis
line: I'm going to take her back to Bentha. I hope to find the person who belongs to that body.

title: Vis A Vis
line: But who knows if that's the end of it? We have no idea how long she or he has been switching identities.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It may take a while, but I will do whatever I can to find everyone you've violated.

title: Vis A Vis
line: A security team will escort you to your ship and erect a forcefield to contain her.

title: Vis A Vis
line: So this is where you've been hiding? A garage.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It's more than just a garage. This is a monument to hundreds and hundreds of hours that I probably should have spent with you.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Probably?

title: Vis A Vis
line: Definitely.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It's a lovely garage, Tom, but I still don't understand why you brought me here.

title: Vis A Vis
line: Well, consider it a symbolic gesture. It's my less than subtle attempt to let you in.

title: Vis A Vis
line: I see. To make it clear that I mean almost as much to you as a cam-a-ro.

title: Vis A Vis
line: It's a mint condition 1969 Camaro. And yes, you mean a lot more to me.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Oh six hundred hours. Regeneration cycle complete.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Daily log, Seven of Nine, stardate 15781.2. Today, Ensign Kim and I will conduct a comprehensive diagnostic of the aft sensor array. I have allocated three hours twenty minutes for the task, and an additional seventeen minutes for Ensign Kim's usual conversational digressions. I am scheduled to take a nutritional supplement at fifteen hundred hours, engage in one hour of cardiovascular activity, then I intend to review a text the Doctor recommended entitled A Christmas Carol. He believes it will have educational value. End log.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'll get this. Don't give me any hints.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I have no intention of doing so.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Ensign.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Hi, Seven.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Are you ready to begin our sensor diagnostic?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Is it oh six hundred already? We've been playing all night.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Vulcan kal-toh.

title: The Omega Directive
line: For a game of logic, you'd be surprised at how addictive it is. Give me a few more minutes to figure this out.

title: The Omega Directive
line: You should attend to your duties, Ensign. I'll accept your forfeit.

title: The Omega Directive
line: No way. This is the closest I've ever come to beating you. I'm not giving up now.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Impressive.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Elementary spatial harmonics. Are you ready now?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yeah, sure. I would've gotten that.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Is there anything you don't know?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I was Borg.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I was Borg. That's what you always say but what does it mean? You've got the knowledge of ten thousand species in your head?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Not exactly. Each drone's experiences are processed by the Collective. Only useful information is retained.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Still, that probably makes you the most intelligent human being alive.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Probably.

title: The Omega Directive
line: So what do you need the rest of us for? Forget I asked.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What was that?

title: The Omega Directive
line: We just dropped out of warp.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What's the problem?

title: The Omega Directive
line: We were hit by some kind of shockwave.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Source?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Checking.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Hold on. I just lost all my sensor readings. The computer's bringing up some kind of message, but I can't access it. You'd better take a look at this.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I see it.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What is it?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I have no idea. My command codes aren't working. The computer says I have insufficient clearance to access the message. We can't function like this. I'm going to get Harry up here to trace the source.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Don't do anything. I'll take care of this.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Send all sensor data about the particle wave to my ready room. Tom, disengage engines and hold position here.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain, what's going on?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I can't explain right now. Don't discuss any of this with the rest of the crew. I'll have further instructions for you soon.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Computer, seal the doors to this room. No entry without my authorisation.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Doors are sealed.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Access secured datafile Omega one.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Voiceprint confirmed. State clearance code.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Janeway one one five three red. Clearance level ten.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Confirmed. Sensors have detected the Omega phenomenon within one point two light years of this vessel. Implement the Omega Directive immediately. All other priorities have been rescinded.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Display sensor data.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I've been informed this is a highly classified mission. Information will be provided on a need-to-know basis. Captain's orders.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Classified? By who? We're sixty thousand light years from Starfleet.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Like I said. Need to know. B'Elanna, she wants you to install multiphasic shielding around the warp core.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I've never seen this shield configuration. I'd like to run a couple of computer simulations to make sure it's stable.

title: The Omega Directive
line: No time. She needs this done by eleven hundred hours.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Eleven hundred? I don't think that's possible.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Make it possible.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Are we attempting to protect the core from some form of subspace radiation?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I don't know any more than you do.

title: The Omega Directive
line: It will be difficult to complete the task without more data.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The data you've got will have to do. Tom, start modifying a shuttlecraft to withstand extreme thermal stress. Twelve thousand Kelvins, at least.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Does all this have anything to do with that secret message the Captain received?

title: The Omega Directive
line: What have you heard?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Rumors, mainly. Janeway's been locked in her ready room for the past sixteen hours. Something about an Omega Directive.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Omega?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Ring a bell?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Look, the speculation ends right here. Now, I expect you to carry out your assignments with a minimum of gossip, understood? I know it's hard not to wonder. Frankly, I'm curious myself, but the captain was very adamant about this. Get going. The captain wants to see you.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I thought she might.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Come in. What do you know about the Omega Directive?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Everything you do, most likely.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I thought as much. The Borg assimilated Starfleet captains. You would possess all of their knowledge.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's correct. Do you intend to carry out the Directive?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then sensors have detected the molecule.

title: The Omega Directive
line: So it would appear. But we have to confirm it.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We?

title: The Omega Directive
line: You're going to help me carry out the Directive. Protocol forbids me from discussing this mission with any of my crew, but since you already know about it, my choice is to either work with you or confine you to quarters.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Perhaps you should do the latter. I will not help you destroy Omega. It should be harnessed.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's impossible.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The Borg believe otherwise.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Explain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: On one occasion, we were able to create a single Omega molecule. We kept it stable for one trillionth of a nanosecond before it destabilized. We didn't have enough boronite ore left to synthesize more, but the knowledge we gained allowed us to refine our theories.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The Borg have been waiting for the chance to test them out.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes. But we never found another source of the ore. Until now.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Sorry, but if someone out there is experimenting with Omega, I'm under orders to stop them. Otherwise, this entire quadrant would be at risk.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Those orders were issued as a result of Starfleet's ignorance and fear. I can alleviate your ignorance. As for your fear

title: The Omega Directive
line: Sometimes fear should be respected, Seven. Tell me, how many Borg were sacrificed during this experiment?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Twenty nine vessels, six hundred thousand drones. But that is irrelevant.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Not to me, not to my crew, and not to the people who live in this quadrant. I'm going to neutralize this threat, Seven, with or without your help.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I will assist you.

title: The Omega Directive
line: You will?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I have waited many years to observe this molecule firsthand. I will not deny myself this experience.

title: The Omega Directive
line: All right. Go back to your cargo bay, assemble all the data you have about Omega. I'll expect a report within the hour. I didn't realize you had such a strong scientific curiosity.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Not curiosity. Desire.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Desire?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Omega is infinitely complex, yet harmonious. To the Borg it represents perfection. I wish to understand that perfection.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The Borg's Holy Grail.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Never mind. I'll see you in an hour.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Arithrazine? What for?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'm going on an away mission.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What are you planning to do, stroll through a supernova?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Something like that. Twenty milligrams. When can you have it ready?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain, arithrazine is used for the most severe cases of theta radiation poisoning. A physician must be present to monitor the treatment.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That won't be possible.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then I'm afraid I can't accommodate you. I'd be in violation of Starfleet Medical Protocols.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Well, I'm overriding those protocols.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Don't tell me. The Omega Directive, whatever that might be.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The arithrazine, Doctor.

title: The Omega Directive
line: It'll be ready in the morning.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Have it sent to the shuttlebay.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain, I don't know what's going on here but I'd hate this to be the last time I ever see you. Please be careful.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I will.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I've analyzed the sensor logs using Borg algorithms. The shockwave we detected indicates not one but possibly hundreds of Omega molecules.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Location?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Within ten light years. I'm having difficulty isolating the exact star system.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Hundreds of molecules? That changes everything.

title: The Omega Directive
line: A shuttle mission may be insufficient. We require the resources of this entire crew.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We're going to need more firepower, more protection. Transfer your data to the Astrometrics lab. I'll work on it there.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Calibration complete. Phase modulator. Detonator circuits?

title: The Omega Directive
line: On standby.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We're ready to load the gravimetric charge.

title: The Omega Directive
line: This looks like enough for a fifty isoton explosion.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Fifty four, to be exact.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What are we planning to do, blow up a small planet?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I don't know.

title: The Omega Directive
line: This warhead isn't standard issue. Who designed it, the captain?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Mister Kim, you ask too many questions. Change of plans, gentlemen. Increase the charge to eighty isotons.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Aye, Captain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Harry, when you're done here, give B'Elanna a hand with the shuttlecraft. She's reinforcing the hull.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Right.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Ensign Hickman thinks it's species eight four seven two.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Pardon me?

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's his theory. There's an opening in fluidic space, and Captain Janeway has to shut it down. Want to know what I think?

title: The Omega Directive
line: No.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I think there's a type six protostar out there, and the captain's planning on detonating it and opening up a wormhole to the Alpha Quadrant. In theory, it's possible. And because she doesn't want to get our hopes up, she's not telling anybody.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then I wouldn't suggest getting your hopes up.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then what do you think it is?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I do not engage in idle speculation.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Oh, come on, Tuvok. Aren't you curious?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes, but we have a task at hand. The phase modulator.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Come in. Status report?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Everything's going according to schedule.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Good. The Omega Directive doesn't allow me to say much but I want you to know what to expect. At oh six hundred hours, I'll be leaving in a shuttle with Seven of Nine.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Would it be out of line to ask where you're going?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I can tell you this. One of two things is going to happen. Either Seven and I will succeed on our mission, and return within a few days, or your long range sensors will detect a large explosion in subspace. If that occurs, you'll have less than ten seconds to jump to warp and get the hell out of here. Head for the Alpha Quadrant and don't look back, understood?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I always thought Starfleet was run by duty-crazed bureaucrats, but I find it hard to believe that even they would order a captain to go on a suicide mission. This shuttle excursion is your idea, isn't it?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Let's just say I've had to amend the Directive, given the circumstances, But you have your orders and I expect you to follow them.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's expecting a lot. You're asking me to abandon my captain and closest friend without even telling me why.

title: The Omega Directive
line: If it were a simple matter of trust I wouldn't hesitate to tell you, but we've encountered situations where information was taken from us by force. I can't allow knowledge of Omega to go beyond Voyager.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's a reasonable argument, but you're not always a reasonable woman. You're determined to protect this crew, and this time you've taken it too far. A dangerous mission? Fine, I'll acknowledge that, but isn't it more likely to succeed with everyone behind you, working together?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Ordinarily, I'd agree. But this Directive was issued many years ago, and Starfleet didn't exactly have our predicament in mind. Lost in the Delta Quadrant, with no backup. I can't ignore the orders, but I won't ask the crew to risk their lives because of my obligation.

title: The Omega Directive
line: My obligation. That's where you're wrong. Voyager may be alone out here, but you're not. Let us help you. We'll keep classified information limited to the senior staff. We'll take every security precaution. Just don't try to do this alone.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Assemble the troops.

title: The Omega Directive
line: If we were in the Alpha Quadrant right now, we wouldn't be having this conversation. I'd be in contact with Starfleet Command, and they'd send in a specialized team to deal with the crisis. In their absence, we're going to have to make do with the training I've received, and the knowledge Seven of Nine has retained from the Borg. You've all seen this symbol. Omega, the last letter of the Greek alphabet. Chosen by Starfleet to represent a threat not only to the Federation, but to the entire galaxy. Only starship captains and Federation Flag Officers have been briefed on the nature of this threat. What you're about to hear will not go beyond these bulkheads, is that clear? Good.

title: The Omega Directive
line: This is Omega.

title: The Omega Directive
line: A molecule?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Not just any molecule. The most powerful substance known to exist. A single Omega molecule contains the same energy as a warp core. In theory, a small chain of them could sustain a civilization. The molecule was first synthesized over a hundred years ago, by a Starfleet physicist named Ketteract. I think he was hoping to develop an inexhaustible power source.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Or a weapon.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Ketteract managed to synthesize a single molecule particle of Omega, but it only existed for a fraction of a second before it destabilized.

title: The Omega Directive
line: This was a classified research station in the Lantaru Sector. Ketteract and one hundred twenty six of the Federation's leading scientists were lost in the accident. Rescue teams attempting to reach the site discovered an unexpected secondary effect. There were subspace ruptures extending out several light years.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The Lantaru Sector. It's impossible to create a stable warp field there. You can only fly through it at sublight speeds. I was always told that was a natural phenomenon. You're saying it was caused by a single molecule of this stuff?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Omega destroys subspace. A chain reaction involving a handful of molecules could devastate subspace throughout an entire Quadrant. If that were to happen, warp travel would become impossible. Space-faring civilization as we know it would cease to exist. When Starfleet realized Omega's power, they suppressed all knowledge of it.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Have you detected Omega here, in the Delta Quadrant?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'm afraid so. I've been authorized to use whatever means necessary to destroy it. Tom, I've calculated the location of the molecules. I'll transfer the coordinates to the helm. Take us there at full impulse.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Aye, Captain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I don't have to tell you what's at stake. If a large-scale Omega explosion occurs, we will lose the ability to go to warp forever. We've got our work cut out for us.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain's log, supplemental. Encrypt log entry. We're approaching the star system where we believe we'll find Omega. I have to admit, I have never been this apprehensive about a mission. I know how Einstein must have felt about the atom bomb, or Marcus when she developed the Genesis device. They watched helplessly as science took a destructive course. But I have the chance to prevent that from happening. I just hope it's not too late.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Status report?

title: The Omega Directive
line: This is a harmonic resonance chamber. The Borg designed it to contain and stabilize Omega.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I thought I asked you to work on the photon torpedo.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The torpedo may be insufficient. I can modify this chamber to emit an inverse frequency. It will be enough to dissolve Omega's interatomic bonds.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Here's to Borg ingenuity. This is excellent work, Seven. We may need this.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The modifications require several complex calculations. Assist me.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I guess I will. I'm curious. When did the Borg discover Omega?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Two hundred twenty nine years ago.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Assimilation?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes, of thirteen different species.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Thirteen?

title: The Omega Directive
line: It began with Species two six two. They were primitive, but their oral history referred to a powerful substance which could burn the sky. The Borg were intrigued, which led them to Species two six three. They too were primitive, and believed it was a drop of blood from their Creator.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Fascinating.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes, but irrelevant. We followed this trail of myth for many years until finally assimilating a species with useful scientific data. We then created the molecule ourselves.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Omega caused quite a stir among my own species. Federation cosmologists had a theory that the molecule once existed in nature for an infinitesimal period of time at the exact moment of the Big Bang. Some claimed Omega was the primal source of energy for the explosion that began our universe.

title: The Omega Directive
line: A creation myth like any other.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Perhaps. What is it the Borg say? That Omega is perfect?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Is that a theory or a belief.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Bridge to Captain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Go ahead.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We're approaching the coordinates.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'm on my way. I'm leaving this project in your hands. Use whatever resources and personnel you need.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Understood.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We've entered a planetary system.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Inhabited?

title: The Omega Directive
line: There's a pre-warp civilization on the outermost planet. The source of Omega seems to be further in.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The damage to subspace in this region is extreme. We won't be able to go to warp.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We're encountering distortions.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Track their origin.

title: The Omega Directive
line: An M class moon. We're in visual range.

title: The Omega Directive
line: On screen.

title: The Omega Directive
line: There's a subnucleonic reaction occurring in the upper atmosphere. It is apparently emanating from a structure on the moon's surface.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Can your sensors penetrate the atmosphere?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Stand by.

title: The Omega Directive
line: My God.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Over three hundred thousand square kilometers destroyed.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Scan the structure. Are there any Omega molecules remaining?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I can't tell. Several sections of the outpost are still shielded.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'm detecting lifesigns.

title: The Omega Directive
line: How many?

title: The Omega Directive
line: A few dozen maybe. It's hard to get a clear reading.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Harry, can we transport to the surface?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I can get you there, but conditions in the structure aren't good. There are high levels of radiation.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Tuvok, assemble a rescue team and have them report to Sickbay for arithrazine inoculations. Tell the Doctor to prepare for casualties. Tom, move Voyager into a high orbit, and then join the away team. We'll need a field medic.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes, ma'am.

title: The Omega Directive
line: You're going with them?

title: The Omega Directive
line: If Omega's still down there, I have to find it. I'll keep an open comm. link with the ship. You have the bridge.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'm picking up Omega's resonance frequency. It's here but I can't pinpoint a location.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I need to ask you questions about the experiments you've been conducting here.

title: The Omega Directive
line: There was an accident. We lost containment.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The substance you were trying to create. Did any of it survive the explosion?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Where?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Inside the primary test chamber. Who are you?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain Janeway of the starship Voyager. We're here to help you. Away team to Voyager. Two to beam directly to Sickbay.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Aye, Captain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: This door is solid duritanium, thirteen centimeters thick.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Can we get it open?

title: The Omega Directive
line: The duritanium has melted into the door frame. We'll need to cut through the metal with phasers.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Do it.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain, I'd be negligent if I didn't point out that we're about to violate the Prime Directive.

title: The Omega Directive
line: For the duration of this mission the Prime Directive has been rescinded. Let's get this over with.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Crewman Dell, I'm assigning you a task more suited to your abilities. Calibrate the ionic pressure seals on the observation ports. Your new designation is Three of Ten.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes, ma'am.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I've got more isolinear processors for you to install.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Thanks, but I need to get the power relays online first.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Are you sure that's a good idea? Ensign Wildman was assigned to that.

title: The Omega Directive
line: This is ridiculous. I'm not going to waste time just because Seven wants to turn this team into her own private Collective.

title: The Omega Directive
line: She says it's more efficient.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Maybe for a bunch of Drones.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Six of Ten, this is not your assignment.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Please, stop calling me that.

title: The Omega Directive
line: You are compromising our productivity. I'm reassigning you to chamber maintenance. Your new designation is Two of Ten.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Wait a minute, you're demoting me? Since when do the Borg pull rank?

title: The Omega Directive
line: A Starfleet protocol I adapted. I find it most useful.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'm glad you're not the captain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: How's it coming?

title: The Omega Directive
line: The crew can be quite efficient when properly organized. The harmonic chamber will be completed within the hour.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Good. I'll let the captain know.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Has she retrieved any new data from the surface?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Not yet. They're still trying to access the primary test chamber.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Were there survivors?

title: The Omega Directive
line: A few. The Doctor's treating them in Sickbay.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Commander. Seven's taking this hive mentality just a little too far. Designated functions, numbered Drones. I wouldn't be surprised if she started plugging us into alcoves.

title: The Omega Directive
line: When in the Collective, Harry, adapt.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Which of them is the senior researcher?

title: The Omega Directive
line: This gentleman. Why do you ask?

title: The Omega Directive
line: He has knowledge I require.

title: The Omega Directive
line: He also happens to be barely conscious. Come back in an hour.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Unacceptable.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Unavoidable. This is my sickbay. The man needs to recover.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The Captain left me in charge of our efforts on Voyager. I would be negligent if I ignored a source of new information.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Our next social skills seminar is entitled Adding Diplomatic Flair To Future Negotiations. How are you feeling, sir?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Better, thank you.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Are you comfortable enough to speak with this individual?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Keep it brief.

title: The Omega Directive
line: How many of the molecules were you able to synthesize?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Two hundred million? I'm not certain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What is the isofrequency of your containment field?

title: The Omega Directive
line: One point six eight terahertz. We used the molecule's own resonance to calculate the field.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That should have been enough to stabilize them.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Obviously, it wasn't.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Obviously. But your approach is innovative. Perhaps I can adapt your technique and improve upon it. You will assist me.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Our equipment was destroyed. If you can transfer the molecules to your ship, maybe they can be saved.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I have no intention of saving them.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What?

title: The Omega Directive
line: My orders are to destroy the Omega molecules.

title: The Omega Directive
line: This is my life's work. The salvation of my people!

title: The Omega Directive
line: Will you assist me or not?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Our resources are nearly gone. The future of my people depends on this discovery.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then your answer is no.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Small-minded creatures. You destroy whatever you don't understand! Rescue ships are on the way. They won't let you do it.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Please, try to be calm. Seven, you'll have to leave.

title: The Omega Directive
line: You don't realize what you're doing. You don't know what this is, what this means.

title: The Omega Directive
line: On the contrary. I understand perfectly.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We've disabled the locking mechanism.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Narrow your phaser beams to cut through the inner seal.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Inadvisable. We'd risk penetrating the containment field.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then we'll have to use some elbow grease. Give me a hand. Right.

title: The Omega Directive
line: There's enough here to wipe out subspace across half the quadrant.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'll order the away teams back to Voyager and target this facility with the gravimetric charge.

title: The Omega Directive
line: It won't be enough. We'll have to go with our Borg option. Ensign.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes, Captain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Return to the ship. Tell Commander Chakotay to help Seven complete the harmonic chamber. We'll have to transport Omega directly to the ship. That means finding a way to shut down this containment field.

title: The Omega Directive
line: It's unfortunate we can't study this phenomenon in more detail. We may not have the opportunity again.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Let's hope we never do.

title: The Omega Directive
line: A curious statement from a woman of science.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'm also a woman who occasionally knows when to quit. Take another look at your tricorder. Omega's too dangerous. I won't risk half the quadrant to satisfy our curiosity. It's arrogant, and it's irresponsible. The final frontier has some boundaries that shouldn't be crossed, and we're looking at one.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We don't need to destroy the molecules. I believe I've found a way to stabilize them. The alien in Sickbay calibrated his containment field using Omega's own resonance, an approach unknown to the Borg. I have modified this chamber

title: The Omega Directive
line: Those weren't your orders. The Captain wants Omega eliminated.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That is still an option, if she insists on yielding to her fear.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Show me what you've done.

title: The Omega Directive
line: This simulation shows the molecules in their free state, highly unstable. I've modified the chamber to emit a harmonic waveform that will dampen the molecules.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Looks great, in theory, but this is only a simulation. How are you going to test it?

title: The Omega Directive
line: On Omega.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Bad idea. One mistake, and no one will be around for a second try.

title: The Omega Directive
line: It will work.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Someday, maybe. Hang on to your research. For now, we stick to the plan. Stand by to transport the molecules into this chamber and neutralize them as ordered.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I have been a member of this crew for nine months. In all of that time, I have never made a personal request. I am making one now. Allow me to proceed. Please.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Why is this so important to you?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Particle zero one zero. The Borg designation for what you call Omega. Every Drone is aware of its existence. We were instructed to assimilate it at all costs. It is perfection. The molecules exist in a flawless state. Infinite parts functioning as one.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Like the Borg.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Precisely. I am no longer Borg, but I still need to understand that perfection. Without it, my existence will never be complete. Commander, you are a spiritual man.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's right.

title: The Omega Directive
line: If you had the chance to see your God, your Great Spirit, what would you do?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'd pursue it, with all my heart.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then you understand.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I think I do. I'll inform the captain of your discovery. For now, her orders stand.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Thank you.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Set the confinement beam to its narrowest dispersion.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Understood.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We'll target this facility with the gravimetric torpedo. If anything goes wrong during transport, that'll be our only hope.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Bridge to Janeway. We've detected two ships on an intercept course. They're not responding to hails.

title: The Omega Directive
line: How long until they get here?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Less than four minutes, Captain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Standby to transport the

title: The Omega Directive
line: Molecules directly to the harmonic chamber.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Understood. Bridge to

title: The Omega Directive
line: Cargo bay.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes, Commander.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Seven, get ready.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We'll have to do this quickly.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's not advisable.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We don't have a choice.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The alien ships are on their way.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then I recommend moving the ship within five thousand kilometers of the surface.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That'll take us right into the atmosphere.

title: The Omega Directive
line: With our shields down, we won't withstand the thermal reaction for more than a few seconds.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then we'll only get one shot at this. Take us in.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Transporter status?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Targeting scanners are locked.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain, are you ready?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Pattern enhancers are active.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Do it.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We're eleven thousand kilometers from the surface. If we get much closer, we'll incinerate.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We're losing structural integrity.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Nine thousand kilometers.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We're close enough. Energize.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Initiating transport.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The Omega molecules are stable.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Transport was successful.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I've got the away team in transporter room two.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Get us out of here, maximum impulse.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Already on it.

title: The Omega Directive
line: How far away are those ships?

title: The Omega Directive
line: They're right on our tail.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We're heading into an area of open space. No indications of life or any kind of technology. We can carry out the procedure with no risk to anyone else.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Except those two ships behind us.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Can we stay ahead of them?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Not for long.

title: The Omega Directive
line: How soon can we clear the subspace ruptures and go to warp?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Ten, maybe fifteen minutes. But those ships will catch up to us before then.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Well we have one advantage. We've got Omega. They won't risk firing at us. At least not until they run out of options. That should give us a chance to neutralize the molecules.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain, we might have another problem.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Seven of Nine?

title: The Omega Directive
line: She's convinced she can stabilize Omega.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I thought we'd settled that question.

title: The Omega Directive
line: While you were on the surface, she showed me a pretty convincing simulation of how it could be done.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I should have known she wouldn't just let this go. I'll be in Cargo Bay two.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Seven, the procedure?

title: The Omega Directive
line: It's working. Eleven percent of the molecules have already been neutralized.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Let's see if we can speed up the process a little.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Did Chakotay tell you about my idea?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then you will allow me to stabilize the remaining molecules.

title: The Omega Directive
line: You know I can't do that.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Your Starfleet Directive is no longer relevant. I have found a way to control Omega.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I don't care if you can make it sing and dance. We're getting rid of it.

title: The Omega Directive
line: A foolish decision.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes, but it's mine to make. Now step aside.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I could have done this without your permission, but I chose to follow your command structure. I should have made the attempt. I still can.

title: The Omega Directive
line: But you won't. You know I'm not trying to stop you from finding perfection, but I can't risk the safety of this Quadrant. Omega must end here. We both know that. Status?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Eighteen percent.

title: The Omega Directive
line: This could take hours. Can you increase the harmonic resonance?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes. but it would rupture the chamber.

title: The Omega Directive
line: How many molecules would we neutralize?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Forty, fifty percent at best.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's good enough. Our torpedo can take care of the rest. Janeway to bridge.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Chakotay here.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Chakotay, I want you to clear deck four. Put emergency forcefields around this section. Prepare to decompress Cargo Bay two on my command.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Understood.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Tuvok, load the gravimetric torpedo. Once we've jettisoned the chamber, fire.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Aye, Captain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Harmonic resonance to maximum.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Commander, they're closing on us.

title: The Omega Directive
line: They're attempting to stop us with a tractor beam.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Adjust shields to compensate.

title: The Omega Directive
line: They're hailing us.

title: The Omega Directive
line: On screen.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Disengage your engines and prepare to be boarded.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I can't do that.

title: The Omega Directive
line: You've stolen our technology, abducted our people.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Your people are safe. They're receiving medical care. I'll be glad to get them back to you when this is over. But we're keeping the molecules.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I won't allow this substance to fall into enemy hands. I'll destroy it first.

title: The Omega Directive
line: They're charging weapons.

title: The Omega Directive
line: You'll destabilize the molecules. We'll both be destroyed.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Then return our technology. Now.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I'm sorry. That's not possible.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Direct hit. Shields down ten percent.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Evasive maneuvers. Try to shake them off.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Harmonic resonance at maximum, Captain.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The molecules?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Eighty percent remaining.

title: The Omega Directive
line: We need to get that down to sixty.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Any damage to our power grid could overload the chamber. Omega would chain react.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The same thought crossed my mind. Where are we now?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Seventy two percent.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's close enough, Bridge, start the decompression sequence.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Acknowledged.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What's wrong? What's happening?

title: The Omega Directive
line: The molecules are stabilizing.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What?

title: The Omega Directive
line: I've done nothing. It's occurring spontaneously.

title: The Omega Directive
line: That's impossible.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Decompression in thirty seconds. Decompression in twenty five seconds.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Seven, let's move.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Decompression in twenty seconds.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Seven!

title: The Omega Directive
line: Decompression in fifteen seconds.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Decompression in ten seconds.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Tom, are we clear of the subspace ruptures?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Almost.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I need maximum warp within ten seconds or we'll be stuck at ground zero.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Decompression is complete. The harmonic chamber has been jettisoned.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Fire!

title: The Omega Directive
line: We made it. We're at warp one.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The alien ships?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Out of range.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Tuvok?

title: The Omega Directive
line: Sensors show no traces of Omega molecules.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Mission accomplished.

title: The Omega Directive
line: Captain's log, stardate 51793.4. We've arranged for our guests in Sickbay to be taken back to their homeworld, and we can finally put this mission behind us. This will be my last encrypted log concerning the Omega Directive. The classified datafiles will now be destroyed.

title: The Omega Directive
line: I wondered who was running my program. Master da Vinci doesn't like visitors after midnight.

title: The Omega Directive
line: He protested. I deactivated him.

title: The Omega Directive
line: What are you doing here, Seven?

title: The Omega Directive
line: This simulation contains many religious components. I was studying them to help me understand what I saw in Cargo Bay two.

title: The Omega Directive
line: The data isn't clear why Omega stabilized in the last few seconds. The chances are it was simply a chaotic anomaly, nothing more.

title: The Omega Directive
line: For three point two seconds I saw perfection. When Omega stabilized, I felt a curious sensation. As I was watching it, it seemed to be watching me. The Borg have assimilated many species with mythologies to explain such moments of clarity. I've always dismissed them as trivial. Perhaps I was wrong.

title: The Omega Directive
line: If I didn't know you better, I'd say you just had your first spiritual experience.

title: Unforgettable
line: When the Captain told us to start collecting deuterium, Seven suggested a series of modifications to the Bussard collectors. title: Living Witness
line: Captain Janeway called this meeting to figure out how we could extricate ourselves from the conflict and still maintain the trade agreement with the Vaskans. But we weren't on their side, and we certainly never attacked you.

title: Living Witness
line: Save your objections until you see the entire recreation. Let's continue.

title: Living Witness
line: We will prevail. p

title: Living Witness
line: Don't look so shocked, Ambassador. This is what you wanted, isn't it?

title: Living Witness
line: Somewhere, halfway across the galaxy I hope, Captain Janeway is spinning in her grave. You've portrayed us as monsters. The Captain's a cold-blooded killer, the crew's a gang of thugs and I'm a mass murderer.

title: Living Witness
line: Calm yourself.

title: Living Witness
line: Why should I? I'm about to be hanged for crimes I didn't commit!

title: Living Witness
line: Tell me your version of events.

title: Living Witness
line: I remember this man.

title: Living Witness
line: Tedran. He was a martyr to our people.

title: Living Witness
line: Some martyr. He led the Kyrian attack against Voyager.

title: Living Witness
line: You're lying.

title: Living Witness
line: I was there.

title: Living Witness
line: You're trying to protect yourself.

title: Living Witness
line: And so are you. From the truth. Isn't it a coincidence that the Kyrians are being portrayed in the best possible light? Martyrs, heroes, saviors. Obviously, events have been reinterpreted to make your people feel better about themselves. Revisionist history. It's such a comfort.

title: Living Witness
line: We were not the aggressors in the Great War, we were the victims. The proof can be found anywhere on this world. The Kyrian people are being oppressed to this day.

title: Living Witness
line: The problems in your society are none of my business. I'm just telling you what I saw seven hundred years ago.

title: Living Witness
line: I don't believe you, and neither will anyone else.

title: Living Witness
line: What are you doing?

title: Living Witness
line: Shutting down your program.

title: Living Witness
line: Wait, please. I can prove to you I'm right. The medical tricorder, the artifact you have on display. If you just let me

title: Living Witness
line: Lies.

title: Living Witness
line: Begin dictation. I've re-examined the data module. From what I can tell, the Doctor was telling the truth, at least about one thing. He is a hologram. A backup program. We always knew he was an artificial lifeform but, we thought he was an android. If we were mistaken about that, I wonder if we might also be wrong about Voyager itself. Another question. Why would a hologram designed for medical purposes be programmed to lie so readily? From the moment I activated him, this Doctor has insisted that he's innocent. At first I didn't believe him. End dictation.

title: Living Witness
line: Activate recreation, the Voyager encounter. Display medical chamber.

title: Living Witness
line: Please state the nature of the medical. Oh, it's you.

title: Living Witness
line: You've given me a lot to think about.

title: Living Witness
line: Really? I thought you'd heard enough of my lies.

title: Living Witness
line: I judged you too quickly. I'm sorry.

title: Living Witness
line: What changed your mind?

title: Living Witness
line: Time to think.

title: Living Witness
line: For your information, I don't appreciate being deactivated in the middle of a sentence. It brings back unpleasant memories.

title: Living Witness
line: It won't happen again.

title: Living Witness
line: Good, because if you don't stop treating me like a second-class hologram, I won't cooperate with your investigation. I'm perfectly happy to lie dormant in that module for a few eons.

title: Living Witness
line: I didn't come here to argue.

title: Living Witness
line: Then what do you want?

title: Living Witness
line: I don't know. To talk, I guess, about what really happened seven hundred years ago.

title: Living Witness
line: Are you sure you're willing to listen to a mass-murderer like me?

title: Living Witness
line: I'm willing to keep an open mind. That's the most I can promise. Try to understand my point of view. All my life, I thought I knew the truth. There was never any doubt.

title: Living Witness
line: I never meant to throw your beliefs into doubt, but I can't deny what I know to be true.

title: Living Witness
line: I realize that now, and I want to know the truth. And I want the Arbiters to know it, too.

title: Living Witness
line: Well, the stage is certainly set, but I'll have to rewrite the characters and revise the plot a little. I'm quite adept in the art of holographic programming. If you'll give me access to your technology, maybe I can create a simulation of own. Show you what happened.

title: Living Witness
line: Don't worry, Ambassador. We've got plenty of medical supplies and we'd be more than happy to share them with you.

title: Living Witness
line: Then we agree. In exchange, we'll provide you with as much dilithium as you need. p

title: Living Witness
line: That's very generous, Ambassador

title: Living Witness
line: I'll transport the canisters immediately. It would be in your best interest to make this exchange quickly. p

title: Living Witness
line: Oh? Why's that?

title: Living Witness
line: We've been conflict with a neighboring species, the Kyrians. They've been threatening to attack us. War could break out any day. We've tried every diplomatic option, but the Kyrians are a violent, stubborn people. p

title: Living Witness
line: No problem. I understand what you're going through.

title: Living Witness
line: I wish I could make you one of our diplomats. You might have better luck resolving this situation. p

title: Living Witness
line: Under different circumstances. Janeway to Sickbay.

title: Living Witness
line: This is the Doctor. p

title: Living Witness
line: Ambassador Daleth and I have reached an agreement.

title: Living Witness
line: Assemble the medical supplies. p

title: Living Witness
line: Done, Captain. The supplies are in Cargo Bay one. p

line: Once we transport the supplies to the surface there may be a p

line: Red alert. Captain Janeway to the bridge.

title: Living Witness
line: We're being fired on by three ships.

title: Living Witness
line: The Kyrians. p

title: Living Witness
line: Hail them. p

title: Living Witness
line: Channel open. p

title: Living Witness
line: This is Captain Janeway of the starship Voyager. We are not your enemies. Please break off your attack. p

title: Living Witness
line: They're not responding.

title: Living Witness
line: I'd advise you to retreat, Captain. p

title: Living Witness
line: Shields down to eight six percent. p

title: Living Witness
line: Break out of orbit. Put some distance between us. p

title: Living Witness
line: Yes, ma'am. p

title: Living Witness
line: Take as much of their technology as you can. p

line: You will fail. p

line: Drop your weapons.

title: Living Witness
line: Back away.
