line: Tuvok to Janeway. p

title: Living Witness
line: Go ahead. p

title: Living Witness
line: The Kyrians have killed

title: Living Witness
line: Three of the engineering crew. They've taken Seven of Nine and one of the injured crew members hostage.

title: Living Witness
line: They're now on deck two, section thirty two. p

title: Living Witness
line: Acknowledged. Remember your offer to make me a diplomat? Well, it looks like I don't have much of a choice. Tell the doctor we have casualties. Have him meet us on deck two.

title: Living Witness
line: Janeway to Tuvok. We're approaching section thirty one. p

title: Living Witness
line: The evacuation of deck two is complete. p

title: Living Witness
line: Send three security teams to this deck, then seal all the access points. p

title: Living Witness
line: Acknowledged.

title: Living Witness
line: How typical of the Kyrians. p

title: Living Witness
line: What do you mean?

title: Living Witness
line: They fight the same way they live. Deviously. p

title: Living Witness
line: Janeway to Tuvok. p

title: Living Witness
line: Tuvok here. p

title: Living Witness
line: The Kyrians are in the mess hall. We're going in. p

title: Living Witness
line: Security is on the way. p

title: Living Witness
line: I'll go first, Captain, and draw any fire if need be.

title: Living Witness
line: Your crew is heroic, Captain. p

title: Living Witness
line: I just happen to be invulnerable to phaser fire, but I appreciate the compliment. Captain? p

title: Living Witness
line: Go.

title: Living Witness
line: Tedran, this is between us. Leave these people out of it.

title: Living Witness
line: I know what you're doing. An alliance with these aliens. p

title: Living Witness
line: We were trading with them, nothing more.

title: Living Witness
line: You expect me to believe that? You plan to use this ship to destroy us.

title: Living Witness
line: We wouldn't need help if we wanted to destroy you. p

title: Living Witness
line: We didn't realize you were fighting with the Vaskans. Now, lay down your weapons and I promise you won't be harmed. p

title: Living Witness
line: No! p

title: Living Witness
line: He's dead.

title: Living Witness
line: Computer, freeze program. A tragic, needless death, but as you can see, Voyager was not responsible. After Tedran was killed, Voyager was attacked by nine Kyrian ships. My program was disabled, most likely when they stole my backup module. The next thing I knew, I was standing next to this gentleman seven centuries later.

title: Living Witness
line: Very entertaining.

title: Living Witness
line: I'll admit your holotechnology is new to me. I had to extrapolate in a few places. But I assure you this is an accurate recreation.

title: Living Witness
line: Perhaps. Or perhaps it's the fabrication of a war criminal who's afraid for his life.

title: Living Witness
line: Do you have any evidence to support your explanation?

title: Living Witness
line: In fact, I do. I've confirmed that this is the same tricorder I used to scan Tedran at the moment of his death. If I can access the bio-readings inside, I can prove he was killed by a Vaskan weapon, not by Captain Janeway.

title: Living Witness
line: Can this be done?

title: Living Witness
line: I've been trying to decipher the instrument for years, but, with the Doctor's help

title: Living Witness
line: I fail to see what this would prove. Tedran died on Voyager, a victim of a conspiracy to oppress my people. The weapon used, who fired it, this is all beside the point.

title: Living Witness
line: Was there a conspiracy? Did Voyager really help my ancestors to start the Great War? Or were Kyrians the aggressors as my people have always believed? Now, this casts doubt on everything.

title: Living Witness
line: But it doesn't change the fact my children can't attend the same academies as yours, or that we are forced to live outside of the city center.

title: Living Witness
line: Today's problems are not at issue here. This is about history.

title: Living Witness
line: Look, I don't know who started your war. All I'm saying is that Voyager wasn't responsible.

title: Living Witness
line: I can't believe that you would cooperate with this murderer. You of all people. You built this museum.

title: Living Witness
line: The facts are turning out to be more complex than I expected.

title: Living Witness
line: We shouldn't be listening to this hologram. I want him arrested and charged for the crimes we know he committed.

title: Living Witness
line: That's not your decision to make.

title: Living Witness
line: No, it's not, is it? I'm only on this commission because you needed a token Kyrian.

title: Living Witness
line: Please. This isn't about race.

title: Living Witness
line: It's always about race. You seize every opportunity to keep yourselves in power.

title: Living Witness
line: I'm sorry you see it that way. I think we are obligated to hear what the Doctor has to say. Proceed with your investigation.

title: Living Witness
line: Yes, Arbiter.

title: Living Witness
line: You'll pay for your crimes.

title: Living Witness
line: Seven hundred years and I'm still caught in the middle of your little dispute. One might have hoped for a bit of social progress in the interim.

title: Living Witness
line: Change never comes easily for us.

title: Living Witness
line: Hmm. That's an understatement.

title: Living Witness
line: I've entered the specifications that you gave me.

title: Living Witness
line: Let's give it a try. Hmm. Close enough. This diagnostic tool should help me get past the initial encryption sequences. Too bad we can't re-create B'Elanna Torres.

title: Living Witness
line: Torres. The chief transporter operator.

title: Living Witness
line: Chief Engineer. You might want to make the correction in your history books.

title: Living Witness
line: What was she like, Torres? I suppose we've gotten her personality wrong too.

title: Living Witness
line: Starting to believe me, are you?

title: Living Witness
line: Well, let's just say I'm trying to keep an open mind.

title: Living Witness
line: B'Elanna Torres. Intelligent, beautiful and with a chip on her shoulder the size of the Horsehead Nebula. She also had a kind of vulnerability that made her quite endearing.

title: Living Witness
line: You miss her, and the others.

title: Living Witness
line: From my perspective, I saw them all only a few days ago. But in fact, it's been centuries, and I'll never see them again. Did they ever reach home? I wonder.

title: Living Witness
line: I've always wondered that too, from as far back as I can remember.

title: Living Witness
line: Really?

title: Living Witness
line: Ever since I was a small child, the first time I heard the name Voyager, it conjured up my imagination.

title: Living Witness
line: Even though we were the bad guys?

title: Living Witness
line: That didn't matter. I was too young to understand the implications. The fact you were so far from home, traveling across the stars. Ah, I found it all very heroic. I suppose Voyager is what made me fall in love with history.

title: Living Witness
line: If it means anything to you, you would have made a fine member of our crew.

title: Living Witness
line: I hope that's part of the simulation.

title: Living Witness
line: No, it isn't.

title: Living Witness
line: Everything goes! The days of lies are over! Destroy it all!

title: Living Witness
line: No! Stop this!

title: Living Witness
line: We know about the hologram. This museum's filled with lies.

title: Living Witness
line: Stop! Listen to me!

title: Living Witness
line: We've listened long enough!

title: Living Witness
line: They're using photon grenades. We've got to take cover. This way.

title: Living Witness
line: What's happening? I've been hearing weapons.

title: Living Witness
line: It's getting worse. Protests, vandalism. Two people have been killed. Don't worry, they've cordoned off the museum. We're safe for now.

title: Living Witness
line: That's not what I'm concerned about. Two deaths, a race riot, all because of me?

title: Living Witness
line: You were only the catalyst. The pressure's been building for years. It was only a matter of time before something set it off. Have you found the tricorder?

title: Living Witness
line: Not yet.

title: Living Witness
line: It's crucial that we do. The Kyrians are demanding you be punished for your crimes, but the Vaskans want to hear your version of events again. They want to continue the investigation.

title: Living Witness
line: What's going to happen?

title: Living Witness
line: I don't know. The Vaskans are more powerful, but the Kyrians are very angry. They're talking about another war.

title: Living Witness
line: Then there's only one solution. Delete my program. I've become a kind of symbol for this conflict. As long as I'm around your people are going to keep on fighting. I'll show you how to decompile my program. You can say I was damaged in the attack last night. No one will hold you responsible.

title: Living Witness
line: I can't do that to you.

title: Living Witness
line: Then I'll do it myself.

title: Living Witness
line: No!

title: Living Witness
line: I'm a medical hologram, programmed to do no harm. But I'm doing harm on a global scale. Ever since you reactivated me, I've been concerned with clearing Voyager's good name. But that's not important now. There's more at stake.

title: Living Witness
line: A few days ago I might have agreed with you, but what about the facts?

title: Living Witness
line: Facts be damned! Names, dates, places, it's all open to interpretation. Who's to say what really happened? And ultimately, what difference does it make? What matters is today and the future of your people.

title: Living Witness
line: Doctor, you were there. You can't deny what happened.

title: Living Witness
line: I can, and I will. Tedran was a martyr for your people, a hero. A symbol of your struggle for freedom. Who am I to wander in seven hundred years later and take that away from you?

title: Living Witness
line: History has been abused. We keep blaming each other for what happened in the past. If you don't help us now, it could be another seven hundred years.

title: Living Witness
line: Let's find that tricorder.

title: Living Witness
line: It was a pivotal moment in our history. As a result of the Doctor's testimony, a dialogue was opened between our peoples. Eventually, we found a new respect for our divergent cultures and traditions. The efforts of people like Quarren and the Doctor paved the way for unity. Quarren died six years later, but he lived long enough to witness the Dawn of Harmony.

title: Living Witness
line: And the Doctor?

title: Living Witness
line: Well, he served as our surgical chancellor for many years until he decided to leave. He took a small craft and set a course for the Alpha Quadrant, attempting to trace the path of Voyager. He said he had a longing for home. This way.

title: Demon
line: The ship is gray, Captain. We've cut power to decks four through nine. Replicators, holodecks and all other nonessentials are offline. Remaining systems are operating at twenty percent capacity.

title: Demon
line: Tom, how long can you keep us flying?

title: Demon
line: With the deuterium supply this low? Even at one quarter impulse we'll be out of gas inside a week.

title: Demon
line: Everyone redouble your efforts. Keep your eyes open for new sources of deuterium. Tuvok, Chakotay, I want recommendations for further methods of conservation. Harry, you and I will give them a hand in geophysics. See if we can't synthesize a substitute fuel. In the meantime, we stay in gray mode. If anybody's got any other ideas, I'm listening.

title: Demon
line: We could set up a bicycle in the mess hall, attach a generator, pedal home.

title: Demon
line: Now why didn't I think of that?

title: Demon
line: And I volunteer Harry to take the first shift.

title: Demon
line: Living space will be extremely limited. Take only those personal items which are absolutely essential.

title: Demon
line: Hello, there.

title: Demon
line: What, may I ask, is this?

title: Demon
line: That, Mister Vulcan, is the Selected Works of Jirex.

title: Demon
line: Only essential items, Mister Neelix.

title: Demon
line: Oh, Jirex is essential. He's the greatest writer in the Talaxian canon. I never go to sleep without reading at least one of his parables.

title: Demon
line: A habit you will have to break until we're able to restore power to crew quarters.

title: Demon
line: I suppose I can try.

title: Demon
line: And these?

title: Demon
line: I get terrible neck pains without them.

title: Demon
line: I suggest you ask the Doctor to prescribe an anti-inflammatory.

title: Demon
line: Fine. I don't mind roughing it.

title: Demon
line: Mister Neelix. The blankets.

title: Demon
line: No, no, that's where I draw the line. My mother knitted these herself. I've slept with them since I was a child.

title: Demon
line: You'll have to make do with standard issue bedding.

title: Demon
line: Those Starfleet blankets give me a rash.

title: Demon
line: I suggest you ask the Doctor

title: Demon
line: For some anti-itch cream. I might as well sleep in Sickbay. Thank you, Mister Vulcan. You've just given me an idea.

title: Demon
line: What's going on here?

title: Demon
line: I'm working.

title: Demon
line: You were ordered to shut down Astrometrics an hour ago. We can't afford the power. Seven, it's inefficient.

title: Demon
line: Efficiency is relative, Commander. If I shut down Astrometrics, I won't be able to scan for new fuel sources.

title: Demon
line: I appreciate your efforts, but we'll have to use conventional scanners until

title: Demon
line: Conventional scanners would not have found this.

title: Demon
line: What?

title: Demon
line: Highly concentrated deuterium.

title: Demon
line: Where?

title: Demon
line: Computer, display source. A planetoid point four light-years from our present position. There are dense pockets of deuterium just beneath the surface.

title: Demon
line: Maybe so, but that's a Demon class planet.

title: Demon
line: Demon class?

title: Demon
line: That's what Starfleet calls it. Also known as Class Y. It's got a toxic atmosphere filled with thermionic radiation. Surface temperatures are in excess of five hundred Kelvins. Just entering a standard orbit would be suicide.

title: Demon
line: Our situation is desperate.

title: Demon
line: True.

title: Demon
line: When faced with desperate circumstances, we must adapt.

title: Demon
line: Captain's log, supplemental. I've ordered adaptations to our shields to repel the thermionic discharges. Hoping that the benefits will outweigh the risks, we're now trying to beam deuterium from beneath the planet's surface.

title: Demon
line: Narrow the annular confinement beam to point four seven terahertz. Ready here, Captain.

title: Demon
line: Stand by. Harry, shunt whatever additional power you can to the containment field. I don't want any of those atmospheric gasses seeping in.

title: Demon
line: Aye, Captain.

title: Demon
line: A thermionic discharge has struck the forward shields. They're holding.

title: Demon
line: Let's get this over with before you tell me otherwise. Seven, do it.

title: Demon
line: Energize. Transport in progress.

title: Demon
line: Shields are weakening.

title: Demon
line: I'm reading an overload in the pattern buffers.

title: Demon
line: Abort transport.

title: Demon
line: Controls not responding.

title: Demon
line: Get out of there now.

title: Demon
line: Computer, seal off the transporter room and erect a level ten containment field.

title: Demon
line: Containment field established.

title: Demon
line: The good news is Nozawa and Seven of Nine have both been treated and released from Sickbay, and the planetary gasses have been expelled from the transporter room.

title: Demon
line: And the bad news?

title: Demon
line: The transporters are offline. It'll take days before they're back again.

title: Demon
line: Great. We use valuable energy on a course change and all we get for our trouble is another downed system. Can we send a probe to collect the deuterium?

title: Demon
line: It would incinerate within seconds of entering the upper atmosphere.

title: Demon
line: Then I don't see any other options. Tom, put us back on our original course, one quarter impulse.

title: Demon
line: Captain, maybe I can help.

title: Demon
line: Harry, the bicycle thing was just a joke.

title: Demon
line: I've been thinking. With Tuvok's shield modifications and a few tweaks to an environmental suit, I could take a shuttle to the surface and mine the deuterium from there.

title: Demon
line: Need I remind you, Ensign, that there is no environment less hospitable to humanoid life than a Class Y.

title: Demon
line: Actually, Tuvok, no, you needn't remind me. What's the alternative? Resume course? Creep along at quarter impulse hoping we find fuel before we end up dead in the water? We've got deuterium within arm's reach. We can't let the opportunity slip away without at least trying.

title: Demon
line: He's got a point.

title: Demon
line: You wouldn't be able to communicate with us if you got in trouble, and until we get transporters back we couldn't beam you out.

title: Demon
line: Even with modifications, it wouldn't be long before your suit began to corrode. Exposure to that atmosphere could kill you within minutes.

title: Demon
line: I know the risks.

title: Demon
line: Even if I agreed, I'd never let you go alone.

title: Demon
line: Of course not. That's why I'm volunteering my good buddy Tom here to go with me.

title: Demon
line: You were pretty forceful in there.

title: Demon
line: So?

title: Demon
line: So? I don't think I've ever seen you that assertive in a staff meeting before. You must be bucking for a promotion.

title: Demon
line: I had an idea and I spoke up, that's all.

title: Demon
line: Oh, no, no, no. It was more than that. You put Tuvok in his place right in front of everybody.

title: Demon
line: He was stating the obvious again. Talking down to me like I didn't know anything about Demon Class planets.

title: Demon
line: I am not criticizing you. Believe me, nobody enjoys seeing the Vulcan Master put down a peg more than I do. I was just surprised, that's all.

title: Demon
line: Why?

title: Demon
line: It didn't seem like you.

title: Demon
line: Good.

title: Demon
line: Cargo bay two.

title: Demon
line: You trying to change your squeaky clean image or something?

title: Demon
line: Not exactly.

title: Demon
line: What, then.

title: Demon
line: How do I explain this? When I first came on board Voyager I was pretty green, right?

title: Demon
line: A deep, almost fluorescent green, if I remember correctly.

title: Demon
line: I was young, inexperienced, and I acted like it. Nervous about giving my opinion, hesitant to make suggestions, so I usually just kept my mouth shut. And I behaved that way for so long it became a habit. But, in the last four years, a lot has happened. I've fought the Borg, been transformed into an alien, helped defeat the Hirogen. Hell, I've even come back from the dead.

title: Demon
line: It's been a wild ride.

title: Demon
line: I woke up the other morning and it suddenly hit me. I've got a lot of experience now, so why should I be afraid to take the initiative or voice my ideas?

title: Demon
line: Good for you, Harry.

title: Demon
line: But do me a favor. The next time you try to assert yourself, leave me out of it. I hate hot weather.

title: Demon
line: Don't worry. We can cut some holes in the environmental suits, get some ventilation going.

title: Demon
line: Harry, while you're busy improving yourself, you might try working on your sense of humor.

title: Demon
line: My sense of humor? What about that stupid gag about the bicycle?

title: Demon
line: Oh, ho, ho. That was funny.

title: Demon
line: No, that was not funny.

title: Demon
line: I can't thank you enough for getting me in on this mission, Harry.

title: Demon
line: Don't mention it.

title: Demon
line: Remind me to volunteer you to help the next time I have to clean the warp plasma manifolds.

title: Demon
line: Really, Tom, you don't owe me anything.

title: Demon
line: Oh, but I do. We've lost attitude control.

title: Demon
line: Time to show off your piloting skills. Think you can handle it?

title: Demon
line: Watch me.

title: Demon
line: Oh, I'll be watching you, all right. Switching to manual control.

title: Demon
line: Just sit back, relax, and enjoy the ride.

title: Demon
line: We're entering the lower atmosphere. Approaching the landing coordinates.

title: Demon
line: All right. I'm going to set us down. On my mark.

title: Demon
line: Mark.

title: Demon
line: You did that on purpose, didn't you.

title: Demon
line: It's almost five hundred degrees Kelvin.

title: Demon
line: Don't worry. The suits can handle it.

title: Demon
line: If not, we'll be human barbecue.

title: Demon
line: I'm picking up traces of deuterium. Fifty meters that way. Let's move.

title: Demon
line: No sweat.

title: Demon
line: Lame.

title: Demon
line: It's coming from inside here.

title: Demon
line: What is it?

title: Demon
line: Some kind of metallic compound. Highly viscous, And if these readings are right, its temperature is only twelve degrees?

title: Demon
line: In this environment?

title: Demon
line: Whatever this stuff is it's packed with liquefied deuterium.

title: Demon
line: Jackpot!

title: Demon
line: There's another pool twenty meters that way. Why don't you go check it out while I collect a few samples here.

line: Right. I don't know, Harry. A couple of lounge chairs, a big beach umbrella, maybe some dermalplast to counteract the chemical burns and I think we've found ourselves a new vacation spot. Oh, come on. That was a little funny. Let me hear you do better. Harry. Harry?

title: Demon
line: Warning. Oxygen depletion in fifteen seconds.

title: Demon
line: You don't have any patients.

title: Demon
line: I may have one in a moment if you and your fellow squatters don't go elsewhere.

line: You wanted to see me, Doctor?

line: Oh, it's about time. Mister Neelix is attempting to turn my sickbay into a flophouse.

title: Demon
line: We are short on beds right now. We've got to adapt.

title: Demon
line: Ah ha!

line: But, what if there's a medical emergency?

title: Demon
line: Then Neelix and the others will get out of the way.

title: Demon
line: Absolutely.

title: Demon

line: But, I have a routine. I'm a night owl. What if one of them should snore while I'm listening to Puccini?

title: Demon
line: Well, if you feel that strongly about it, Doc, I suppose we'll have to consider other options.

title: Demon
line: Thank you, Commander.

line: For example, we could shut down your program until you're needed. The Captain asked me to look for ways to conserve power, and it would spare you from having to listen to them snore.

line: On my way.

title: Demon
line: But

title: Demon

line: Try scanning for infrared signatures.

line: What's up?

line: Tom and Harry still aren't back.

title: Demon
line: You want me to take another shuttle down and look for them?

title: Demon
line: And risk losing you, too? Either we keep waiting until we run out of deuterium and we get trapped in orbit, or

title: Demon
line: What's the alternative? We're up here, the deuterium's down there, and we're stuck without it. We've come this far. Janeway to engineering. Vent all plasma from the nacelles. Transfer any available power to atmospheric thrusters and stand by to commence landing sequence.

title: Demon
line: Acknowledged, Captain.

line: Start organizing repair crews. That was very good, Commander. Take an away team and find Harry and Tom.

title: Demon
line: All right.

line: I will.

line: Excuse me, Doctor.

title: Demon

line: Well, no, but I'll never be able to fall asleep.

line: I've got a very, very busy day tomorrow and my next shift is just four hours away.

title: Demon
line: Perhaps you should have thought of that when choosing your accommodations.

title: Demon
line: Well, if we can't sleep, I guess we'll just have to find some other way to pass the time. How about a sing-along? I could teach you all some Talaxian rondos and I know a Vulcan funeral dirge, not to mention the classics of Klingon opera.

title: Demon
line: Very well, Mister Neelix. You win. Pleasant dreams.

title: Demon
line: Computer, lights off.

title: Demon
line: You're a little jumpy, aren't you?

title: Demon
line: I thought I heard something.

title: Demon
line: Now you know why they call it Demon Class.

line: Demon implies a presence. This planetoid is unoccupied.

title: Demon
line: I'm picking up the shuttlecraft.

title: Demon
line: Nobody home.

line: It's unlikely their environmental suits were able to survive the elements for this long.

title: Demon
line: I hope you're wrong.

line: Looks like they went this way.

line: My tricorder isn't picking up any lifesigns. How did you reach that conclusion?

line: Footprints. I guess you never assimilated any Indian scouts.

title: Demon
line: High concentrations of deuterium coming from this fluid. I'll collect a sample.

title: Demon
line: Let's find Tom and Harry first. We'll collect the deuterium later

title: Demon
line: As you wish.

title: Demon
line: Maybe they found some shelter inside.

title: Demon
line: Commander!

title: Demon
line: Good to see you guys. Welcome to the Demon planet. Our suits were corroding, our lungs were burning. We were suffocating. You know what they say about your life passing before your eyes? Well, it's true. I was finally getting past puberty when suddenly, I lost consciousness. I don't know how long I was out but, the next thing I knew, I was awake and I was breathing normally. And I looked over at Harry. He was breathing normally too, with his helmet off. And, and we just looked at each other, and we just started laughing. I know it sounds crazy, but it was an exhilarating experience.

title: Demon
line: His vital signs are normal. Apparently he has adapted.

title: Demon
line: Just the same, we'd better let the Doctor take a look at you. Chakotay to Voyager.

title: Demon
line: I've already tried that. The comm. signal can't get out of the caves.

title: Demon
line: Then we'll call again when we get back outside.

title: Demon
line: I'm telling you, Chakotay. It was an amazing experience. It, it's like when you're a kid who's afraid of the water and you suddenly realize that you can swim. Go ahead, take your helmets off. Try it.

title: Demon
line: I'm glad you're feeling all right, but none of us should be taking any risks until we know exactly what's going on.

title: Demon
line: Don't tell me that a big, tough guy like you is afraid of a little poisoned atmosphere?

title: Demon
line: Where's Harry?

title: Demon
line: He's further inside the cave. We found a huge cache of deuterium.

title: Demon
line: Let's find him and get you two back to the ship.

title: Demon
line: Whatever you say, boss, but I'm telling you. We could breathe this air forever.

title: Demon
line: Lieutenant.

title: Demon
line: Yes?

title: Demon
line: We should have transporters back online within the hour.

title: Demon
line: Well, that's great. But right now I'm more concerned with little things like, oh, I don't know, say, life support?

title: Demon
line: Indeed. According to my calculations, environmental systems will cease to function in two hours.

title: Demon
line: You say that like you're giving me the weather report.

title: Demon
line: I agree the situation is dire, but losing our cool will not help matters.

title: Demon
line: Losing our cool? Where did you pick up that expression?

title: Demon
line: Mister Paris.

title: Demon
line: Well, there's hope for you yet. Now, how about giving me a hand.

title: Demon
line: Harry.

title: Demon
line: Commander. Isn't it incredible?

title: Demon
line: That's what I've been trying to tell them.

title: Demon
line: Are you feeling okay, Harry?

title: Demon
line: Never better. If we could get mobile transporters down here, we could mine enough deuterium to get us all the way to the Alpha Quadrant and back again.

title: Demon
line: Tom tells me you've already picked up twenty kilos. That should be enough to get the main systems back online. Let's get back to the ship. Have the Doctor take a look at you.

title: Demon
line: I'd rather stay here and keep working, if it's all the same to you.

title: Demon
line: It's not.

title: Demon
line: Really, Commander, I'm fine. You should send some more personnel out to help. They won't even need environmental suits.

title: Demon
line: I appreciate your enthusiasm, but we're going back to Voyager. Now.

title: Demon
line: It's all right, Harry. Once the Doc takes a look at us and sees we're fine, we'll get right back to work.

title: Demon
line: Status, Mister Tuvok?

title: Demon
line: I've shut down life support everywhere but decks one and five. It should provide us with an extra hour of breathable air.

title: Demon
line: Chakotay to Voyager.

title: Demon
line: Janeway here.

title: Demon
line: We've found Tom and Harry.

title: Demon
line: First good news I've had all day. What about the deuterium?

title: Demon
line: We've got

title: Demon
line: A few kilos. We're on our way back to Voyager now.

line: What's your position?

title: Demon
line: About two kilometers from the ship.

title: Demon
line: Captain.

title: Demon
line: Transporters are coming back online. We should be able to beam you back from that distance, but it may take a few minutes.

title: Demon
line: Have the Doctor standing by. I think he's going to want to look at Tom and Harry.

title: Demon
line: Computer, lights. Maximum illumination. Everybody up! Rise and shine, Mister Neelix.

title: Demon
line: What's going on?

line: It's checkout time.

title: Demon
line: It's the middle of the night.

title: Demon
line: Medicine knows no time clock. I've got patients on the way and there's no more room at the inn.

line: Patients. Is somebody sick?

title: Demon
line: I can't answer that until I've examined them, now can I?

title: Demon
line: Examine who?

title: Demon
line: Ensign Kim and Lieutenant Paris.

title: Demon
line: Is there anything I can do to help?

title: Demon
line: Yes. You and your friends can vacate the premises.

line: Right, move! You heard the Doctor. This is an emergency evacuation. Move! Move! Move! Doctor.

line: Yes?

title: Demon
line: Thanks for your hospitality. And if you ever need a place to stay, my door's always open.

line: What happened to them?

line: What are you doing?

title: Demon
line: Filling the area inside the forcefield with the atmospheric gasses from the planet. Try to breathe normally now. Easy, or you'll hyperventilate. Slowly. In and out. In and out.

title: Demon
line: That stuff is in our blood?

title: Demon
line: I'm afraid so. From what I can tell, you've been bioformed.

title: Demon
line: Bioformed?

title: Demon
line: Think of it as the opposite of terraforming. In the same way we adapt the environment of a planet to suit our needs, this planet has adapted you.

title: Demon
line: How is that possible?

title: Demon
line: This fluid somehow entered your bloodstream and began altering your physiology at the cellular level. I haven't had the time to analyze this substance, but I hope to have answers soon.

title: Demon
line: I'd like to run a few tests of my own, if you don't mind.

title: Demon
line: Of course.

title: Demon
line: So, what's our prognosis, Doc?

title: Demon
line: Well, you'll be fine. As long as you keep breathing the planet's gasses.

title: Demon
line: You mean we have to stay inside this forcefield?

title: Demon
line: I'm afraid it's worse than that. The atmosphere of this planet can't be replicated safely.

title: Demon
line: Which means if we leave, we'll have nothing to breathe.

title: Demon
line: Exactly. Either we find a way to treat your condition, or you'll have to be left behind.

title: Demon
line: Can the bioforming process be reversed?

title: Demon
line: As it stands, I don't know enough about the phenomenon to undo it.

title: Demon
line: I'll send Chakotay and Seven back to the surface. They'll gather as much information as they can. B'Elanna and I will start running tests on this.

title: Demon
line: Let me go with the away team, Captain. I know the terrain. I can help.

title: Demon
line: Doctor?

title: Demon
line: Right now they're better off out there than they are in here. But one of you will have to remain so I can monitor your condition.

title: Demon
line: No problem. I volunteer Tom to stay here and play guinea pig.

title: Demon
line: Each square kilometer of this planetoid is less appealing than the last.

title: Demon
line: I think it's breathtaking.

title: Demon
line: Breathtaking?

title: Demon
line: Yes.

title: Demon
line: Perhaps your recent experience has impaired your perceptions.

title: Demon
line: No, I don't think so. I wasn't really seeing it before.

title: Demon

title: Demon

title: Demon
line: Would you care to point out an example?

title: Demon
line: Look over there. What do you see?

title: Demon
line: I see monochromatic geological formations, dust, haze.

title: Demon
line: What do you see, Harry?

title: Demon
line: To me, those geological formations are a dozen shades of red and gold. That dust, it's glowing. And the haze, it seems to intensify the colors. I'm sorry. I know it's weird, but I feel connected to this place.

title: Demon
line: Connected how?

line: I'm picking up humanoid lifesigns.

title: Demon
line: Location?

title: Demon
line: One hundred meters this way.

title: Demon
line: Magnify. Factor ten. Deuterium, hydrogen sulfate, dichromates.

title: Demon
line: Add a little sodium chloride and it would probably taste a lot like Neelix's soup.

title: Demon
line: We should be so lucky. Oh, what's this? Magnify. Factor twenty.

title: Demon
line: Captain? That's a protein molecule.

title: Demon
line: This fluid has organic properties. Let me see the sample that's been treated with the reagents.

title: Demon
line: Captain.

title: Demon
line: Let's get you to sickbay.

title: Demon
line: Wait. That might not be necessary.

title: Demon
line: Commander!

line: Janeway to bridge. Report.

line: A large pool of the metallic compound is forming beneath the ship. We are sinking, Captain.

line: On my way. Get down to Engineering. Get thrusters online. We're getting off this planet.

title: Demon
line: I'm not sure how, but they're still alive.

title: Demon
line: Just barely.

title: Demon
line: Go ahead.

line: The Captain has ordered an emergency ascent.

line: We must bring you back to the ship.

title: Demon
line: We found another Paris and Kim.

title: Demon
line: I can't explain it.

line: I think I can. Prepare for transport.

line: Beam us directly to Sickbay.

line: No. I don't want to go back.

line: Maybe so. But until we know what's going on, you've got to come back with us to the ship. Harry, no!

line: Four of the away team are in Sickbay, Captain. I'm trying to get a lock on the fifth. It is Ensign Kim or rather, one of the Ensigns Kim. The ship is continuing to sink.

line: Then there's no time. We've got to get back into orbit. We'll worry about Harry or whoever he is once we're up. Bring antigrav thrusters online.

line: Thrusters are offline due to an overload. Decks thirteen through fifteen are submerged. If we don't lift off soon, the hull will begin to corrode.

line: I need thrusters back online.

line: How long?

line: There must be some way to disperse it. Try a nadion burst from the phaser emitters. It may weaken the electromagnetic properties of the fluid.

line: Aye, Captain.

line: I'm on my way to Sickbay to check on Harry and Tom. You've got the bridge.

line: How are they?

title: Demon
line: And him?

title: Demon
line: Aside from his ability to breathe the rarified air on this planet, he's the exact duplicate of Mister Paris. He even seems to share his memories, not to mention his winning personality.

title: Demon
line: B'Elanna and I discovered that the fluid has mimetic properties. Somehow, it reads the DNA of whatever it comes in contact with and re-creates it.

title: Demon
line: Fascinating.

line: Can you tell me who you are?

line: Please, just let me go back.

line: Captain, you have to believe me. I don't know any more than you do about this. Until he showed up, I thought I was Tom Paris. line: Ow. What are you doing?

line: If you really do have Harry Kim's memories, you know that I'm going to do whatever it takes to get this ship back in orbit.

line: Well then, you're going to have to help me figure it out. Mister Tuvok, I'm on my way to transporter room one. Erect a level seven forcefield around the platform. Fill it with atmosphere from the planet and then beam Mister Kim, or rather his duplicate, aboard.

line: And I'm willing to stop. But I'll say it again, release the ship.

title: Demon
line: No. We need you.

title: Demon
line: What are you?

title: Demon
line: Stop. No.

title: Demon
line: I'll fire again.

title: Demon
line: You're killing us!

title: Demon
line: You leave me no choice.

title: Demon
line: It's not fair. It's wrong!

title: Demon
line: Janeway to Tuvok.

title: Demon
line: No! No, no, no. Please. No more.

title: Demon
line: Hold your fire, Tuvok.

title: Demon

title: Demon
line: Hold your fire.

title: Demon

title: Demon
line: I want some answers.

title: Demon
line: I'm trying to understand. This is hard for me as well.

title: Demon
line: You said you have a connection to this planet. You talk about it like it's alive.

title: Demon
line: Alive. Yes, but not the planet. The silver blood.

title: Demon
line: The compound that sampled Harry's DNA, and created you.

title: Demon
line: Yes. but it's never been conscious, never sentient before now. Before me and the other.

title: Demon
line: Tom Paris.

title: Demon
line: We're the first. Don't you see? You came here. You showed us. When the compound came in contact with Tom and Harry, it experienced awareness for the first time. Before, it was only instinct, sound and light and heat. But those two showed us thought.

title: Demon
line: I'm beginning to understand. This silver blood experienced sentience, and now you want more. You want to duplicate the rest of this crew and populate this planet.

title: Demon

title: Hope and Fear
line: I'll be right there.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Computer, display datablock fourteen beta, auxiliary display.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Seven, I could use your help. I'm trying to reconstruct the last fragment of the Starfleet message.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Arturis said it was irreparably damaged.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I know, but I think he gave up too easily.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Intuition?

title: Hope and Fear
line: It's intuition if I'm right. I've designed a new decryption algorithm. Let's give it a try.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Captain. I will not be going with you to the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I can understand your reluctance. It's been hard enough dealing with a crew of a hundred and fifty individual humans. The prospect of an entire planet must be overwhelming.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I am not overwhelmed. I simply do not wish to live among humans.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Well, whether you like it or not, you're one of us. You've come a long way from that drone who stepped out of a Borg alcove nine months ago. Don't turn your back on humanity now. Not when you're about to take your biggest step. Earth. Your home.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I may have come a long way, but not in the direction you think. You've attempted to influence my development. You exposed me to your culture, you ideals. You hoped to shape me in your own image. But you have failed. You may have noticed our tendency to disagree.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Oh, I've noticed.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Then you must also recognize that I do not share your values. Your desire to explore space is inefficient. Your need for familial connections is a weakness. Your infatuation with this planet is irrational.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I won't argue that you've turned out differently than I expected, and that we often have conflicting points of view. But right now, the stakes are higher. This crew needs your expertise. Abandon them and you diminish their chances of getting home.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Irrelevant.

title: Hope and Fear
line: No, it's not. We've given you a lot, Seven. It's time you gave something in return.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I have, on many occasions. Now I refuse.

title: Hope and Fear
line: What would you do, go back to the Collective?

title: Hope and Fear
line: I don't know.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Then what exactly do you have in mind?

title: Hope and Fear
line: I don't know.

title: Hope and Fear
line: That's my point. You're asking me to cast you adrift in the Delta Quadrant alone and without support. I wouldn't grant that request to any member of this crew because it's too dangerous.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I will survive.

title: Hope and Fear
line: On what, Borg perfection?

title: Hope and Fear
line: Precisely.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I don't buy it. This isn't about your independence or your superiority. This is about your fear. You're not making this choice because you've outgrown humanity. I think you're afraid to go back to Earth.

title: Hope and Fear
line: The algorithm's working. It's reconstructing the datablock. That's strange, I thought we already recovered this part of the message.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Perhaps it is an addendum from the Admiral. You did designate him a windbag.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Oh, I don't think so. The data index doesn't match. This is a completely different message.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Apologies from everyone at Starfleet Command. We've had our best people working around the clock, trying to find a wormhole, a new means of propulsion, anything to get you home. But despite our best efforts. I know it's not what you were hoping, but we've sent you all the data we've collected on the Delta Quadrant. With any luck, you'll find at least some part of it useful. Maybe enough to shave a few years off your journey. Safe journey. We hope to see you soon.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Your intuition was correct.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Unfortunately.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Arturis must have created a false message.

title: Hope and Fear
line: It sure as hell looks that way. Janeway to Tuvok.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Yes, Captain.

title: Hope and Fear
line: My suspicions have been confirmed.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Arturis tampered with Starfleet's message.

title: Hope and Fear
line: The Dauntless isn't what it appears to be.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I agree. We've discovered alien technology behind a bulkhead

title: Hope and Fear
line: In Engineering. I can't identify it.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Where's Arturis now?

title: Hope and Fear
line: On the Dauntless bridge, working with Lieutenant Torres.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Go to the bridge, but don't tip our hand.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I'll be there with a full security team within minutes.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Understood.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Let's get weapons.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Don't touch that! You almost kicked us into slipstream drive.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Oh. I wouldn't want to do that. Kucha meRah.

title: Hope and Fear
line: No problem. You speak Klingon.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I do now. Your captain was kind enough to let me review your linguistic database.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I only know speak a few phrases myself.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Oh, shame. It's a robust language.

title: Hope and Fear
line: A little too robust for me.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Evacuate the repair teams.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Captain?

title: Hope and Fear
line: Do it. Explain yourself.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I don't know what you're talking about.

title: Hope and Fear
line: You fabricated the message from Starfleet. I recovered the real transmission. The one you said was irreparably damaged.

title: Hope and Fear
line: That's absurd.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Starfleet didn't send us this vessel and you're not here to help. Is this your ship?

title: Hope and Fear
line: Please, stay calm, There must be an explanation.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I tried to ignore my gut feelings, because I got carried away by the excitement of getting home. But you preyed on that, didn't you? You took advantage of our hopes and now I want to know why.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I believe that there is a threat here, Captain, but not from me. I didn't feel it was my place to make accusations, but I saw her reconfigure several key algorithms two days ago in your Astrometrics lab, and it seemed obvious. She must have been tampering with the Starfleet message.

title: Hope and Fear
line: You are lying.

title: Hope and Fear
line: She's been sabotaging your every effort to reach Earth. You don't have to believe me, Captain. You can find all the evidence you need in her personal database.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Evidence you undoubtedly put there yourself just in case you got caught. Take him to Voyager. Throw him the brig.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Janeway to Voyager. Beam us out of here.

title: Hope and Fear
line: He's trying to deflect our transporters. Stand by.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I've got everyone but Seven and the Captain. He's found a way to block their transport.

title: Hope and Fear
line: The ship's going into slipstream mode.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Pursuit course.

title: Hope and Fear
line: We lost them, Commander.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Tom, bring the warp core modifications online. We're going after them.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Sir, we haven't even had a trial run yet.

title: Hope and Fear
line: There's no time like the present.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Where are you taking us?

title: Hope and Fear
line: Home.

title: Hope and Fear
line: How'd you create the Starfleet bridge? Holograms?

title: Hope and Fear
line: Particle synthesis. Beyond your understanding.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Is this what your people do? Prey on innocent ships?

title: Hope and Fear
line: Innocent? Typical of Captain Janeway. Self-righteous.

title: Hope and Fear
line: If I've offended you or your people in some way, please tell me.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Diplomacy, Captain? Your diplomacy destroyed my world.

title: Hope and Fear
line: What? What are you saying?

title: Hope and Fear
line: You negotiated an agreement with the Borg Collective. Safe passage through their space. And in return, you helped them defeat one of their enemies.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Species eight four seven two.

title: Hope and Fear
line: In your colorful language, yes. Species eight four seven two. Did it ever occur to you that there were those of us in the Delta Quadrant who had a vested interest in that war? Victory would have meant the annihilation of the Borg, but you couldn't see beyond the bow of your own ship!

title: Hope and Fear
line: In my estimation, Species eight four seven two posed a greater threat than the Borg.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Who are you to make that decision? A stranger to this Quadrant.

title: Hope and Fear
line: There wasn't exactly time to take a poll. I had to act quickly.

title: Hope and Fear
line: My people managed to elude the Borg for centuries. Outwitting them, always one step ahead. But in recent years, the Borg began to weaken our defenses. They were closing in and Species eight four seven two was our last hope to defeat them. You took that away from us! The outer colonies were the first to fall. Twenty three in a matter of hours. Our sentry vessels tossed aside, no defense against the storm. By the time they'd surrounded our star system, hundreds of Cubes, we had already surrendered to our own terror. A few of us managed to survive. Ten, twenty thousand. I was fortunate. I escaped with a vessel. Alone, but alive. I don't blame them. They were just drones, acting with their Collective instinct. You, you had a choice!

title: Hope and Fear
line: I'm sorry for what happened to your people, but try to understand. I couldn't have known.

title: Hope and Fear
line: It took me months to find you. I watched and waited for my opportunity to make you pay for what you'd done. Then the Starfleet message, and I knew that your selfish desire to get home would surface again. That I could lure you to this vessel. That I could see to it that you'd all be assimilated and spend the rest of eternity as Borg. I was hoping to get your entire crew, but I'll settle for the two of you. In a matter of hours, this ship will return to my homeworld. Inside Borg space.

title: Hope and Fear
line: When that happens, you will be assimilated as well.

title: Hope and Fear
line: That's irrelevant. This is what you wanted all along, isn't it? To go back to your Collective? You should thank me.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Report.

title: Hope and Fear
line: We're at full impulse, but we're not breaking through the quantum barrier.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I'm having trouble controlling the field parameters. I need more power to the deflector.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Bridge to Torres.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I'm already on it, Commander.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Stand by. Reroute auxiliary power to Deflector Control. Make sure that quantum warp field is stable.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Aye, Lieutenant.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Deflector at maximum. I'm focusing the quantum field.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Make it quick. Hull temperature's at critical.

title: Hope and Fear
line: We're at slipstream velocity.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Structural integrity's down by nine percent. We've got less than an hour before the hull starts to buckle.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I've located their slipstream. I'm aligning ours to match. We're right behind them.

title: Hope and Fear
line: How far behind?

title: Hope and Fear
line: Just a few minutes.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Is there any way to increase our speed?

title: Hope and Fear
line: None. We're at maximum.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Maintain course. If I know the captain, she's already got a plan.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Any ideas?

title: Hope and Fear
line: Not presently.

title: Hope and Fear
line: We'd better think of something. We come face to face with your former family in less than an hour, and that's one reunion I'd like to miss. Unless of course, you're looking forward to rejoining the Collective?

title: Hope and Fear
line: I do not believe I am.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Not the ringing opposition I was hoping for, but I'll take it. A drone could walk through this forcefield like it was thin air. Is there enough Borg technology left in your body to let it adapt?

title: Hope and Fear
line: If I activate the appropriate nanoprobes, I could alter my bio-electric field. However, I would need to adjust my cranial implant.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Would a micro-filament do the trick?

title: Hope and Fear
line: It might.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Then let's get you one. Once you get outside, access that control panel and disable the forcefield. Then we'll try to reach the engine room.

title: Hope and Fear
line: And employ the emergency shutdown procedure.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Sufficient. You will need to cross-link the third and sixth nodules.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Déjà-vu.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Captain?

title: Hope and Fear
line: As I recall, this is where our relationship began. In a brig, nine months ago. I severed you from the Collective and you weren't exactly happy about it.

title: Hope and Fear
line: No, I was not.

title: Hope and Fear
line: In case I never get a chance to say this, I realize that I've been hard on you at times. But it was never out of anger, or regret that I brought you on board. I'm your Captain. That means I can't always be your friend. Understand?

title: Hope and Fear
line: No. However, if we are assimilated, our thoughts will become one, and I'm sure I will understand perfectly. A joke, Captain. You yourself have encouraged me to use my sense of humor.

title: Hope and Fear
line: It's nice to know you've taken some of my advice to heart.

title: Hope and Fear
line: You were correct. My desire to remain in the Delta Quadrant was based on fear. I am no longer Borg, but the prospect of becoming human is unsettling. I don't know where I belong.

title: Hope and Fear
line: You belong with us.

title: Hope and Fear
line: The adaptations are complete.

title: Hope and Fear
line: We're in business.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I can't initiate the emergency shutdown.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Our commands are being blocked from the bridge. He's detected us.

title: Hope and Fear
line: The ship's velocity has just increased. At our present speed, we will enter Borg space in less than twelve minutes.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Do we still have access to the power distribution grid?

title: Hope and Fear
line: Yes.

title: Hope and Fear
line: If we can't throw on the brakes, let's swerve the wheel. Send a power surge into the starboard thrusters.

title: Hope and Fear
line: The torsional stress at these speeds could tear the ship apart.

title: Hope and Fear
line: It's either that or join the Hive. Do it. If we're still in one piece, try to gain control of navigation. I'll be on the bridge. We have a game of Velocity scheduled for tomorrow, holodeck one. I expect you to keep the appointment.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Aye, Captain.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Sorry about the bumpy ride.

title: Hope and Fear
line: You can slow this ship down, but you can't stop it. In four minutes, Captain Janeway will be gone and a new drone will be born.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Don't count on it. Seven of Nine has accessed your navigational systems. You taught us how to use this ship a little too well. I can't begin to imagine your loss, but try to see beyond your desire for revenge.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Revenge is all I have left.

title: Hope and Fear
line: No. As long you're alive there's hope. Your people's accomplishments, their knowledge, their dignity, can survive in you. End this.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I've just destroyed the navigational controls. No one can stop this ship now. Not even me. Two minutes to Borg space.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Direct hit. The vessel's shields are down. Transporters standing by.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Get a lock on our people.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Voyager.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Come with me. It's not too late.

title: Hope and Fear
line: It is for you.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I've got them, Commander, Transporter Room two.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Alter our slipstream. Hard starboard. Take us back the way we came.

title: Hope and Fear
line: We are the Borg. You will be assimilated. Resistance is futile.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Captain's log, supplemental. We remained in the quantum slipstream for an hour before it finally collapsed. Our diagnostics have concluded that we can't risk using this technology again. But we did manage to get three hundred light years closer to home.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Full impact. Final round to Janeway. Winner, Janeway.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Nice play. You almost had me.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Almost.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Go again?

title: Hope and Fear
line: I must report to the Astrometrics lab. There is work to be done.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Work? I gave the crew strict orders to take some R and R over the next few days, and that includes you.

title: Hope and Fear
line: There are more pressing needs. I am attempting to design another method of traveling at slipstream velocities without damaging Voyager.

title: Hope and Fear
line: I thought that was impossible.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Impossible is a word that humans use far too often. I wish to continue my efforts.

title: Hope and Fear
line: A few days ago you were ready to abandon ship, and here you are, practically laying in a course to Earth.

title: Hope and Fear
line: As we approached Borg space I began to re-evaluate my future. The prospect of becoming a drone was unappealing.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Sometimes you've got to look back in order to move forward. Sounds to me like you're starting to embrace your humanity.

title: Hope and Fear
line: No. But as I said, nothing is impossible.

title: Hope and Fear
line: Computer. One more game.

title: Night
line: Citizens of Earth! Your destiny is in my hands. Those of you who acquiesce to my demands will be treated fairly. Oppose me, and you face a dire fate indeed as my slaves in the mines of Mercury! You have one hour.

title: Night
line: You'll never get away with this.

title: Night
line: Oh, but I shall. Your once proud country will fall to its knees. How ironic that I am using your rocket ship to lead my space force into battle!.

title: Night
line: You're wrong, Chaotica. Before you came on board, someone pushed the self-destruct button. In three minutes, we'll all be dead.

title: Night
line: No!

title: Night
line: The jig is up, your Majesty.

title: Night
line: Captain Proton.

title: Night
line: Spaceman First Class, Protector of Earth, scourge of intergalactic evil, at your service.

title: Night
line: But I saw you fall into the fiery mouth of that volcano.

title: Night
line: It takes more than a little lava to stop Captain Proton. Now, I want you to call off your invasion and give me back my rocket ship.

title: Night
line: There is one force in this universe that even you cannot defeat.

title: Night
line: The same to you.

title: Night
line: Doc.

title: Night
line: Mister Paris. I should have known it was you monopolizing the holodeck.

title: Night
line: Who is this insolent fool?

title: Night
line: He's one of our men. Computer, adjust the Doctor's spectral frequency.

title: Night
line: I have no interest in your frivolous fantasy. I'm here to rehearse a duet from Don Carlo and you've already gone three minutes into my scheduled

title: Night
line: Enough! Robot, attack!

title: Night
line: Destroy them. Start with him.

title: Night
line: Computer, freeze program.

title: Night
line: Doc, this is the final chapter. Satan's Robot Conquers the World. We can't stop now.

title: Night
line: Does the phrase to be continued mean anything to you?

title: Night
line: Your opera can wait.

title: Night
line: This program is a waste of photonic energy.

title: Night
line: Oh, really. Take a look around you. This is how the twentieth century saw the future. We are studying sociology.

title: Night
line: Perhaps you can teach a course at Starfleet Academy. Satan's Robot - an Historical Overview.

title: Night
line: Bridge to holodeck one. What's going on down there?

title: Night
line: Oh, nothing, Commander. Just a little power surge.

title: Night
line: Says here the hologrid just blew out.

title: Night
line: We're fixing it now, sir.

title: Night
line: Well, make it quick. The last thing we need is a broken holodeck.

title: Night
line: Seven, I want good news. That's an order.

title: Night
line: Then I must disobey. I have no good news to report. I've completed an astrometric scan of the entire region. There are no star systems within twenty five hundred light years.

title: Night
line: Nothing?

title: Night
line: Nothing.

title: Night
line: Why can't we see stars beyond that?

title: Night
line: There are heavy concentrations of theta radiation. It has occluded our sensors.

title: Night
line: Any other ships out there?

title: Night
line: None. We are alone.

title: Night
line: Every sailor's nightmare.

title: Night
line: Commander.?

title: Night
line: It's like being becalmed in the middle of the ocean. If it weren't for sensors we wouldn't even know we were at warp. We've only been crossing this expanse for two months and we're already feeling the strain. How do we last another two years?

title: Night
line: We will adapt.

title: Night
line: Easier said than done.

title: Night
line: Shall I inform the Captain of my findings?

title: Night
line: No. I'll tell her. First Officer's log, Stardate 52081.2. It's been fifty three days since we entered this desolate region. If we want to continue our course toward home we have no choice but to cross it. We won't have an opportunity to take on fresh supplies or fuel, so I've ordered all departments to create an energy reserve. We're using power cells to stockpile deuterium.

title: Night
line: This won't be much of a briefing. There's nothing new to report.

title: Night
line: Humor me.

title: Night
line: All right, let's see. Warp core's at peak efficiency, just like last week, and the week before that. And my engineering staff is going stir crazy.

title: Night
line: Thanks. Ensign.

title: Night
line: Nada.

title: Night
line: Can you be more specific?

title: Night
line: All systems are operating within normal parameters.

title: Night
line: Anything new on sensors?

title: Night
line: I've detected a sudden increase in theta radiation in the vicinity.

title: Night
line: Source?

title: Night
line: Unknown.

title: Night
line: Could be worth a look.

title: Night
line: Finally some excitement. Radiation.

title: Night
line: Next piece of business. Crew morale.

title: Night
line: Deteriorating, obviously.

title: Night
line: I have a few suggestions that might boost people's spirits.

title: Night
line: Please.

title: Night
line: Rotate crew assignments. Add variety to the daily routine. I myself wouldn't mind squeezing in a little tactical training.

title: Night
line: Noted.

title: Night
line: And the holodecks have been in high demand. I was thinking we could install a few emitters in Cargo Bay two. Turn it into a third holodeck.

title: Night
line: Hear, hear.

title: Night
line: See to it, Harry.

title: Night
line: One other item, sir. A point of er, concern among some of the crew. It's, well, it's the Captain. She's been a bit elusive lately.

title: Night
line: What's your point?

title: Night
line: People take comfort in talking to her. When they see that the Captain's happy, they're happy.

title: Night
line: Rumor has it she never leaves her quarters.

title: Night
line: Captain's privilege. She'll come to the bridge if and when she's needed.

title: Night
line: Spare us the protocol, Chakotay. It's pretty odd, you've got to admit it.

title: Night
line: It's her choice. She can run this ship from wherever the hell she wants to. Understood?

title: Night
line: Yeah. Sure.

title: Night
line: We're all feeling the pressure, including me.

title: Night
line: Listen, maybe we've got the wrong attitude. Let's think of this as a two year vacation.

title: Night
line: Dismissed.

title: Night
line: That's a great idea, Harry.

title: Night
line: Wow, Harry. You're a real genius. How do you come up with these brilliant ideas?

title: Night
line: You're such an optimistic guy.

title: Night
line: Computer, lights! Maximum level! Bergamot tea, hot. First thing in the morning I replicate some curtains.

title: Night
line: Predictable. The Novokavich gambit. You always use that opening move.

title: Night
line: That's because you always fall for it.

title: Night
line: I feel like we've played this match a hundred times.

title: Night
line: Derada is a game of subtlety.

title: Night
line: Too subtle for me.

title: Night
line: Hmm. I'll bet.

title: Night
line: What's that supposed to mean?

title: Night
line: Well, if it doesn't involve Klingon pain sticks.

title: Night
line: Good night.

title: Night
line: There you go, just when I'm winning. Who's predictable?

title: Night
line: You don't want to start a fight with me now. Not at three a.m.

title: Night
line: Three in the morning, four in the afternoon. What's the difference? You're angry twenty four hours a day.

title: Night
line: Everything is a joke to you.

title: Night
line: Good evening. Or should I say good morning? Guess you couldn't sleep either.

title: Night
line: Oh, why sleep when we're having so much fun.

title: Night
line: He's joking, Neelix. We're all supposed to laugh.

title: Night
line: I certainly am laughing, on the inside. Smiling, anyway. Let's start a new game. Cards? Maybe a little snack?

title: Night
line: No. I have a better idea. Why don't we make a schedule. A fight rotation. We can optimize our resources. I can start one, then you can start one.

title: Night
line: Please.

title: Night
line: I am really tired of these games.

title: Night
line: Well then, don't play them.

title: Night
line: Stop! You are senior officers! You are you are supposed to be setting an example for the rest. The rest of the crew.

title: Night
line: Neelix?

title: Night
line: Paris to Sickbay.

title: Night
line: Some morale officer I turned out to be.

title: Night
line: I've given you a mild sedative. It should control the urge to hyperventilate, and alleviate some of your anxiety.

title: Night
line: Anxiety? Anxiety's what I feel when I burn a pot roast. This. This is more like.

title: Night
line: Dizziness? Nausea? Unspeakable dread?

title: Night
line: Yes.

title: Night
line: Nihiliphobia. the fear of nothingness. Or in layman's terms, the fear of nothingness. If it's any consolation, I can relate to it. I go into a void every time I'm deactivated. Emptiness, complete and utter oblivion. I'll admit it was unsettling at first. The existential horror of it all.

title: Night
line: You're not helping, Doctor.

title: Night
line: Sorry. My point is, you'll get used to it.

title: Night
line: I hope so.

title: Night
line: Commander. Am I disturbing you.

title: Night
line: No.

title: Night
line: Is the Astrometrics lab designated for recreational use?

title: Night
line: I come here to meditate. Needless to say, the view from my quarters has been less than stellar lately.

title: Night
line: Astronomical phenomena help you to focus your mind.

title: Night
line: Yes. I imagine that each star represents a single thought.

title: Night
line: Meditation. It rejuvenates you?

title: Night
line: Indeed it does.

title: Night
line: I suggest you try Borg regeneration. It's much more efficient. A simple cortical implant would be required.

title: Night
line: Another time, perhaps.

title: Night
line: What is it?

title: Night
line: Long range sensors are detecting more theta radiation. Dangerously high levels.

title: Night
line: Source?

title: Night
line: Unknown.

title: Night
line: It's probably nothing. Just background theta radiation. But it could mean there's someone nearby.

title: Night
line: Distance?

title: Night
line: Approximately twenty five light years.

title: Night
line: It's a long shot, but alter course.

title: Night
line: Yes, ma'am.

title: Night
